title: Credit Model Validation Manager (Machine Learning & NPV Models)
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK)  | 💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

🌟 About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!

Our Credit Model Validation team is crucial in providing independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely and ensure that the models we use deliver good outcomes for our customers. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) to join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across our suite of credit models, covering critical business disciplines such as credit strategy and impairment.

You’ll have a particular focus on models used for customer-level decisioning and defining our credit strategies - such as underwriting scorecards, origination PD models and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models - across all our lending products.

Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is deep expertise in credit risk modelling. You’ll have hands-on experience in either model validation or model development within a financial services environment, including practical experience using Python to develop, validate or analyse machine learning and statistical models. . In-depth knowledge of credit decisioning models would be a strong plus. 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

  • Leading hands-on independent validation of models used for credit decisioning within our Borrowing strategies - covering a range of machine learning, decision science and NPV models. You will be ensuring that models are fit for purpose, appropriately governed, explainable and performing as expected
  • Supporting oversight and validation of broader credit risk models, including IFRS9, stress testing and economic response models
  • Developing deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers to improve our modelling capabilities
  • Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required
  • Performing statistical analyses to independently assess model performance, including developing challenger models where appropriate to test model assumptions and strengthen validation conclusions
  • Improving our Model Risk Framework, including overseeing our policies, standards and procedures to help embed best practice across the business. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory guidelines, and adapt our processes to make sure they remain relevant as modelling techniques evolve
  • Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees
  • Partnering with colleagues in the first line of defence credit strategy and modelling teams - and wider risk teams across Monzo - to support the embedding of our model risk framework and establishing consistent validation standards across the organisation
  • Embracing new and innovative technology, including leading the adoption of AI tools to enhance our model validation approach

 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation - in particular with exposure to machine learning or statistical models used in credit decisioning, such as decision science scorecards, origination / underwriting PD models, and NPV / unit economics modelling
  • Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep understanding of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Being able to get hands on with data is critical - so strong SQL and Python skills are essential, and experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus!
  • Understand how models are used in real-time decisioning and lending strategies, and how to balance commercial and risk outcomes
  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts
  • Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge
  • Are impact-driven, and proactive in identifying issues and opportunities to improve outcomes for both our customers and our business
  • Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):

  • Google Cloud Platform for all of our analytics infrastructure
  • dbt and BigQuery SQL for our data modelling and warehousing
  • Python for data science and machine learning
  • Go to write our application code
  • AWS for most of our backend infrastructure

The interview process: 

Our interview process usually involves up to four main stages via Google Hangouts: 

  • An initial call with our recruiter
  • A call with our Senior Model Validation Manager, the hiring manager for the role 
  • A role-specific call with colleagues from our credit modelling teams. We’ll share a short case study in advance, but you won’t need to submit a written response; we’ll use it to guide the discussion during the interview.
  • A behavioural interview 

    🙌 What’s in it for you

    • 💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance benefits.

    • 📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

    • ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

    • 📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

    • 🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

    • ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage, so please apply as soon as you can - we don’t want you to miss out!

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten.

Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten.

Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk.

Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken.

Jouw rol

Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten.

Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties.

Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren.


Wat je doet

Data- en AI-governance

  • Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI.

  • Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming.

  • Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen.

  • Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps.

  • Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten.

Data quality, metadata & AI

  • Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage.

  • Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden.

  • Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act.

Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement

  • Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen.

  • Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten.

  • Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier.

  • Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren.

  • Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team.

Samenwerking & ontwikkeling

  • Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is.

  • Je gebruikt AI-tools waar ze waarde toevoegen en beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch, met aandacht voor vertrouwelijkheid en dataveiligheid.

  • Je deelt kennis, begeleidt waar mogelijk minder ervaren collega's en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening.


Wat jij meebrengt
Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken. Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen en organisaties.

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen data governance, datamanagement of dataconsultancy.

  • Kennis van data governance, data quality, data stewardship en governanceprocessen.

  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren van analyses, begeleiden van workshops of adviseren van stakeholders.

  • Begrip van data-architectuur, datamodellering en de samenwerking tussen business en IT.

  • Interesse in AI-governance en het verantwoord toepassen van AI binnen organisaties.

  • Je gebruikt AI zelf in je werk en onderzoekt graag hoe het slimmer kan.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en weet wanneer je collega's moet betrekken.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen.

  • Een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen

  • Ervaring met maturity assessments, governance operating models of het opstellen van RACI's.

  • Kennis van DAMA-DMBOK of een CDMP-certificering, of de ambitie om deze te behalen.

  • Ervaring met datacatalogustools zoals Microsoft Purview, Collibra of Alation.

  • Kennis van metadata, data lineage en data quality frameworks.

  • Kennis van Responsible AI, de EU AI Act of data-readiness voor AI.

Over ons team

Je komt terecht in een klein, enthousiast en leergierig team van drie collega's. De lijnen zijn kort, iedereen heeft invloed en ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd. Onze focus ligt op de consultancykant van data en AI. We begeleiden organisaties bij AI-transformaties en beginnen altijd bij het echte probleem van de klant. Van daaruit ontwikkelen we roadmaps en helpen we bij de implementatie.

We werken aan data- en AI-governance, datastrategie, change management en datakwaliteit. Daarbij onderzoeken we continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. We delen kennis, proberen nieuwe werkwijzen uit en leren van elkaar. Heb je een andere achtergrond binnen datamanagement? Ook dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.


En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris van €5.400,- tot €6.600,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

Zullen we kennismaken?
Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

title: Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights
descriptionHtml:
Worum gehts?

Bei Event Inc wollen wir Entscheidungen konsequent auf Basis von Daten treffen. Das gilt von der Go-to-Market-Strategie bis zur Conversion-Optimierung, in Marketing, Sales und Product. Mit Dir bündeln wir die Analysekompetenz an einer Stelle und schaffen eine gemeinsame Datenbasis, auf die sich alle verlassen können.

Deine Rolle

Als Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights bist Du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Datenanalysen entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Du bist Teil unseres Product Teams und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Data Engineers. Du begleitest Maßnahmen von der ersten Exploration über die Empfehlung bis zur Wirkungsmessung.

  • Performance im Blick: Du überwachst laufend unsere GTM-Performance über Marketing, Sales und Product hinweg, von Funnel-Analysen über Kanal-Performance bis zu Conversion-Raten.
  • Zahlen, die etwas bewegen: Du lieferst Ad-hoc-Analysen für unsere Teams, immer mit konkreten Handlungsempfehlungen statt reinen Reports.
  • Von der Idee bis zur Wirkung: Gemeinsam mit den Teams entwickelst Du Hypothesen und übersetzt sie in Experimente und A/B-Tests. Mit Vorher-/Nachher-Vergleichen misst Du, ob Maßnahmen wirklich wirken.
  • Muster erkennen: Du machst Cohort- und Funnel-Analysen über Kundensegmente und Marketplace-Bereiche hinweg (z. B. Pharma vs. Automotive). Mit Win/Loss-Analysen bei Enterprise-Deals lieferst Du wertvollen Input für unser Sales Enablement.
  • Traffic-Kanäle optimieren: In enger Abstimmung mit Marketing, Sales und Product optimierst Du unsere Traffic-Kanäle, z. B. mit Blick auf SEO/GEO-Performance und Content-Wirkung.
  • Reporting smart automatisieren: Zusammen mit einem Data Engineer baust Du eine KI- und automatisierungsgestützte Reporting-Infrastruktur auf. So fließt Deine Zeit in Analyse und Empfehlung statt in manuelle Datenaufbereitung.
  • Schnittstelle mit Gewicht: Du bist die zentrale Datenquelle für GTM-Entscheidungen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CPO zusammen.

Was uns gefällt

  • Fundierte Basis: Du hast ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung in Data Science, Statistik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, BWL oder einem ähnlichen Bereich erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Erfahrung, die zählt: Du bringst 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Data, Business oder Product Analytics mit. Mit Marketing-, Sales- oder Marketplace-Funnel-Metriken und Tracking kennst Du Dich aus.
  • Analytisches Handwerkszeug: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse und Statistik und weißt, wie man aussagekräftige KPIs entwickelt.
  • Daten in Klartext: Du leitest aus Zahlen konkrete, verständliche Empfehlungen ab und vermittelst sie so, dass jedes Team etwas damit anfangen kann.
  • Struktur, auch wenn's voll wird: Du arbeitest eigenständig und behältst den Überblick, auch wenn mehrere Teams gleichzeitig etwas von Dir brauchen.

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The RoleDo you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting data analysts based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a data analyst. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

title: Data & AI Architect (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen.

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an anspruchsvollen Projekten arbeiten und dich in der gesamten Data & AI-Landschaft in die Richtung weiterentwickeln, die zu dir passt.

Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile
uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum
Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine
Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit.

Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden!

Aufgaben

  • Du sprichst mit Fachbereichen, IT und Management unserer Kunden, strukturierst Anforderungen und leitest daraus ein Zielbild für ihre Daten- und KI-Landschaft ab.

  • Du entwirfst hybride Architekturen, in denen SAP-Daten (SAP BW, SAP Business Data Cloud) und Nicht-SAP-Plattformen wie Microsoft Fabric oder Databricks zusammenspielen. Ziel ist eine gemeinsame Datenbasis ohne doppelte Datenhaltung.

  • Du bewertest Plattformen und Architekturvarianten herstellerunabhängig und bereitest die Entscheidung für den Kunden vor.

  • Du planst Migrationspfade, etwa von SAP BW in die SAP Business Data Cloud, und erarbeitest Architekturleitlinien einschließlich der Kostensicht (FinOps).

  • Du konzipierst Integrationsmuster und die ersten Datenprodukte und validierst sie mit dem Kunden in einem PoC oder MVP.

  • Du modellierst fachliche Semantik: Kennzahlen, Begriffe und ihre Beziehungen. Du legst sie als Semantic Layer oder Ontologie technologieunabhängig ab, sodass SAP- und Nicht-SAP-Plattformen sie gleichermaßen nutzen.

  • Du entwirfst den Context Layer, über den KI-Anwendungen und Agenten verlässlich an Daten und fachlichen Kontext kommen, und legst die Schnittstellen für die Agenten fest.

  • Du prüfst, ob die Datenlandschaft eines Kunden für die geplanten KI-Vorhaben trägt, und zeigst die Lücken auf.

  • Du baust mit uns ein neues Angebot rund um Semantik, Kontext und Agentenarchitektur auf, von der Methodik bis zum ersten Kundenprojekt.

  • Du übergibst Zielbild und Leitlinien an unsere Engineering-CCs und begleitest die Umsetzung als Architekt:in.

  • Du profitierst von Lernformaten, Mentoring und internen Sessions und bringst mit der Zeit eigene Inhalte ein.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast idealerweise erste Erfahrung (ca. 2–3 Jahre) in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Data-&-Analytics-Lösungen.

  • Du kennst dich in SAP-Datenlandschaften aus (SAP BW, SAP Datasphere oder SAP Business Data Cloud) und hast erste Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric oder Databricks. Wenn du von der Nicht-SAP-Seite kommst, bringst du die Bereitschaft mit, dich in SAP einzuarbeiten.

  • Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung (3NF, Data Vault, Star Schema) und Integrationsmustern.

  • Du interessierst dich für KI-Architektur, Semantik und Agenten und verfolgst, was sich dort tut.

  • Von Vorteil: Du hast Erfahrung mit Semantic Layern, Ontologien oder Knowledge Graphs (z. B. RDF/OWL, Neo4j) oder hast KI-Anwendungen an Unternehmensdaten angebunden, etwa über RAG, MCP oder Agenten-Frameworks.

  • Du denkst lieber in Zielbildern und Alternativen als in einem einzigen Werkzeug.

  • Du denkst analytisch, handelst eigenverantwortlich und kommunizierst souverän gegenüber Kolleg:innen und Kunden.

  • Verhandlungssichere (C-Niveau) Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

Deine Perspektive

Dein nächster Schritt ist die Rolle Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Data & AI Architecture, in der du:

  • Architekturvorhaben eigenständig verantwortest,

  • Kunden bei Plattformentscheidungen berätst,

  • und dich im Team als Ansprechperson für Semantik, Kontext und Agentenarchitektur etablieren kannst.

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von allen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.
Da wir die Diversität in unseren Teams weiter stärken möchten, freuen wir uns besonders über Bewerbungen von Frauen.

Benefits

  • Wir stellen standortunabhängig ein. Du arbeitest überwiegend remote – von zuhause oder an einem unserer Standorte, wenn dieser für dich gut erreichbar ist. Für Kundentermine und Teamevents bist du etwa 1–2 Mal im Monat unterwegs, egal wo in Deutschland du wohnst.

  • Über 100 Data & Analytics Consultants zum Austausch sowie eine interne Weiterbildungsacademy

  • Langfristige Projekte mit wechselnden technologischen Herausforderungen

  • Ein festes Budget für Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsperspektiven

  • Eine gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Überstundenausgleich sowie bis zu 40 Tagen Urlaub

  • Sowohl erstklassige Hard- und Softwareausstattung als auch Leasingangebote für Firmenwagen, IT-Hardware und Fahrräder

  • Kurze Wege im Unternehmen, ein fairer Umgang miteinander sowie unterhaltsame Teamevents

Du verfügst über die gewünschten Erfahrungen und suchst eine neue Herausforderung? Du bist flexibel, lösungsorientiert und kommunikationsfähig?

Nutze deine Chance: Wir bieten das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.

title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world's leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is at our core and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is looking for a Data Engineer to build the trusted data foundation behind machine learning across the company.

You’ll partner with data scientists to understand their modeling needs and what the available data can (and can’t) support. You’ll transform large-scale raw data into production-ready datasets and build the scalable pipelines that make them dependable and reusable. Working across Data Science, Data Engineering, and Data Platform, you’ll help address data gaps and bring new machine-learning use cases into production.

If you’re excited to shape how teams across KAYAK use data to build and scale machine learning, we’d love to hear from you.

This role will be required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with the Data Science teams and help translate modeling needs into dataset requirements, then collaborate with Data Engineering and Data Platform to extend foundational pipelines into ML-ready datasets.

  • Design scalable and efficient dataset workflows and ensure pipeline reliability through validation, monitoring, and alerting; diagnose and resolve issues.

  • Ship production-ready data solutions that enable ML applications and deliver real-world impact on user experience and key business metrics.

  • Identify gaps and opportunities, contributing to technical decisions and roadmap priorities that strengthen the data foundation for current and future ML use cases.

  • Collaborate across Data Science, Engineering, and Data Platform, communicating technical decisions, findings, and trade-offs clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences.

Please apply if you have:

  • Strong technical foundations in data engineering, software engineering, and systems design, backed by a track record of building and operating reliable, large-scale data pipelines. Demonstrated capability matters more than academic credentials.

  • Hands-on experience developing production data pipelines, with the ability to clearly explain the problems addressed, your specific contributions, and the resulting impact.

  • Ownership, sound judgment, and systems thinking, with the ability to navigate technical, reliability, cost, and risk trade-offs while working independently and recognizing when to seek guidance.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted workflows, leveraging modern tools to improve productivity and quality while critically evaluating their outputs and limitations.

  • Curiosity, humility, and a collaborative mindset, with a commitment to continuous learning, sharing knowledge, and improving together.

Bonus qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with technologies relevant to KAYAK’s stack, such as Kafka, Flink, Iceberg, Trino, AWS, Kubernetes, Airflow, Python, SQL, and schema-based data contracts.

  • Experience with feature stores or feature pipelines.

  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working, such as sprint planning and team ceremonies.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

     

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

title: Data Engineer- UK
descriptionHtml:
About CoreView   

CoreView is the global leader in Microsoft 365 (M365) tenant resilience, serving over 23 million users worldwide. We empower the world’s leading organizations to master the complexity of Microsoft M365.  Through robust security and precise governance, we help ensure that our client’s environments stay cyber-resilient and productive, no matter how complex they are.  
 
Our unified, cloud-native platform delivers powerful automation, rapid value, and end-to-end visibility across the entire M365 ecosystem. Backed by world-class support and a collaborative, innovative culture, CoreView is a place where your ideas matter, and your work truly impacts global enterprises.  

Job Summary

This role sits in Operations. You'll report to the Data Analyst Manager helping establish our data practice, including documented pipelines, governed metric definitions, and an established way for other departments to ask for data without it becoming ad hoc, bespoke work every time. In addition, CoreView is improving how we understand product telemetry, platform product usage, licence utilisation and adoption trends.  You will work across business functions and take ownership of CoreView's customer usage and adoption analytics and turn them into a production-grade, reliable system, then help scope and build the next set of metrics and signals on top of them. You'll work primarily in Databricks (Unity Catalog, Spark Declarative Pipelines), using SQL and Python day to day, and you'll be expected to use AI-assisted development (Cursor, Claude, or equivalent) as a normal part of how you work.

Job Responsibilities

  • Take operational ownership of the usage and adoption pipelines and their alerting
  • Reconcile figures derived from our product-usage tool
  • Separate development and production environments and mature CI/CD so deployment is repeatable and rollback is reliable.
  • Build and maintain Bronze-to-Gold pipelines in Databricks, Unity Catalog metric views, and the permissions/row-level-security model behind them.
  • Extend automated data quality checks across the underlying gold-layer tables and validate outputs against existing Power BI reports.
  • Co-own the scoping of the next set of usage and adoption signals with Product and Post-Sales: prioritising upsell signals and the ROI narrative and confirming what needs new instrumentation.
  • Handle the realities of business system data: schema drift, inconsistent field naming, soft deletes, incremental loads 
  • Lead and be responsible for the consolidation of additional data sources — including support tickets, audit logs, CRM, and other customer-facing systems — while defining the feasibility, effort, cost, and implementation approach required to support a future unified data platform.
  • Establish documented pipelines, an access model for raw and transformed data, and a working intake process for cross-department data requests.
  • Act as a credible point of contact for CoreView's Databricks estate
  • Bring automation and AI-assisted tooling into the day-to-day work — for example automated monitoring and anomaly detection on metric movements — as the platform matures.

Job Requirements

  • 3 to 5 years' professional experience building and operating production data pipelines (ETL/ELT) in a commercial setting.
  • Hands-on Databricks proficiency: Unity Catalog, Spark Declarative Pipelines and metric views, including the permissions / row-level-security model behind them.
  • Strong SQL and Python applied to data engineering work — building, testing and supporting pipeline code through to production.
  • Experience with data transformation/orchestration tooling such as Spark Declarative Pipelines, dbt, or an equivalent.
  • Solid grounding in data modelling (dimensional/star-schema approaches) for analytics consumption.
  • Git-based version control and CI/CD practices applied to data pipelines, not just application code.
  • Experience ingesting data from a range of source systems — CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), product usage and telemetry (CoreView's own platform, UserPilot, or equivalents such as Pendo, Amplitude or Mixpanel), and other business systems.
  • Comfortable operating with limited hand-holding: implementing, documenting and running to an agreed direction rather than waiting for detailed instruction.
  • Clear written and verbal communication: you'll be the named contact for commercial teams asking questions about the numbers.

Preferred skills:

  • Power BI or an equivalent BI tool, including validating a migrated report against a legacy one.
  • Prior experience implementing data governance, a metric catalogue, or an access model from a low base of maturity.
  • Background in B2B SaaS.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) as part of a production engineering workflow.

Coreview Values

Ownership Mindset:Take ownership. Drive outcomes. 

One Team: One team, one goal, embracing diversity - to achieve more together. 

Velocity: Decide fast. Deliver fast. Repeat.

Continuous Improvement: Curiosity drives us. We challenge the status quo.

Customer First: Listen deeply. Solve boldly.  

Resilience: Steady under pressure.

CoreView is an organisation which values the strength that diversity brings to the workplace. As an employer, we seek to promote equal opportunity through affirmative action. All qualified applicants will therefore receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on gender/sex, race/ethnicity, disability, age or any other protected group status (such as protected veteran status) or characteristic that is protected by local legislation.

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

  • Investigate detection performance deeply: dig into missed cases, alert quality, and pattern drift, and turn what you find into concrete tuning or configuration changes.

  • Translate technical findings into customer-facing insight: build the analysis that shows investigator productivity gains, false positive cost reduction, and detection effectiveness improvements in language a customer's compliance and risk leadership actually uses.

  • Sit in the room with customers directly. Present findings, defend your methodology to a customer's own data science or compliance team, and answer the hard “why did the model do this” questions live.

  • Partner closely with your regional Customer Value Partners on account strategy, informing where the model needs to change to unlock the next stage of value realization or a renewal conversation.

  • Feed patterns and findings back into Hawk's broader model and product functions, distinguishing between “this customer needs local tuning” and “this is a systemic gap worth fixing centrally.”

  • Own the regulatory defensibility of the tuning decisions you make. Document your reasoning so a customer's audit or regulator review holds up.

  • Bring rigor to how you validate model changes before they go live: backtesting, sample review, and sign-off discipline that protects the customer's compliance posture.

Your Profile

  • 5-7 years as a data scientist in a customer-facing role, presenting analysis and defending model decisions directly to clients. This is not an internal-facing engineering or product data science background; you've sat across the table from a customer before.

  • Real experience in AML, fraud detection, or financial crime analytics is required. You understand transaction monitoring, typologies, and what a false positive actually costs an investigator, not just what one costs on a confusion matrix.

  • Strong hands-on skills in the standard data science stack (Python, SQL, and whatever ML tooling you've used in production), but your edge is judgment under ambiguity: knowing when a model change is safe to make and when it needs a human in the loop.

  • Comfortable being the technical voice in a room with a customer's risk, compliance, or data science stakeholders, and holding your own when questioned.

  • A track record of translating model performance into business value a non-technical stakeholder can act on: not just accuracy metrics, but investigator hours saved, false positive cost avoided, and cases caught.

  • Genuine comfort with ambiguity and live production systems. You're not looking for a clean offline research problem, you're looking for the “why did this alert fire on a real customer's data at 2pm today” problem.

  • An ownership mentality. You don't wait for a ticket; you notice when an account's detection performance is drifting and you go find out why.

Bonus

  • Experience specifically in transaction monitoring or payments fraud detection at a bank, payment provider, or a vendor serving them.

  • Familiarity with explainable AI and rules-based hybrid detection approaches, since that's core to how Hawk's models work.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The RoleDo you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting DevOps engineers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a DevOps engineer. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

What you’ll bring

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud supports strategic business outcomes including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work.

About The Role

We are looking for a Director of Customer Experience and Engagement to build and lead the organization responsible for helping Nscale customers realize meaningful value from our platform.

You will own the strategy, operating model, and execution of our customer experience function. This role will be pivotal in working with our customers across the AI lifecycle—from initial requirements gathering to contractual acceptance, onboarding and workload migration through production adoption, optimization, and expansion.

This role sits at the intersection of customers, engineering, product, sales, and infrastructure. You will be accountable for ensuring customers can successfully build and operate AI workloads on Nscale while receiving clear, proactive, and technically credible guidance throughout the relationship.

The right leader will combine strong customer judgment with technical depth and operational rigor. You should be comfortable getting into the technical details enough so that you understand where customers are blocked, influencing product priorities, and advising executives on retention, risk, adoption, and account health.

This is a highly visible leadership role with the opportunity to define what world-class customer experience looks like for the fastest growing Neocloud platform in the world.

  • Define and Develop Nscale’s initial customer engagement strategy from requirements to PoC execution and signoff
  • Define and own Nscale’s customer experience strategy across onboarding, implementation, adoption, technical success, support coordination, retention, and expansion.

  • Establish account-health frameworks that combine product usage, platform reliability, workload performance, customer sentiment, support activity, and commercial risk.

  • Create clear escalation and incident-management processes that provide customers with fast response times, strong ownership, seamless internal coordination, and proactive communication.

DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab’s business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. title: Director, International Tax
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Director, International Tax 

We are looking for an Director, International Tax to build and own the international tax function at Quince. This is the first dedicated tax hire in the company, and it arrives at the moment we need it most: Quince is entering Europe, Mexico, Australia, and numerous other countries on an aggressive timeline, and every one of those markets brings tax questions we do not currently have an in-house answer to.

Entity structure. Permanent establishment. VAT and GST registration. Withholding tax. Transfer pricing. Customs and import duty treatment. Local filing obligations we may not know exist until we have already tripped over them. The International Tax Director is the person who knows where those blind spots are before we walk into them, and who tells us what we need to do about them while it is still a decision rather than a problem.

The role reports directly to the VP of Accounting and functions as their right hand on anything tax — the person who can answer any tax question, or knows exactly how to go get the answer. This role is also the first call for the Head of International on any tax question tied to a new market, and a close partner to Legal, People Ops, and Supply Chain as the international footprint is built.

Responsibilities

  •     Serve as the tax lead on every new-market launch — assess the tax profile of a market before we enter, flag what will and won't work, and define the registrations, filings, and structural decisions required to operate compliantly from day one.
  •     Build and maintain a market-entry tax playbook and a global filing calendar, so the tenth country launch is materially faster and cleaner than the first.
  •     Advise on legal entity structure and the tax consequences of each option — branch vs. subsidiary, holding structure, where IP and inventory sit, and how intercompany flows are designed — partnering with Legal on entity timing and sequencing.
  •     Identify and manage permanent establishment risk created by employees, contractors, EOR arrangements, warehouses, third-party logistics providers, and local agents, including the tax implications of transitioning employees from EOR to local entity.
  •     Own transfer pricing end to end: intercompany agreements, pricing methodology, master file and local file documentation, country-by-country reporting where applicable, and defense of the position under audit.
  •     Own indirect tax globally — EU VAT (including OSS/IOSS, distance-selling rules, import VAT, and reverse charge), UK VAT, Mexican IVA, Australian GST and low-value imported goods rules, and the considerably more complex South American regimes — covering registration, filing, recoverability, and the operational setup behind each.

Qualifications

  •     Deep international tax capability is essential given the scope of this role — cross-border structuring, transfer pricing, treaty analysis, permanent establishment, and indirect tax across multiple regimes.
  •     Working knowledge of US federal and state taxation, including ASC 740, is a plus rather than a requirement. Our US provision and returns are prepared by an external firm; what we need is someone who can manage that firm credibly, review its work, and recognize when an answer doesn't hold up.
  •     Genuine indirect tax depth, or a demonstrated ability to research an unfamiliar country's VAT/GST regime from scratch and return with a defensible, documented answer. Knowing how to find the right answer in a new jurisdiction matters more here than having memorized any one of them.
  •     Demonstrated ability to stand up tax infrastructure where none exists, and to apply rigorous technical judgment to ambiguous, fast-moving, and incompletely specified situations.
  •     Comfortable being the only tax person in the company. This role will not be hiring a team for at least 12–18 months, and in the meantime you are both the strategist and the person doing the work.
  •     Proactive risk identifier. The most valuable thing you will do in this role is raise the issue nobody else knew to ask about.
  •     Skilled at translating complex technical tax positions into clear business language that non-tax partners can act on with confidence.
  •     Collaborative partner with a positive, solutions-oriented mindset; able to build trust quickly with Accounting, Legal, People Ops, Supply Chain, and the International team.
  •     Agile and adaptable; comfortable building and evolving processes as the international footprint matures, without being constrained by legacy approaches.
  •     Entrepreneurial mindset; equally comfortable setting global tax strategy and rolling up their sleeves to file a return.
  •     Proactive problem-solver and self-starter; energized by ambiguity and motivated to find the right answer even when no playbook exists.

Preferred:

  •     Substantial international tax experience specifically — this is the center of the role, not an adjacent skill.
  •     Demonstrated experience supporting a company through multi-country international expansion, including entity setup, indirect tax registration, and cross-border structuring.
  •     Experience supporting direct-to-consumer, retail, e-commerce, or another goods-based business with a physical supply chain strongly preferred, including exposure to customs and import duty matters.
  •     Experience selecting and managing external tax advisors across multiple jurisdictions.
  •     Practical experience with tax engines (Avalara, Vertex, or similar) and ERP tax configuration preferred.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Director, Partnerships & Enterprise International Growth
descriptionHtml:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. 

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Partnerships & B2B International to lead our Health commercial expansion strategy for Oura into global markets. This role requires a strategic thinker with hands-on experience in market entry, localization, and scaling revenue across diverse geographies. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of partnerships and enterprise growth experience along with a track record of driving growth for health tech products in new markets.

The ideal candidate has both a deep health industry experience and leadership experience in establishing new partnerships and growing accounts/markets over time. Given Oura’s more recent international expansion, no job is too big or too small. Scaling global and local Health partners in UK, European, MENA and APAC markets  is an essential frontier for Oura's future strategy. 

The Director of Partnerships & B2Bwill scale and lead our go-to-market efforts across the international health landscape. This leader will hold revenue and partnership responsibility for our ecosystem of international health partnerships including B2B partner programs and custom strategic partnerships and will drive commercialization across key DTC and B2B channels health’s point solutions, health plans, employers, insurers, brokers, health institutions and health systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of product, partnerships, marketing, and sales. The ideal candidate brings a track record of international commercial leadership in healthcare or digital health, deep understanding of the international health landscape across different markets of UK, Europe, MENA, APAC, and a passion for building solutions that meet the unique needs of customers across all markets and stages of life.

What you will do

Consumer & Enterprise Business Development

  • Lead end-to-end business development of health partnerships, from identifying strategic consumer health platforms and emerging digital brands to negotiating and closing enterprise agreements with health systems, insurers, medical institutions, and employers 
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline of long-term prospects across different health categories including cardiohealth, metabolic health, women’s health, wellness, mental health, and chronic condition management 
  • Represent the brand in high-level partner engagements, acting as a subject matter expert on digital health, general health and insurance models 

Partner Program Development & Management

  • Build and scale a partner program infrastructure that allows for onboarding and managing health partners with consistent processes, tiering, and program benefits 
  • Design and lead customized, strategic partnerships for larger and more complex partners (health systems, multinational employers, insurers, consumer platforms), ensuring tailored solutions that drive measurable business and health outcomes 
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with strategic partners, with the ability to serve 10-20 simultaneous accounts with varying needs.
  • Establish partner enablement tools, resources, and communications to ensure partner success and scalable growth 

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Clinical, Regulatory affairs, Legal, Operations) to design, launch, and optimize partnership integrations and programs. Ensure alignment of goals, accountability, and execution across scaled programs and complex deals  

Performance, Optimization & Insights

  • Define, track, and optimize success metrics for both scaled partner programs and bespoke enterprise deals; identify and address challenges in internal processes that may slow innovation in partnerships 
  • Champion a culture of experimentation by testing new partnership models, incentive structures, and go-to-market approaches for health programs

Strategic Communication & Reporting

  • Leverage user research, behavioral data, and partner feedback to guide health partnership strategy 
  • Regularly communicate partnership program performance, enterprise deal progress, and overall health market traction to executive leadership 

We would love to have you on our team if you have: 

  • 15+ years in outbound enterprise or corporate sales and business development, with a track record of growing accounts from first deal to major enterprise customer and representing a brand in executive-level commercial conversations.
  • Deep knowledge of the consumer health landscape (apps, digital health, retail wellness) and enterprise stakeholders (insurers, employers, health systems, providers), ideally across international markets.
  • Experience designing and scaling structured partner programs alongside bespoke, high-value enterprise deals — balancing repeatable growth with the customisation complex partners require.
  • Experience using performance, partner adoption, and consumer engagement data to build partnership models that expand reach, engagement, and retention.
  • A cross-functional operator who aligns product, clinical, operations, and marketing to deliver measurable health and business outcomes.
  • An entrepreneurial, commercially minded builder: sharp written and verbal communicator, comfortable bringing clarity to ambiguity in a fast-paced environment, and relentless about the quality and measurability of your work.

Considered a strong asset: additional language skills, an established network in your market, and willingness to travel up to 50%.

title: Director Space Business
descriptionHtml:
Destinus is seeking a Director, Space Business to establish and grow its space business, with military satellite communications (Satcom) as the initial priority. The role covers the complete communications system, including the space segment, user terminals, ground infrastructure and integration with tactical networks.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director will lead business development and programme delivery, supported by programme managers and a Technical Lead with communications systems expertise. The Director must have enough technical depth to challenge proposals and lead informed decisions.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop the business. Define the Satcom business plan, customer priorities, investment needs and Destinus' role in the industrial partnership. Align proposals with technical feasibility, funding and delivery capacity.
  • Secure customers and programmes. Build relationships with defence customers, space agencies and industrial partners. Lead proposals, commercial negotiations and funding opportunities in coordination with the group commercial team.
  • Deliver agreed programmes. Own programme budgets, milestones and customer commitments. Lead programme managers and coordinate engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing and entry into service.
  • Build the required team. Recruit business and programme staff within approved plans. Define engineering capability needs with the CTO and establish clear responsibilities for internal teams and external partners.
  • Manage industrial partnerships. Select and manage partners and suppliers with the relevant functions. Establish workshare, interfaces and delivery commitments across the complete Satcom system.
  • Develop future opportunities. Assess early warning and interceptor opportunities through customer engagement, partnerships and funding proposals. Present staged investment recommendations before committing development resources.
  • Maintain delivery discipline. Track costs, risks and progress. Resolve issues within the agreed mandate and escalate material changes to scope, investment or portfolio priorities.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Substantial experience in space, aerospace or defence, typically 12+ years, including at least five years leading complex programmes, multidisciplinary teams or a business.
  • A proven record of delivering satellite communications programmes or substantial parts of an integrated Satcom system, with direct responsibility for budgets, schedules and customer commitments.
  • Business development experience with government or defence customers, including shaping requirements, preparing proposals and negotiating contracts or programme funding.
  • An engineering degree or equivalent technical background, with a system-level understanding of satellites, communications payloads, user terminals and the ground segment.
  • Understanding of protected waveforms, anti-jam capabilities and secure tactical datalinks sufficient to assess requirements, risks and integration needs with technical specialists.
  • Experience leading programme managers and coordinating engineering teams in a matrix organisation, with clear resource commitments and accountability for delivery.
  • The ability to build teams, manage industrial partners and make commercial decisions that reflect technical maturity, available resources and funding.
  • The ability to work independently, present clear recommendations to the CEO and execute within an agreed mandate. Fluent English and willingness to travel regularly.

German language skills as well as experience with German defense customers and space programmes are advantages. We value programme delivery and commercial judgement, especially in the context of establishing a new business line or taking a programme from concept to funding and delivery. Deep expertise across all space applications is not required.

title: Dispenser
descriptionHtml:
About Bolt Pharmacy and AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.

Key responsibilities

  • Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

  • Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

  • Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

  • Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

  • Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

  • Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates.

Need to have

  • Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification.

  • Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety.

  • Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation.

  • Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist.

  • Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

Nice to have

  • Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser.

  • Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely.

  • Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly.

  • Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied.

  • Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism.

  • Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

  • Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

  • GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

  • Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

  • What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.
