title: Doctorant : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”
descriptionHtml:
Contexte :

ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe.

ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”

Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables.

La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Les méthodes théoriques innovantes d'INJECT seront testées en profondeur à l'aide de modèles numériques de haute fidélité qui tiendront compte de la dynamique poro-élasto, du frottement de Coulomb, de la multiphysique et de la modélisation d'ordre réduit. Le plan expérimental s'appuiera sur des démonstrateurs et des essais hybrides laboratoire-ordinateur pour tester la théorie. Pour plus d'informations : https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771 ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire.

En tant que chercheur doctorant, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la construction de démonstrateurs innovants adaptés à la méthodologie d'INJECT. Cette opportunité englobe l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement, c'est-à-dire de la conceptualisation des idées à l'assemblage et au test rigoureux de prototypes de laboratoire avancés pour des expériences géomécaniques. Vous intégrerez la conception mécanique, l'ingénierie des matériaux, la mise en œuvre des capteurs et des contrôleurs, l'analyse des données et la modélisation numérique. L'objectif ultime est de reproduire et de contrôler les instabilités sismiques causées par des injections de fluides dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, ouvrant ainsi la voie à des applications dans le monde réel.

Missions / Activité annexe :

· Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues.

· Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs

· Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : CDD de 3 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : dès que possible

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) mais également par les transports en commun

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 18 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, centre de loisirs pour les enfants du personnel à partir de 6 ans avec tarifs préférentiels (campus Paris-Saclay)

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

Candidature complète : curriculum vitae, lettre de motivation et coordonnées de 2 professeurs de référence


Les candidats retenus doivent posséder de solides compétences scientifiques et être très motivés. La maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit est obligatoire.

Les candidats effectueront des recherches, développeront des dispositifs et des outils expérimentaux et rédigeront des articles scientifiques en étroite collaboration avec le PI du projet, Pr. Ioannis Stefanou, et les membres du groupe INJECT.

Connaissances :

· Une expérience dans le domaine des essais expérimentaux et de la conception (par exemple en géotechnique/géophysique/géomécanique) ou un diplôme de fin d'études dans ce domaine.

· Intérêt pour la modélisation numérique, la conception mécanique et l'électronique.

· Sens de l'organisation et rigueur.

· Utilisation de logiciels de design industriel.

· Compétences en Python.

· Expérience en laboratoire et esprit d'équipe.

. Connaissances en physique/mathématiques/mécanique

title: Electrical Distribution Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems.

  • Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments.

  • Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies.

  • Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

  • Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data.

  • Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings.

  • Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science or equivalent

  • You have a strong background in electrical engineering, control systems, or a related field, with hands-on experience in industrial environments

  • You are adaptable and motivated to grow with evolving technologies and increasing system complexity

  • Experience in grid integration, or electrical infrastructure for industrial, utility-scale, or energy-related facilities is a plus

  • Knowledge of reactive power compensation is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: EMEA Statutory Reporting Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

Applied Intuition is scaling quickly across entities and geographies, and statutory reporting, clean audits, and compliant local filings are essential. In this London-based role, you will be the accountable owner of statutory reporting, audit, and compliance for our EMEA entities, including the UK, Germany, Sweden, and Saudi Arabia, with more to come.

Reporting to the Director of Accounting, you will lead the EMEA local close and statutory audits, own the filing calendar, oversee the US GAAP to local GAAP conversion work produced by our India-based outsourced accounting team, and partner with Tax, Legal, and Business Technology to automate statutory and compliance processes in NetSuite. This is a hands-on opportunity to build a best-in-class statutory and compliance function across EMEA for a high-growth company.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own the preparation, review, and sign-off of statutory financial statements for our EMEA entities under local GAAP (UK GAAP/FRS 102, German HGB, Swedish K2/K3, and IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia), including the US GAAP to local GAAP conversion and bridge work papers.

  • Lead each statutory audit end to end with our external auditors, from planning and PBC lists through audit queries, adjustments, and management representation letters, closing audits on schedule.

  • Run the EMEA month-end on the US close calendar: review and sign off statutory balance sheet reconciliations, drive aged reconciling items to zero, and maintain local GAAP schedules such as leases and accrued vacation.

  • Own the EMEA statutory and compliance filing calendar, covering VAT, corporate income tax and zakat (with Tax and external advisers), company registry filings, and annual accounts, so every filing goes in on time with no notices from authorities.

  • Manage the quality and performance of our India-based outsourced accounting team and of in-country auditors, tax advisers, and accounting providers, and turn statutory and conversion workpapers into standard templates the team can run with minimal rework.

  • Partner with Business Technology to automate statutory reporting, VAT, and e-invoicing in NetSuite, design and document the related controls, and bring new entities and regulatory changes (for example, FRS 102 amendments and German and Saudi e-invoicing mandates) into the process ahead of effective dates.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or CPA) with 14+ years of relevant accounting experience

  • Proven ownership of multi-entity UK statutory reporting under UK GAAP (FRS 102) and the Companies Act 2006, including leading statutory audits end to end

  • Experience converting US GAAP to local GAAP and reviewing GAAP bridge workpapers (for example, leases and accrued vacation)

  • Experience managing outsourced or offshore accounting teams, including setting quality standards and reviewing output across time zones

  • Proficiency with NetSuite, ideally in a multi-subsidiary environment

  • Sound judgment on materiality and filing risk, and clear communication with auditors, advisers, and partners across EMEA, the US, and India

Nice to have:

  • Big 4 or top-tier public accounting background, and in-house experience at a software/technology multinational

  • Hands-on German GAAP (HGB) and GmbH statutory experience

  • Exposure to Swedish (K2/K3) or Saudi (IFRS, zakat, ZATCA e-invoicing) statutory reporting, or other EMEA local GAAPs and languages

  • Working knowledge of VAT, Making Tax Digital, and e-invoicing requirements across EMEA

  • Experience designing internal controls (SOX or audit readiness) and testing finance system automation, including applying AI tools to accounting workflows

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

title: Engineering Manager - Cx App Foundations
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Cx App Foundations is a platform organisation within our global Cx organisation. It provides shared consumer foundations and platform capabilities used by engineering teams across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo. Within this organisation, the Velocity team owns the paved road for consumer app development across mobile and web: shared SDKs and client foundations, integration patterns and multi-brand customisation, migration playbooks and reference implementations, and developer tooling that makes building on shared foundations fast and safe. Our mission is to reduce the cost, time, and risk of building consumer experiences across platforms and brands. Product teams own customer-facing experiences; our job is to make sure they can spend their time on delivering delightful experiences. The team is AI-native: AI is a default part of how we design, build, and ship software.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of experienced engineers across mobile and web, collaborating closely with product teams, design, and adjacent platform organisations across three brands. Your primary responsibility will be owning the team's roadmap and delivery of shared client foundations, and driving their adoption across the organisation, so that product teams ship delightful customer experiences without rebuilding the foundations under them. You will be a key player in keeping the team's operating model healthy: clear intake from stakeholders, predictable delivery, and support expectations that keep the platform from drifting into a general escalation queue. You will also guide architectural and system design decisions with your tech leads. You will stay hands-on: contributing code, reviews, and prototypes alongside the team is part of the job. This role is ideal for a leader who has run platforms, SDKs, or shared services for other engineering teams, communicates clearly across brands and time zones, and wants their impact measured through what other teams achieve with the foundations you ship.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own the platform roadmap - the shared SDKs, client foundations, and developer tooling the team ships - and sequence it against the migration and adoption goals of the three brands
  • Drive adoption of the shared foundations by partnering with product teams, running onboarding and rollout support, and making the supported path the easiest path

descriptionHtml:
Hybrid, based in our London, Bath or Edinburgh office. We are flexible but would like you to be in the office at least once per week.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead one of our product engineering squads, reporting to an engineering director. As Seccl grows and our platform supports more customer firms and investors, you’ll help your squad deliver the scalable platform capability we need for what comes next.

You’ll build a strong, psychologically safe engineering team where people feel trusted, supported and able to do their best work. You’ll coach and develop engineers, create clarity and help the team maintain high standards while delivering valuable outcomes.

Working closely with your product manager, engineering leaders and teams across Seccl, you’ll help define priorities and keep the squad focused on the right outcomes. You’ll balance delivery pace with engineering quality, security, operational resilience and long-term maintainability.

This role brings together people leadership, delivery and engineering accountability. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to guide and challenge decisions, while giving engineers the ownership and support they need to develop effective solutions.

What you’ll own

  • Building, leading and developing an inclusive, high-performing engineering squad

  • Creating an environment of trust, psychological safety, continual learning and constructive challenge

  • Owning the delivery health of your squad, from priorities and planning through to production readiness, reliability and ongoing maintainability

  • Partnering with product managers to align the squad’s work with customer, commercial, regulatory and platform priorities

  • Guiding technical decisions and helping the team build solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient and well integrated with the wider platform

  • Using metrics, feedback and team insight to improve delivery predictability, system reliability and team effectiveness

  • Recruiting and onboarding engineers while contributing to shared engineering practices and collaboration across Seccl

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re an experienced engineering manager who has led teams working within complex product or technology domains

  • You have a strong track record of hiring, onboarding, coaching and developing engineers

  • You can balance people leadership with delivery accountability and remain close enough to the technology to offer meaningful guidance

  • You have experience with a modern JavaScript and cloud-based technology stack. Our stack includes Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, MongoDB, AWS, Lambda and Serverless Framework

  • You communicate clearly and can work effectively with product managers, engineering leaders and senior stakeholders

  • You have recent, practical experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and can help teams use them responsibly to improve delivery, quality and developer effectiveness

  • You care about building secure, scalable and resilient systems. Experience in financial services, fintech, investment platforms or another regulated environment would be valuable

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re looking for a purely people-management role. You’ll need enough technical credibility to guide decisions and challenge constructively

  • You want to be the primary technical decision-maker. You’ll create the environment for engineers to own solutions and grow their capability

  • You need priorities to remain fixed. You’ll be leading delivery in a fast-moving environment where plans and business needs can change

  • You prioritise speed at the expense of quality. Delivery pace matters, alongside security, resilience and long-term maintainability

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 £95,000 to £110,000 depending on experience, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

title: Engineering Manager, Operations Technology (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
About the role: What's in the Box

The Logistics Tribe builds the systems powering end-to-end delivery across North America, Europe and Australia/New Zealand: getting fresh ingredients into our facilities, giving customers the best delivery options the network can support, and tracking every box to the customer's door. Today it is a single engineering team - two staff engineers, a data engineer and seven mid-to-senior engineers - led by the Director of Engineering, owning that software and keeping it running in production. You will join as an Engineering Manager and take line management of the seven.

The work is operations-heavy and business-critical, spread across different subdomains. You won't own a fixed backlog in one corner of the domain; the team's scope follows where the business pressure is. That is reflected in how we work: rather than one fixed squad, the team organises into small, project-focused pods that form and dissolve as projects start and finish. In a typical sprint, your engineers might be spread across three projects with three different product managers.

Strategy and technical direction are things we shape together - staff engineers, product managers and you all contributing, nobody working from a script handed down. You own the people and the delivery of your engineers.

The role reports to the Director of Engineering for Logistics Tech; your team is spread across two geographies.

What you'll do: The Recipe

  • Lead and grow a team of mid-to-senior engineers: set clear expectations, give regular and honest feedback, and own their development - including building the case when someone is ready for the next level.
  • Own the people and stay technical. This role carries real hands-on expectations - you still deliver code yourself, not management at a distance.
  • Keep raising the team's AI bar: role-model it in your own work, and push the workflows where AI genuinely changes how fast we deliver.
  • Make our project-based way of working work for people. You lead project staffing with the Director of Engineering and the product managers, putting engineers where the work and their growth both fit. You limit how many projects anyone carries, and you keep handovers clean so nobody becomes a single point of failure.
  • Own the delivery health of your team's work together with the product managers and the engineers leading each project: realistic plans, sound quality, and systems that stay reliable once shipped.
  • Hire and onboard well - you'll be building the team's balance of skills as projects and domains shift under you.
  • Champion the engineering practices we care about: behaviour-driven tests for every business use case, and small iterations.
  • Help shape tribe culture as part of the leadership team, in a setup that is deliberately flat and collaborative.

What you'll bring: The Ingredients

  • At least 2 years leading mid-to-senior engineers in an agile environment, backed by 6+ years of total engineering experience - you've run development and growth conversations and seen people through to promotion.
  • Comfort leading people through changing project boundaries - this is a team that reforms around projects, not one that sits still.
  • A backend-leaning technical grounding - event-driven microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, relational databases, CI/CD - with real BDD/TDD habits that make large refactorings safe. You don't need to be the deepest engineer in the room, but you need to earn the team's respect.
  • Daily, practical experience building with AI tooling: you've shipped real work with it, you know where it fails, and you learn as readily from others as they learn from you.
  • A product-oriented mindset: you can reason about the business problem, prioritise for customer impact, and push back on low-value scope.
  • Genuine interest in physical-world and supply-chain problems. You want to understand how the operation actually works; logistics or carrier integration experience is a plus.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Erfahrener SAP Personalberater / Headhunter - Schwerpunkt Kandidatengewinnung
descriptionHtml:
Die besten SAP-Spezialisten der Schweiz suchen keinen Job, sie wollen angesprochen werden. Für das «Who is Who» der Schweizer Wirtschaft finden, überzeugen und begleiten wir genau diese Menschen. VANGARD ist eine auf SAP spezialisierte Headhunting-Boutique mit dem Anspruch: Headhunting. Nicht Recruiting.

Warum VANGARD, gerade jetzt

Der Markt für Personaldienstleister ist unter Druck, viele Agenturen kämpfen. Wir stehen auf einem soliden Fundament: Seit 2012 sind wir im Schweizer SAP-Markt aktiv, haben bei über 400 SAP-Arbeitgebern platziert und sind in der SAP-Community bestens etabliert. Jährlich veröffentlichen wir das White Paper «SAP-Arbeitsmarkt Schweiz», mit Interviews von Branchenführern aus SAP-Beratung und Inhouse-Organisationen. Und dank unseres eigenen CRM-Systems vermessen und mappen wir den Schweizer SAP-Markt systematisch, wie kaum jemand sonst.

Für dich heisst das: Du musst nicht jeden Monat bei null anfangen.

Deine Rolle

Du spürst Top-SAP-Spezialisten auf, für die sonst niemand einen Zugang findet. Du gewinnst ihr Vertrauen, verstehst ihre Ziele und begleitest sie bis zur Vertragsunterschrift und darüber hinaus. Unser Kandidatenpool mit tausenden Profilen, unsere gewachsenen Beziehungen und unser erprobtes Headhunting-Konzept geben dir vom ersten Tag an Rückenwind.

Deine Aufgaben

Kandidatengewinnung

  • Systematisches Mapping des SAP-Markts: Wer arbeitet wo, in welchem Modul, mit welchem Erfahrungsprofil?

  • Gezielte Direktansprache passiver SAP-Spezialisten über Telefon, Netzwerk, Empfehlungen und LinkedIn

  • Aufspüren von Talenten, die auf keiner Jobbörse und oft nicht einmal auf LinkedIn sichtbar sind

  • Kontinuierliche Pflege und Reaktivierung unseres Kandidatenpools

  • Aufbau eines eigenen Netzwerks in der Schweizer SAP-Community, mit Empfehlungen als festem Bestandteil deiner Arbeit

Qualifizierung und Präsentation

  • Fundierte Interviews zur fachlichen und persönlichen Qualifizierung, von Modulwissen und Projekterfahrung bis zu Karrieremotivation und Wechselbereitschaft

  • Ehrliche Einschätzung, welche Position wirklich passt, statt Kandidaten in die erstbeste Stelle zu schieben

Betreuung durch den gesamten Prozess

  • Persönliche Begleitung jedes Kandidaten als feste Ansprechperson, vom ersten Gespräch bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

  • Individuelle Interviewvorbereitung, Gehaltsbenchmarks und ehrliches Feedback nach jedem Gespräch

  • Begleitung durch Debriefings, Gehalts- und Vertragsverhandlungen

  • Souveräner Umgang mit Gegenangeboten, Zweifeln und kritischen Momenten im Entscheidungsprozess

  • Nachbetreuung nach dem Start, damit Platzierungen langfristig tragen und aus Kandidaten Botschafter werden

Zusammenarbeit mit den Key Account Managern

  • Projektarbeit in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Key Account Managern

  • Bei Eignung Einbindung in die Kundengewinnung und -betreuung, etwa durch Teilnahme an Briefings und Kundenterminen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der SAP- oder IT-Personalberatung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Direktansprache

  • Einen nachweisbaren Track-Record im Gewinnen und Platzieren von Spezialisten, die nicht aktiv suchen

  • Gutes Verständnis der SAP-Welt: Du weisst, was einen FI/CO-Berater von einem EWM-Spezialisten unterscheidet

  • Die richtige Mischung aus Ausstrahlung und Hartnäckigkeit, am Telefon wie im persönlichen Gespräch

  • Eine Art, die Menschen öffnet: Kandidaten rufen dich zurück, weil sie gerne mit dir sprechen, und hören dir auch nach dem dritten Nein noch zu

  • Humor, Drive und die Gelassenheit, auch in hektischen Phasen den richtigen Ton zu treffen

  • Stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ein stabiles Umfeld in einer gefragten Nische, mit gefülltem Pool und etablierten Beziehungen statt Kaltstart

  • Erfahrene Mentoren mit über 10 Jahren SAP-Headhunting-Erfahrung, die dich mit viel Engagement, Know-how und Freude an deinem Erfolg unterstützen

  • Ein solides Fixum und ein variabler Anteil, der deutlich über dem der grossen Personaldienstleister liegt: Bei gleichem Erfolg verdienst du bei uns unter dem Strich mehr

  • Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Teamspirit

  • Ein super modernes Office in Zürich-Greencity mit neuester IT

Was du sonst noch wissen solltest

Bei uns ist jeder Tag anders, die Pace ist hoch, und Kandidaten wie Unternehmen erwarten eine Beratung auf höchstem Niveau. Dafür brauchst du Fokus, Engagement und Freude an Menschen. Unser Antrieb: SAP-Spezialisten in die Rolle zu bringen, in der sie wirklich wachsen, und dabei selbst jeden Tag besser zu werden.

Auf deine Kontaktaufnahme freuen wir uns.

title: Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.

Job Summary

As SiTime’s Field Marketing Manager for EMEA, you are the regional marketing lead responsible for translating global campaigns and product launches into programs that build awareness, engagement, and qualified pipeline. Reporting to the Director, Growth Marketing and partnering with EMEA sales leadership, you are the voice of the region within corporate marketing; bringing local market intelligence, sales insights & priorities, and program performance data to inform marketing investments & programs across EMEA.

This is SiTime's first dedicated field marketing hire in EMEA, so you will help build the regional playbook, leveraging global campaigns and programs while bringing regional insight and recommendations back to the corporate team. You will establish an operating rhythm with sales, activate distribution and rep partners, and ensure global programs land effectively in local markets.

 Qualification and Requirements:

  • Demonstrated success building and executing regional marketing plans that generate qualified pipeline against the objectives of a named sales territory.
  • Working knowledge of EMEA country and regional dynamics; differences in buying behavior, design activity, media landscape, language, and business culture across Germany, the UK, France, the Nordics, Italy, Israel, and emerging markets in the region.
  • Ability to localize global campaigns and messaging for regional relevance — adapting content, channels, and offers to how the region actually buys, rather than translating them.
  • Proven experience owning regional events end to end: trade shows, seminars, webinars, customer roundtables, and partner activities, including objectives, booth strategy, logistics, staffing, budget, and lead follow-up.
  • Experience marketing through distribution and rep channels such as partner enablement, co-marketing programs, MDF planning, and joint demand generation.
  • Ability to work in direct partnership with regional sales leadership: joint account targeting, agreed pipeline objectives, lead follow-up SLAs, and regular pipeline reviews.
  • Ownership of a regional program budget, with clear reporting on spend, pipeline contribution, and ROMI by country, program, and account.
  • Hands-on fluency with marketing automation, CRM, and BI reporting to build regional campaign flows, track lead flow through to sales, and report performance without waiting on corporate.
  • Excellent communication and project management skills, with the ability to operate independently across time zones, cultures, and competing regional priorities.
  • It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position. 
  • nglish proficiency is required, including the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and perform job responsibilities in a professional business environment.

Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • Minimum 7+ years in field, regional, or channel marketing within the semiconductor, electronic components, or high-technology industry, including direct EMEA responsibility.
  • Based in EMEA, able to travel across the region approximately 30% of the time, and effective working with a US-headquartered marketing team.
  • Business-level English required; German, French, or an additional regional language strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with the EMEA electronics event calendar (embedded world, electronica, and the key regional and vertical conferences) and a point of view on where to invest and where not to.
  • Established relationships with, or strong working knowledge of, EMEA distribution and rep partners (Arrow, Avnet/EBV, Future, Mouser, Digi-Key, Farnell) and the regional trade media landscape.
  • Understanding of the region’s priority end markets — automotive, industrial and automation, aerospace and defense, telecom infrastructure, and datacenter — and how design-win cycles differ across them.
  • Practical command of GDPR and regional data privacy requirements as they govern event data capture, lead handling, and email programs.
  • Comfortable building process from scratch, prioritizing without a template, and asking for what the region needs.
  • Experience applying AI tools to accelerate localization, content adaptation, and regional reporting.
  • Known for building trust quickly with sales teams and partners, with superb verbal, presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s Degree required in marketing, communications, business, or related field; technical or engineering background a plus.

Compensation Range: 

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.

SiTime is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Flight Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

At The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx - a modular, reusable orbital vehicle for space missions to stations and beyond. Nyx is engineered with the capability to transport cargo and, in the future, humans.

We are seeking a highly motivated Flight Software Engineer to join our mission-driven team developing Nyx. In this role, you will take full ownership of key components of the flight software stack. You will be designing, implementing, and testing mission-critical systems that enable safe, autonomous, and reliable spaceflight operations.

You will work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where cross-functional integration is essential. Your code will interface directly with vehicle avionics, guidance systems, propulsion, communications, and ground control. Expect to write modern, high-reliability C++ and Python code, drive software simulations, and ensure flight readiness through rigorous testing at both unit and system levels.

The position level will be determined based on your experience, technical depth, and ability to take ownership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and own core flight software modules for spacecraft control, telemetry, data handling, fault management, and communications.

  • Develop in modern C++ and Python for support tooling, following best practices in software architecture, testing, and performance optimization.

  • Build and maintain test frameworks for automated unit, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing to validate software behavior across mission phases.

  • Create and run high-fidelity simulations to model flight dynamics, subsystem interactions, and edge cases.

  • Collaborate closely with GNC, avionics, propulsion, and mission operations teams to ensure seamless integration and mission success.

  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and flight readiness assessments.

What we would love to see from you

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17 or newer) and Python.

  • Experience with real-time systems, embedded development, or spacecraft software.

  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution.

  • Familiarity with software testing methodologies and simulation tools.

  • Excellent cross-disciplinary communication and collaboration skills.

  • Good understanding of math & physics.

  • Focus on detail, quality, and testing.

  • Experience with CI/CD systems and build systems.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of safety critical and real-time critical software and familiarity with RTOS.

  • Good understanding of communication protocols such as: TCP/IP, UART, CAN Bus and serialization.

  • Experience with automotive or flight software frameworks.

  • Background in orbital mechanics, spacecraft systems, or space mission lifecycle.

  • Experience with industry standards such as AUTOSAR, ECSS, DO-178.

 

Why you should join us!

Qualifications and Skills

title: Founding Engineer (Remote or Hybrid - EEA/UK)
descriptionHtml:
Founding Engineer


Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices.

Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

About Tarebase

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on.

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship.

You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. title: Founding Growth - Alan Precision
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Alan Precision: why this exists

Your body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them.

50% of non-communicable diseases (cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, many cancers) are preventable with lifestyle changes, and we're not capturing them. Western countries have seen healthspan flatline for years, meaning we live longer, but not better. 46% of Europeans report mental health issues. The kind of deep, personalised health reading that could change this has been reserved for the few who could afford a 3,000€ check-up, and built for filing reports rather than changing lives.

We don't accept that.

Alan Precision is our bet on advanced prevention as the new norm of care. We combine biology, wearables, medical history, and lifestyle context, read it all as a connected system with AI supervised by physicians, and turn the result into a personalised protocol the member actually executes across sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and supplementation. Then we retest, learn, and adapt. Health is a moving target. We move with it.

Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030.

⭐ The Founding Growth opportunity

Alan Precision is live, with fast week-over-week growth. Now we need to turn a new category into a habit: hundreds of thousands of customers in the coming years, and a measurable impact on their health. You will be the first growth and go-to-market person on the crew, accountable for two numbers: how many members subscribe to Precision, and how many stay, retest and renew.

The crew was launched by the founding team of ARO, acquired by Alan in 2026, to move fast and apply their learnings from building a preventive health company.

It is a unique playground. You get the means of one of France's biggest scale-ups (1M+ members reachable from day one, an ecosystem of products like Mo, Play and Clinic, and a brand carried by ambassadors like Kylian Mbappé) with the culture and pace of a fast-growing startup: small crew, short loops, everything still to invent.

🔭 Scope: Three go-to-market engines

1. Direct-to-member: turn Alan's 1M+ members into Precision subscribers.

Offering paid services that members subscribe to by themselves inside Alan is a pretty new go-to-market for us, and you invent it.

  • Build the CRM and lifecycle engine: segments, triggers, sequences, in-app moments.

  • Use product data to decide who to push Precision to, when and where: which actions, traits or life moments make it relevant, and which do not.

  • Position Precision inside the surfaces of other product crews (Mo, Play, Clinic, Shop), with their teams and push the right message at the right time.

  • Own recurrence: activation after the first check-up, retests, renewals, reactivation. Acquisition without retention does not count.

2. B2B: get Alan's client companies to offer Precision to their employees.

Almost everything is to define: business model, offer format, pricing logic, sales motion.

  • Work with our B2B Marketing team to understand the constraints of our Sales and Account Management teams, give them the right pitch and materials, and set the right targets with them.

  • Meet HR buyers yourself to learn what makes them pay.

3. Beyond Alan: take Precision to the open market.

Once the internal engine runs:

  • Apply the full B2C health and e-commerce playbook to acquire users that are not insured by Alan

  • Your levers will be numerous, across paid acquisition, influence, partnerships, brand.

Across all three:

  • Create demand in a market that is still being created. Talk to members every week, define the value proposition and the messages that make people want advanced prevention, and push for the product changes that go with them.

  • Build a brand people want, and explain it simply. Make advanced prevention desirable and easy to understand, with our Brand team, without overpromising.

  • Say what can be said. Health communication is regulated: medical biology, health claims, influencer rules, use of health data for targeting. You work with our medical and legal teams and turn these constraints into sharper, more credible messages.

  • Measure and decide. Funnels, cohorts, holdouts, channel performance. Pick the next bet, cut what does not work, share what we learned.

  • Own it end to end. From the idea of a strategy to the campaign live in production: you design it, write it, build it, ship it and iterate on it yourself. Sharp copywriting is a core part of the job.

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • You have grown a B2C product from its early days. Ideally as the first growth or go-to-market person, on a subscription in health, wellbeing or e-commerce. You can tell us which channels you picked, which ones you cut, and why.

  • A creative Swiss army knife who prioritises. You can do a bit of everything and you find channels and angles nobody has thought of yet. You know the job is to pick the right one, execute it, measure it and move to the next.

  • Lifecycle and CRM at scale. Customer.io, Braze or equivalent: segmentation, behavioural triggers, in-app moments.

  • Analytical rigour. You read a funnel, build a cohort, set up a holdout and call a result. You measure success in subscribers, retention and revenue.

  • Hands-on, and a great writer. You love taking an idea all the way to production yourself: the strategy, the copy, the campaign, the dashboard. You write well and fast, and you turn a complex medical topic into a clear, desirable promise.

  • Customer-obsessed. You talk to members every week and you are just as comfortable in front of an HR director.

  • Fluent with AI. You build with AI every day: assets, copy variants, segments, analyses and even building your own tools. You use it to go faster, and you keep your judgment on what ships.

  • Driven by health, and rigorous about it. Health matters to you, and when something blocks, you find a way. You make people want to act with messages that hold up in front of a physician.

Nice to haves

Company Mission

The company develops safe, rapid and accurate active muon imaging solutions for industrial quality assessment, security and customs inspection and medical diagnostics. Their platform combines laser-plasma-accelerator-driven muon sources, next-generation particle detectors and AI to enable high-resolution 3D imaging with automated decision-making. The company operates at DESY in Hamburg, Germany, and Tehnopol in Tallinn, Estonia. Their main development partners span the energy, defence, aerospace and security industries. Their initial technology and business focus is on the quality and safety assessment of critical metallic and ceramic components, such as rocket engines, gas turbines, jet engines, and large-scale nuclear or industrial systems.

Core Values

Skunkworks approach: They work in small teams with full ownership. They keep it simple, stupid. Move fast: a shiny prototype means they spent too long on it. They build to learn. They polish later. Disagree together, commit together: they debate and challenge, regardless of title. Then they deliver the decision as one team. They win as a team. They pivot as a team.

Courage: they always make the call. A mistake isn't a failure: it's proof they're improving. Either way, the own the outcome. Honesty and transparency: they share what's really happening, good or bad. That lets everyone make the right call. They stay open. They stay honest.

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Assemble and lead the Muon Source team, covering LPA, converter, and optics; start hands-on, hire and structure the team as the work grows

  • Oversee the development of working points and a density-tailored plasma source that survives the thermal load of a 100 Hz, 100 TW focus—millions of consistent shots, not one good shot

  • Lead the development of the plasma source and execute experiments at user facilities to iterate the design toward powering the transportable muon source

  • Isolate the laser specs that matter most—pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality—and ensure they get delivered

  • Own the vacuum system and the laser transport line, including vacuum chambers, differential pumping, vibration management and thermal management, turning the LPA into a machine that fits inside a shipping container and runs 24/7

  • Define the requirements for the control system, the machine protection system, and the diagnostics suite that let the machine run unattended

  • Manage the budget and make technical decisions within your area of responsibility

  • Participate in hiring processes to expand the Muon Source team as the scope grows

title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
descriptionHtml:

Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. 

Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.

Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Singular Photonics:

Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution.

About the Role:

We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host.

Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment.

You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams.
  • RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control.
  • Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware.
  • Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado.
  • High-Speed Interfaces: Build and integrate the high-speed interfaces that move sensor data: PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, AXI interface, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS, Camera Link.
  • Bring-Up & Debug: Lead firmware bring-up on new boards and sensors, debugging with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and in-system probes.
  • Source Control & Build: Keep RTL under version control with a repeatable, automated build, and document designs to the standard our ISO 9001 design control process requires.
  • Reviews & Support: Contribute to design reviews, and support the software team and customers during field integration.

Experience & Skills:

Essential:

  • Strong proficiency in Verilog, and a solid grounding in RTL design, synthesis and timing closure.
  • Hands-on experience with AMD-Xilinx Vivado and its toolchain.
  • Experience writing your own testbenches and verifying a design in simulation before hardware.
  • Experience bringing up firmware on real hardware and debugging it in the lab.
  • Experience with at least one high-speed interface or bus at RTL level.
  • Comfortable in a small company where priorities shift and everyone pitches in.
  • Working with complex, existing codebases and seamlessly integrating new functionality with minimal disruption.

Desirable:

  • SystemVerilog, and verification practices beyond directed testbenches.
  • Comfortable working in Linux operating systems.
  • Exposure to any of PCIe, AXI interface, USB3, Ethernet, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS or Camera Link.
  • C, C++ or Python for embedded software integration and test automation.
  • Experience with image sensors, time-of-flight, TDCs or single-photon detection.
  • Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, and reading schematics during debug.

Educational Background:

  • Degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2-5 years' experience in FPGA and digital design.

Key Attributes & Behaviours:

  • Rigour: Disciplined about verification - you would rather find it in simulation than on the bench.
  • Debugging: Systematic when the fault could be in the RTL, the board or the sensor, and comfortable with the instruments that tell you which.
  • Clarity: Writes documentation and code that colleagues can pick up without you in the room.
  • Collaboration: Works well across the hardware, ASIC and software boundaries rather than only inside the FPGA.
  • Ownership: Takes a problem from architecture through to a working system, and sees it through.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment where the requirement can move.

Success Indicators:

  • Firmware that meets timing and functions correctly on first hardware more often than not, with issues found in simulation rather than on the bench.
  • Effective bring-up and debugging support during prototype validation and customer deployment, with hardware and firmware issues resolved promptly.
  • Design documentation, simulation coverage and design review contributions good enough for another engineer to maintain the work.

Benefits of Joining Singular Photonics

At Singular Photonics, we are committed to fostering a rewarding and supportive environment for our team. As an FPGA Firmware Engineer, you will benefit from:

  • Pension: 5% company contribution.
  • Share Options: Participation in the Company EMI Share Option Scheme, so you share in the growth you help build.
  • Enhanced Annual Leave: 35 days paid annual leave per year, inclusive of UK public holidays.
  • Hybrid Working: Primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week (full time worker).
  • Career Growth: Work on silicon and systems few engineers get near, with the chance to shape how we do FPGA development as the team grows.
  • Additional Benefits: [Cycle to work and private medical insurance (once implemented)

Why Join Us

This position offers a rare opportunity to work at the forefront of SPAD sensor technology, driving innovation and shaping future applications in photonics and imaging. At Singular Photonics you will be part of a passionate, close-knit team, where the work you do is visible in the product and in the hands of customers.

Location & Work Environment

Based at Orchard Brae House, Queensferry Road, Edinburgh. This is a full-time, permanent role. The work is hands-on with hardware in our lab, so it is primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week.

Right to work in the UK is essential. We are unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities

Singular Photonics is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make appointments on merit, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

If you need any adjustments to the application or interview process, please let us know and we will do what we can to accommodate you.

title: Fullstack Developer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Fullstack Developer (m/w/d)

Deine Mission

Du entwickelst Anwendungen, die Menschen im Arbeitsalltag tatsächlich Arbeit abnehmen. Von der verständlichen Oberfläche über die Backend-Logik bis zur Anbindung bestehender Systeme.

Bei Agentur Philipp bauen wir KI-Lösungen und individuelle Software für den Mittelstand. Dafür suchen wir einen Fullstack Developer, der Anforderungen hinterfragt, technisch mitdenkt und Anwendungen zuverlässig in den produktiven Einsatz bringt.

Du arbeitest je nach Projekt mit unterschiedlichen Technologien: JavaScript und TypeScript im Frontend, PHP und Laravel, Node.js oder Python im Backend. Gemeinsam mit dem Team wählst du die passende Lösung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Webanwendungen vom Frontend bis zum Backend und begleitest sie bis zum produktiven Betrieb.

  • Du baust verständliche Benutzeroberflächen mit React, Next.js, Vue.js oder vergleichbaren Frameworks.

  • Du entwickelst Backends und APIs mit PHP und Laravel, Node.js oder Python und FastAPI, passend zu den Anforderungen des Projekts.

  • Du bindest bestehende Kunden-, ERP- und Drittsysteme an und sorgst für einen zuverlässigen Datenaustausch.

  • Du entwirfst Datenmodelle und setzt Geschäftslogik, Benutzerverwaltung, Rollen und Berechtigungen sauber um.

  • Du integrierst KI-Funktionen und automatisierte Workflows in unsere Anwendungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren KI- und Automatisierungsentwicklern zusammen.

  • Du sorgst mit Tests, Logging und Fehlerbehandlung dafür, dass Anwendungen auch außerhalb des Idealfalls funktionieren.

  • Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter und behältst Wartbarkeit, Sicherheit und Performance im Blick.

  • Du stimmst technische Anforderungen mit der Projektleitung ab und machst frühzeitig sichtbar, wenn etwas unklar ist oder aufwendiger wird.

  • Du dokumentierst wichtige technische Entscheidungen so, dass andere im Team deine Arbeit nachvollziehen und weiterführen können.

Das bringst du mit

  • Praktische Erfahrung darin, Webanwendungen eigenständig vom Frontend bis zum Backend zu entwickeln und produktiv einzusetzen.

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in JavaScript und TypeScript sowie Erfahrung mit React, Next.js, Vue.js oder einem vergleichbaren Frontend-Framework.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in PHP und praktische Erfahrung mit Laravel.

  • Erfahrung mit Node.js oder Python, idealerweise mit einem Backend-Framework wie Express, NestJS oder FastAPI.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken wie MySQL oder PostgreSQL sowie Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung und Datenbankmigrationen.

  • Erfahrung mit REST-APIs, Authentifizierung und der Integration externer Systeme.

  • Routine im Umgang mit Git, Docker und gängigen Deployment-Prozessen.

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind Voraussetzung. Du kannst Anforderungen, technische Rückfragen und Abstimmungen im Team und mit unseren Kunden sicher auf Deutsch klären.

  • Du denkst an Berechtigungen, Datenschutz und Fehlerfälle, bevor die Anwendung beim Kunden läuft.

  • Du arbeitest dich in bestehende Codebasen und neue Technologien ein. Du musst nicht jedes genannte Framework beherrschen, solltest aber Frontend und Backend sicher abdecken.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, sprichst Probleme offen an und bringst übernommene Aufgaben zuverlässig zum Abschluss.

Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit LLM-APIs, RAG-Systemen oder anderen KI-Funktionen.

  • Erfahrung mit n8n oder vergleichbaren Automatisierungsplattformen.

  • Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Laravel-Ökosystem, beispielsweise Livewire oder Inertia.js.

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-Schnittstellen, Webhooks, Queues, Hintergrundjobs und asynchroner Verarbeitung.

  • Kenntnisse in CI/CD, Linux, Monitoring oder Cloud-Infrastruktur.

  • Erfahrung mit automatisierten Frontend-, Backend- und Integrationstests.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Anwendungen, die bei Kunden im Alltag eingesetzt werden. Du siehst, wofür du entwickelst und was deine Arbeit verändert.

  • Unterschiedliche Aufgaben rund um individuelle Software, KI-Kollegen, Schnittstellen und Prozessautomatisierung.

  • Ein breiter Tech-Stack und technische Entscheidungen, die sich am Projekt orientieren.

  • Technischer Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, unsere Entwicklungsstandards mit aufzubauen.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit KI-Entwicklern, Automatisierungsexperten und Projektleitung.

  • Direkter Austausch mit den Menschen, die Entscheidungen treffen. Kurze Wege und schnelle Umsetzung.

  • Remote-freundliches Arbeiten mit regelmäßigem persönlichem Austausch in Dingolfing. Für die finale Gesprächsrunde möchten wir dich vor Ort kennenlernen.

Über Agentur Philipp

Agentur Philipp ist eine KI-Umsetzungsberatung für den Mittelstand. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern bauen Systeme, die im Alltag funktionieren, Aufwand reduzieren und einen messbaren Unterschied machen.

Unsere Haltung ist klar: Verstehen, Anpacken, Liefern und Besser werden.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, GitHub-, Portfolio- oder Projektlinks und gern eine kurze Beschreibung einer Anwendung, die du selbst produktiv gebaut hast. Was war deine Verantwortung?
