title: Global Service Specialist - Semiconductor Equipment (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Description

Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across United States, Asia and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important.

As our Global Service Specialist, based at our Munich HQ, you’ll be part of a rapid-deployment team that resolves complex and escalated technical issues across our worldwide installed base. You’ll step in where regional service teams and partners need deeper expertise, and support installations, commissioning, and repairs when situations require it.

You’ll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You’ll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus.

This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

  

What will you do

  • Act as the technical escalation point for regional service teams and distribution partners, resolving issues that require deeper system expertise.

  • Deploy rapidly to customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia to resolve critical system issues and minimize downtime.

  • Support installation, commissioning, and qualification of our quantum sensing systems when required, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams.

  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, calibration, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when root causes go beyond service-level expertise.

  • Work closely with Field Application Engineers, who focus on measurement execution and customer applications, to ensure a seamless customer experience.

  • Support spare-parts planning and service logistics across the global installed base, ensuring critical parts are available for rapid response.

  • Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers and partners through clear technical communication and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments.

  • Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including escalation workflows, maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.

 

What is expected of you

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field service, service support, or equipment engineering roles, ideally with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment.

  • A proven track record of resolving escalated or complex system issues that first-line service could not solve.

  • Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software.

  • Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures.

  • Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications.

  • Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, especially under time pressure.

  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and build trust with customers, partners, and internal teams.

  • Willingness to travel internationally on a frequent basis, often at short notice, to support customers and partners across the US, Europe, and Asia.

  • Fluency in English. Other languages (e.g. German, Mandarin, Korean) are a plus.

  • A degree in Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent technical training and relevant practical experience.

 

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.
  • Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.
  • Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
  • Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.
  • A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.
  • An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward graduates to join the first graduate cohort at Resonance in Berlin as AI Transformation Leads. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Graduate AI Transformation Lead in Berlin, you’ll work on client teams across DACH from your first month, alongside experienced AI Transformation Leads and AI engineers, with real responsibility from day one. You’ll analyse how a business works, where time and money go, and where AI fundamentally changes the economics. You’ll build the models, business cases and story a leadership team will act on, and prototype new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar. You’ll work side by side with engineers to define what gets built, test it with the people who will use it, and help the client’s teams adopt it. As one of our first graduate cohort, you’ll also help shape our graduate programme and how Resonance trains and grows.

Your first year: Structured training in AI, consulting and the industries we work in, with coaching from Senior AI Transformation Leads and the founding team. You’ll be on a client team from your first month, in a small team where you know everyone by name and work closely with colleagues in London. Nobody expects you to know it all when you start: asking for help early is part of the job. You’ll start as a Junior Transformation Lead and typically move up a level within 18–24 months.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the very top performers of your peers. You’re finishing an undergraduate or master’s degree in a technical subject, such as engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or another natural science, or a quantitative subject such as economics, or you graduated in one in the last two years, with top results from a top university. You structure problems clearly and are comfortable with numbers. You use AI every day and have built something with it, whether a project, a tool or an automation, and you’re curious about how businesses actually work. You can show you make things happen through internships, a society you led, a company you started or something you built. An internship in consulting, banking, private equity or a startup is a plus, and so is German for client work in DACH. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Real client work from your first month, learning from people who have shipped 30+ AI products and embedded AI into 50+ businesses. Every engagement ends with AI running in production and results you can measure. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and a chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates. Start date Summer 2027 (dates to be confirmed). We also offer Summer 2027 internships for students in the penultimate year of their degree.

Apply

Send your CV with your grades and a short note on something you've analysed or built with AI.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Graduate Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward graduates to join the first graduate cohort at Resonance as Applied AI Engineers. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Graduate Applied AI Engineer, you’ll build production AI systems for our clients from your first month, working alongside Senior Applied AI Engineers who review your code and coach you. You’ll ship agents, integrations, data pipelines and evals, working across the stack from the AI layer to the client’s core systems and the interfaces people use. You’ll sit with the people who do the work today, see how AI changes it, and help client teams run and extend what we build. You’ll also contribute to Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, take on more ownership as you grow, and help shape how we train, build and grow as one of our first graduate cohort.

Your first year: Comprehensive training when you join, covering AI engineering, our platform and how we work with clients. You’ll be on a client team from your first month, in a small team where you know everyone by name, founders included. Nobody expects you to know it all when you start: asking for help early is part of the job, and senior people make time for it. You’ll start as a Junior Engineer and typically become an Engineer within 18–24 months.

What we’re looking for: You take the initiative, learn fast and go looking for hard problems. You’re AI-obsessed, trying new models and tools the day they come out. You’re finishing a degree in Computer Science or a closely related subject, such as Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science or Mathematics with a strong programming component, or you graduated in one in the last two years, and you can show what you’re capable of through your grades, competitions, internships, societies or things you’ve built. You write good code in Python or TypeScript and have built something with LLMs: a project, a hackathon entry or an open-source contribution. A software engineering internship, ideally at a startup or fast-moving product team, AI side projects or a company you founded are a plus. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Instead of one product at one company, you’ll ship several production AI systems a year across industries, and help build our own AI products and platform. You’ll learn alongside engineers and operators who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses, in a team aiming to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe and worldwide. Europe is falling behind on AI, and every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: London, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in the UK and Europe. English is our working language. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates. Start date Summer 2027 (dates to be confirmed). We also offer Summer 2027 internships for students in the penultimate year of their degree.

Apply

Send your CV with your grades, your GitHub if you have one, and a short note on something you've built with AI.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Graphic Designer - Maternity Cover FTC
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Graphic Designer to join our Graphic Design team. This is a fixed term contract covering maternity leave, until August 2027 with the possibility of extension. You’ll also be a technical reference point for our Graphic Designers, sharing technique and best practice to keep the team’s output consistent. NICE TO HAVES

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

  • Wellbeing allowance – £250 annual allowance for you to invest in your health and wellbeing (T&Cs apply).

  • Stay active & save money – Cycle-to-work scheme and gym discounts.

JOIN US!

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!

title: Growth Manager (Berlin) - Russian speaking
descriptionHtml:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Growth Manager (Berlin)

Salary Range: €55K – €75k

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business in Russian speaker markets. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.

What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth and expansion efforts in Russian speaker markets. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

  • Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

  • Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

  • You speak Russian on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  1. Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.

  2. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it.

  3. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict.

  4. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing.

  5. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €55K – €75K

title: GTM Engineering Intern | Revenue Operations (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
In a nutshell: 4 to 6-month internship in our RevOps team at our Munich headquarters (hybrid), starting between February and April 2027, with the opportunity to move into a full-time role straight afterwards.

About this role at Luminovo

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we have recently expanded into North America and the rest of Europe.

GTM engineering at Luminovo is part of Revenue Operations, the department that sits between marketing, sales and customer success and makes sure our revenue organisation runs smoothly.

Our go-to-market engineering function builds the systems that find the right companies and the right people for our sales team: target lists, data enrichment, hyper-personalised outbound campaigns that signal our sellers whom to call next. We work closely with Account Executives, the BDR team and marketing and directly contribute to pipeline generation.

As our GTM engineering intern, you will run outbound campaigns end to end and help build the next layer: signal-based lead generation. You will also help us improve account scoring and build AI automations that take manual work off our sales reps.

There is no textbook for this role. You will learn it the way we did: by building, shipping and seeing what works.

By the end of your internship, you will have shipped revenue systems that our sales & marketing teams rely on every day, and gained hands-on experience in go-to-market engineering, one of the hottest roles on the market right now!

You will also see first-hand how a modern B2B start-up operates day to day, with AI built into its workflows.

This role is for you

  • You combine technical thinking with commercial curiosity: perhaps you studied engineering and want to understand how companies sell, or you have discovered a passion for the commercial side of start-ups.

  • You are keen to work in a fast-paced environment and to grow alongside a high-growth start-up.

  • You bring the drive to learn quickly, a sharp analytical mind and the ambition to take on real responsibility from your first weeks. You collaborate well, ask questions without hesitation and are happy to get your hands dirty.

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You have built your own automations, workflows or tools, and can explain what you shipped and what came of it.

  • You are fluent in both German and English. Much of our outbound targets buyers in the DACH region, while the company operates in English.

  • You stand out if you have built something entrepreneurial during your studies, be it a side project, a student society or a small business.

  • You have first experience in GTM engineering, sales operations or automation (this is a big advantage but not a requirement!)

Your performance objectives

🧬 Run outbound campaigns

  • Deliver multichannel campaigns end to end. Build target lists, source and enrich the right contacts, and write the messaging in German and English.

  • Go where coverage is thin. Your campaigns will go wherever our sellers need the most support or wherever there is an opportunity worth pursuing, starting with DACH and extending to the rest of Europe and North America. Take on event campaigns, new regions and opportunistic plays, and turn them around to contribute to our pipeline.

🌀 Build signals and tooling

  • Ship signals. Build plugins or scrapers that generate high-intent leads for our sellers.

  • Process scaling. Transform website engagement into automated outbound triggers and create repeatable playbooks.

⚙️ Build automations

  • Remove manual work. Automate the repetitive manual tasks our revenue teams deal with day to day.

  • Challenge what exists. Get to know the systems we have built, then tell us where they fall short and help improve them.

💶 Unblock the sales team

  • Understand what sales reps need. Work closely with our AEs and BDRs, get to know their accounts and processes, and remove the friction that slows them down.

  • Close the loop. Feed what you learn from replies and campaign results back to sales and marketing.

🗂 Own the data

  • Own enrichment and imports. Take responsibility for account enrichment and every data import into HubSpot on contact, company and lead level.

  • Keep data accuracy high. You will be responsible for maintaining our enrichment so that data stays clean and workflows keep firing.

Your Toolkit

You will learn to work with the most modern sales automation tools on the market, such as Clay, n8n, Twain, Lusha, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and many more.

Work location

Our Munich headquarters. For your first two months you will be in the office most days, so you get to know the product, the team, our ICP and the basics of our market. After that, the role is hybrid, with the flexibility to work from home. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

Whom you will be working with

  • Max Hungenbach, Revenue Operations Team Lead and your line manager

  • Danny Bodnar, GTM Engineer, your mentor and day-to-day coach

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales. You will work directly with him on GTM strategy.

  • Dasha Vyazemskaya, Head of BDR and your partner on handing campaigns over to the BDR team

  • George Knight, Demand Generation Manager in Marketing and your partner on campaigns run alongside marketing

  • Our Account Executives and BDRs across Europe and North America, for whom your campaigns run

Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know, we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you’re interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles, see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor.

 

Compensation: €2,650 – €3,150 per month

title: GTM Manager
descriptionHtml:
tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry

  • 6 of the 20 largest construction companies in the German-speaking region already rely on Kuro every day, representing over €40bn in combined annual construction volume

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

One year after launch, Kuro runs every day inside the back offices of DACH’s largest construction companies, which together build more than €40 billion a year. We automate their core workflows and help them make faster, better decisions.

We’re just getting started. The construction software companies that reached billion-dollar scale did it by owning core back-office workflows, and that’s where we already are. With AI, we believe the next category leader can be 10x bigger. We raised a €10M seed round to build it.

We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

The Opportunity

As GTM Manager, you'll play a key role in driving Kuro's commercial growth by generating new business opportunities, engaging prospective customers, and turning go-to-market initiatives into results. You'll be hands-on across the customer journey, from prospecting and building relationships to supporting POCs and transforming them into long-term customer relationships.

You'll work directly with our Founding GTM Manager to bring our go-to-market strategy to life, while collaborating closely with our Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams. Together, you'll strengthen our commercial activities, improve how we engage and convert customers, and help scale Kuro's go-to-market engine as the company grows.

What You'll Do

  • Drive top-of-funnel activities through prospecting, targeted outreach, lead qualification, and relationship building.

  • Manage and develop customer opportunities from first contact through product demonstrations, POCs, and commercial discussions.

  • Create compelling customer presentations, proposals, and business cases to support commercial conversations.

  • Proven hands-on experience in prospecting, outbound sales, pipeline generation, and managing customer relationships.

  • Strong commercial mindset and communication skills, with the ability to engage both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Technical curiosity and an analytical, structured approach to solving problems and identifying opportunities.

  • Proactive, highly driven, and execution-oriented, with strong organizational skills and the ability to take ownership in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Fluent in German and English (more languages are a plus).

Why Kuro

You are joining Kuro when it matters most. The product is live, our customers are using it daily, but their journey with Kuro has only started, and you can shape it from the get-go. There is no playbook, the world is changing at an unprecedented speed, and you can shape how one of the most critical industries around the globe wins in this new era.

  2. Impact Call: Deep dive & Get to know Product (45 min)

  5. Final Culture Interview (45 Min)

title: Head Of Data Protection & DPO
descriptionHtml:
💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book,which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


The Opportunity:

We're on a journey to steward AI into the NHS safely and responsibly. We've already deployed ambient voice technology to write up consultations, released our first AI triage products to help practices read and route hundreds of patient requests a day, and we're now working on deploying agents in healthcare settings.

The next few years will define how AI is used with patient data in the NHS. As Head of Data Protection and our in-house DPO, you'll help set that standard nationally: building the frameworks that let us move quickly and safely, and earning the trust of the patients, clinicians and organisations who rely on us.

This role is about building and shaping, not just running. You'll own data protection at Accurx end to end: the strategy, the statutory role, the team and the calls. You'll be a key leader in our Technology division, working as a trusted partner to our Chief Product Officer and Head of Legal.

Challenges you'll solve...

  • Steward AI into the NHS: set Accurx's positions on how we build, deploy and monitor AI products at scale, from controllership and assistive vs automated, to retention of AI inputs and outputs, sub-processors and model hosting, without ever undermining the trust we've built with our users

  • Set guardrails, not gates: define clear guardrails so product teams can move fast inside them without asking permission each time, and make our positions public and credible so NHS DPOs can rely on them rather than starting from scratch

  • Bring privacy into product design: work with product, design and engineering to embed privacy by design. Much of what we're building hasn't been seen in the health system before, so you'll need to be unapologetically forward-looking and comfortable taking informed, calculated risks

  • Turn decisions into reusable patterns: with our in-house privacy team, build governance templates, pre-approved data flows and plain-English privacy notice wording that healthcare organisations can pick up and use, and shape how we responsibly use our data to improve products and patient outcomes

  • Hold the statutory DPO role with independence: inform, advise and monitor compliance under UK GDPR, including our record of processing, DPIAs, training and audits. You'll be our named contact for the ICO, NHS customers and data subjects, and lead testing, breach assessment and reporting

  • Run corporate privacy: own our core privacy obligations and registrations, keep the evidence current for regulators, customers and bids, lead privacy due diligence on suppliers, partners and corporate transactions, and oversee how we handle employee and corporate data as well as patient data

  • Build a function that moves at product speed: lead and grow a small, bar-raising privacy and data function, and make it easy for 200+ colleagues to get fast, consistent answers to privacy questions

You should apply if...

  • You're product-minded about privacy: you've worked inside a product company and helped ship things, finding an approach that's both more private and better for the user. You've guided technology organisations through responsible innovation, especially where AI/ML meets sensitive data

  • You're AI-fluent with deep UK data protection expertise: you apply UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 and the common law duty of confidentiality in practice, understand how modern AI systems actually handle data, and have a view on ICO AI guidance and where regulation is heading

  • You've built and led privacy teams: you grow capability, bring your team into decisions, delegate real ownership and build trust across functions

  • You're confident externally: you can represent the business to regulators, NHS organisations and partners, and communicate complex positions clearly

  • You know health and the NHS, or have a fast route to it: controller and processor roles in primary care, DSPT, DTAC, the Caldicott Principles and the national data opt-out. You learn the NHS by going to see it

  • You challenge the status quo: you stay ahead of changes in digital health, AI and data ethics, and see privacy as something that enables the business to move at pace

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £110,000 - £140,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £100,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £110K – £140K • Offers Equity

descriptionHtml:

About JetBrains

More than 15 million users, over 300,000 organizations, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 companies rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

JetBrains Air is an AI-native software development platform that connects developer workflows, collaboration, and control into a single system. Because this is a major strategic focus for us, we need a strong data function to help guide it. As Head of Data Science and Analytics for JetBrains Air, you’ll lead our data science, analytics, and data engineering capabilities for both the product and go-to-market domains. 

By building a high-performing team, you’ll help us use data to navigate product direction, optimize product and go-to-market decisions, and accelerate growth. You’ll own the data strategy for JetBrains AI, partnering closely with product, engineering, and leadership teams to ensure our data infrastructure scales smoothly alongside our ambitions.

Day to day, you will:

  • Build and lead a cohesive team of data scientists, analysts, and data engineers.
  • Help teams adopt a rigorous experimentation culture, improving how we test and measure product changes.
  • Uncover insights across the customer journey to improve acquisition, retention, and monetization.
  • Establish scalable analytics foundations, including clear metric frameworks, data models, and self-service reporting.
  • Partner with engineering teams to design robust, compliant data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Guide the development of machine learning capabilities that enhance marketing acquisition, product personalization, and operational efficiency.

What you’ll bring

  • A strategic mindset paired with a willingness to dive hands-on into the details when necessary.
  • A strong belief in building experimentation cultures and helping others make data-informed decisions.
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity and build new capabilities in a fast-moving space.
  • Clear, candid communication skills to align both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A commitment to maintaining high standards for privacy, security, and responsible data use.

What you’ll need

  • Willingness to learn fast and find practical solutions to hard problems.

What success looks like

You will have transformed JetBrains Air into a truly data-informed, experimentation-driven product offering. By establishing strong data foundations, you’ll empower teams to deeply understand our customers, accurately measure product impact, and confidently make strategic decisions. Rather than just reporting on what has already happened, your work will actively shape what we build next.

title: Head of E-commerce
descriptionHtml:
On réinvente l'imperméable. Pour de vrai.

On crée des imperméables colorés, modulables et fabriqués à partir de tissus recyclés. Pas pour faire comme tout le monde, mais pour donner enfin envie de porter un imperméable.

Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une vingtaine, avec un modèle multicanal : un réseau retail en plein développement, un e-commerce qui fonctionne bien et un B2B qui accélère.

Et surtout, on a encore beaucoup de choses à construire et de barrières à faire tomber.

C'est là que tu entres en action.

Le poste

On cherche quelqu'un qui a déjà scalé un e-commerce dans la mode — et qui a envie de recommencer avec une marque qui a quelque chose à dire.

Pas un manager qui supervise. Pas un consultant qui conseille. Un(e) Head of E-commerce qui exécute, qui teste, qui itère, et qui vient chercher le résultat lui-même. Tu travailles en direct avec le fondateur, sans couche intermédiaire, sans réunion de validation à n'en plus finir.

Tu prends le lead sur l'e-commerce de A à Z — et le site, c'est ton produit. Pas un outil qu'on subit, pas un chantier qu'on repousse : quelque chose qu'on améliore en continu, avec méthode, avec des données, et avec l'obsession que chaque visiteur devienne client.

Tu comprends que dans la mode, performance et image de marque ne s'opposent pas — ils se construisent ensemble, sur le long terme. Tu sais qu'une bonne décision d'acquisition peut abîmer une marque, et qu'une marque forte réduit le coût d'acquisition. C'est exactement ce qu'on veut construire chez Flotte.

Si tu cherches un poste où on te demande de « définir uniquement la vision », ce n'est pas ce poste. Si tu cherches un endroit où tu construis quelque chose qui compte, avec quelqu'un prêt à aller vite et à prendre des risques calculés — bienvenue.

Vos missions

Tes responsabilités concrètes

Le site, c'est ton produit

  • Tu « owns » le site de A à Z — pas juste sa performance marketing, mais son expérience, son évolution, sa roadmap
  • Tu priorises les développements avec notre prestataire tech : ce qui sort, dans quel ordre, pourquoi
  • Tu A/B testes en continu — pas une fois par trimestre, mais comme réflexe de travail
  • Tu détectes les points de friction avant que les clients se plaignent
  • Chaque page, chaque étape du tunnel a une raison d'être et un indicateur qui le prouve

Performance & acquisition

  • Piloter et optimiser les campagnes Meta / Google / TikTok (et challenge l'agence qui s'en charge)
  • Construire une stratégie d'acquisition rentable, cohérente avec l'image de marque — pas juste du volume à tout prix
  • Gérer la saisonnalité mode : anticiper les pics, optimiser les périodes creuses, ne jamais sacrifier l'image pour remplir un objectif court terme
  • Déployer un vrai tracking et ne plus naviguer à vue

CRM & retention

  • Structurer la base client, segmenter, personnaliser
  • Email, SMS, automation — construire des flows qui transforment les acheteurs en fans
  • LTV : la faire grimper

Vision 360 & cohérence omnicanale

  • Assurer la cohérence de l'expérience digitale sur tous les canaux : e-commerce, retail, B2B
  • Apporter un regard digital sur la stratégie B2B portée par l'équipe dédiée — sans empiéter sur leur terrain
  • Garantir que le site et les outils digitaux servent l'ensemble des canaux, pas seulement le DTC
  • Être le garant d'une image de marque cohérente quel que soit le point de contact

Développement international

  • Identifier et prioriser les marchés européens à fort potentiel pour Flotte (UK, Benelux, DACH, Nordics...)
  • Définir la stratégie de pénétration marché par marché : positionnement, canaux, pricing, timing
  • Travailler en binôme avec le pôle marketing & communication pour adapter l'image de marque aux marchés cibles sans en diluer l'ADN
  • Tester, mesurer, ajuster — pas de grand plan sur 3 ans, mais une approche structurée et itérative
  • Piloter les partenariats locaux (distributeurs, revendeurs, marketplaces) quand c'est le bon levier

Pilotage

  • Définir les bons KPIs, les suivre, les challenger
  • Être force de proposition sur le budget, les outils, la stack tech
  • Recruter et structurer une petite équipe quand on est prêts

Vos compétences

Le profil qu'on cherche vraiment

Tu as déjà fait le chemin dans la mode — et tu as envie de recommencer avec une marque qui a quelque chose à prouver.

Tu connais les contraintes du prêt-à-porter : les collections qui se succèdent, les stocks à piloter, la saisonnalité qui dicte le calendrier marketing, et la pression permanente de défendre une image de marque tout en délivrant de la performance. Tu sais qu'on ne construit pas une marque mode comme on scale un pure player généraliste. Et tu crois qu'on peut faire les deux.

  • 5 ansd'expérience en e-commerce, obligatoirement dans la mode ou le prêt-à-porter, avec au moins une expérience de scale probante — et des chiffres à l'appui
  • Tu ne sacrifies pas l'image de marque sur l'autel du ROAS — tu sais que la désirabilité d'une marque mode se construit sur le long terme et se détruit très vite
  • Une vision long terme : construire une marque qui dure, pas juste optimiser une saison
  • Un profil entrepreneur dans l'âme : tu penses business autant que tu penses acquisition, tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire
  • Tu maîtrises Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, un outil CRM (Klaviyo ou équivalent)
  • Tu exécutes — la stratégie c'est bien, mais sans exécution ça ne vaut rien
  • Tu es à l'aise pour travailler en direct avec un fondateur exigeant, sans filtre, avec franchise et sans ego
  • Anglais courant obligatoire.

Avantages

Ce qu'on t'offre

Une marque à construire, pas à gérer.

Chez Flotte, tu n'arrives pas dans une structure figée avec des process à respecter. Tu arrives dans une équipe qui construit encore — et qui cherche quelqu'un pour accélérer. Tu as un accès direct au fondateur, une vraie autonomie, et un impact qui se mesure.

On est convaincus qu'on peut devenir la référence de l'imperméable en France, puis en Europe. Ce poste, c'est le poste de quelqu'un qui veut être là quand ça arrive — pas juste le regarder de loin.

  • Rôle de direction dans une PME en croissance avec une vraie ambition de scale
  • Package attractif selon profil + variable sur objectifs
  • Une culture friendly, colorée, qui ne se prend pas au sérieux — mais qui prend ses résultats très au sérieux

Envoie-nous un message court avec ce que tu ferais en priorité si tu arrivais chez Flotte demain matin, et ce que tu as déjà construit dans la mode.

descriptionHtml:
Unternehmen

Die PolymerCycle Gruppe ist ein integriertes Kunststoffrecycling-Unternehmen und vereint die Best Plastic Management GmbH, PB Solutions GmbH, ATP Service & Consulting GmbH und Hoffmann+Voss GmbH. Gemeinsam machen wir aus Kunststoffabfällen hochwertige Rezyklate, die Neuware in anspruchsvollen Anwendungen ersetzen – etwa in der Automobil-, Elektro- oder Verpackungsindustrie.

Dabei decken unsere Gesellschaften jeden Schritt des Recyclingkreislaufs ab: vom Handel mit Sekundärrohstoffen und PCR-/PIR-Stoffströmen über die Trennung komplexer Kunststoffgemische mit innovativen Dichtetrennverfahren und die Regranulierung in großen Mengen bis hin zu maßgeschneiderten Recompounds für technische Kunststoffe.

Damit zählt PolymerCycle zu den wenigen Anbietern, die den gesamten Recyclingkreislauf vom Kunststoffabfall bis zum fertig spezifizierten Compound aus einer Hand abbilden – und ist optimal aufgestellt für die wachsende europäische Nachfrage nach hochwertigen Rezyklaten.

Digitale Geschäftsprozesse verbinden bei uns alle Bereiche: vom Vertrieb über die Steuerung der Stoffströme und die Produktion bis zur kaufmännischen Abwicklung. Diese vernetzte Systemlandschaft wollen wir gezielt weiterentwickeln.

title: Head of Platform Foundations
descriptionHtml:
Location: London or Bristol, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Head of Engineering

Team: Platform Foundations

Salary: £115,200 - £144,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Director of Platform & Security

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


About the role

As Head of Platform Foundations, you’ll own the core foundations every Kaluza engineer and client builds on: the internal platform, production reliability, release pipelines and AI tooling. You’ll lead four teams (Platform Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Release Engineering, and AI & Enablement Engineering) through your engineering managers. The platform runs Kaluza Retail, Energy Optimisation and Customer Care across dedicated client instances in the UK, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Your mission is to make Kaluza scale reliably, with more clients, markets and meters without a matching rise in cost or operational load. You’ll also turn our early gains from AI-assisted engineering into how the whole technology organisation works. (The data platform sits outside this role, though you’ll own the AWS accounts it runs in.)


What you’ll do

  • Set the multi-year platform strategy and roadmap with Product and Engineering leadership, so platform investment follows client and commercial priorities

  • Make Kaluza scale repeatably at falling marginal cost, delivering new client instances, mass meter migrations and new markets

  • Lead Kaluza’s AI transformation in engineering, embedding tooling, agents and guardrails into the development lifecycle, measuring the impact, and partnering with Product on the AI capabilities we offer clients

  • Make reliability a feature clients trust, through SLOs, incident response and continuous improvement across all client instances

  • Own how software ships at Kaluza, with CI/CD and progressive-delivery practices that let teams deliver safely and often, using frameworks such as DORA to measure and improve velocity

  • Own cloud unit economics and FinOps, making investment and savings recommendations to the technology budget, and manage strategic partners including AWS and Datadog

  • Lead, mentor and grow a UK-based team with a global remit, building a culture of engineering excellence and developing the next layer of leaders, while working with Security and IAM to build in compliance (ISO 27001 / 22301) and data residency


What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Proven experience in a senior leadership role running an organisation’s Platform function, with a track record of hiring, mentoring and scaling high-performing platform and SRE teams through engineering managers

  • Experience developing and delivering a multi-year platform strategy and roadmap with product counterparts

  • Hands-on experience implementing AI tooling across an engineering organisation and measurably changing how it builds software, not just piloting it

  • A track record of running production reliability at scale (SLOs, incident management, on-call) for a multi-tenant or multi-instance SaaS platform, with a strong grounding in modern cloud-native architecture (AWS preferred)

  • Experience owning cloud unit economics and making the investment case to Finance, plus strong partner management with technology vendors

  • Exceptional stakeholder management, including presenting platform strategy, risk and investment cases to executive leaders. Experience with DORA, internal developer platforms or platform-as-a-product thinking, regulated or data-sovereignty-sensitive markets (energy, utilities, financial services), or running a platform for external clients is a bonus


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% of salary to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Head of Sales – France & International
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Galénic

Fondée en 1978 par Pierre Fabre, Galénic est une Maison française de skincare scientifique qui associe excellence de la recherche, innovation et savoir-faire du luxe français.

Portée par son centre d'innovation scientifique à Toulouse et par l'ouverture de la Maison Galénic Paris, à quelques pas de la Place Vendôme, la marque entre dans une nouvelle phase de développement.

Notre ambition est de construire un modèle de distribution sélectif, international et omnicanal, conjuguant e-commerce, retail expérientiel, distributeurs premium et partenariats stratégiques.

Pour accompagner cette transformation, nous recrutons notre futur Head of Sales & Retail– Europe & International.

Votre mission

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Générale, vous aurez la responsabilité de construire, piloter et accélérer le développement commercial de Galénic en Europe et sur ses marchés internationaux prioritaires.

Vous serez responsable de la performance commerciale, de la croissance du chiffre d'affaires et de la rentabilité de nos différents canaux de distribution.

Vous interviendrez à la fois sur la définition des stratégies commerciales, leur exécution opérationnelle et la structuration progressive des équipes.

Votre objectif : transformer l'ambition internationale de Galénic en un business durable, rentable et scalable.

Vos responsabilités

  1. Piloter la stratégie et la performance commerciale

  • Construire et déployer la stratégie commerciale à trois ans, en cohérence avec les ambitions de la marque.

  • Définir les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires, de rentabilité et de développement pour chaque canal.

  • Piloter les budgets commerciaux, business plans, forecasts et P&L par canal.

  • Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés : Net Sales, marge, productivité, conversion, sell-in et sell-out.

  • Identifier les opportunités de croissance et optimiser les investissements commerciaux.

2. Accélérer le développement du e-commerce DTC

  • Piloter la performance commerciale du e-commerce en collaboration avec les équipes Digital et Marketing.

  • Développer le chiffre d'affaires, le taux de conversion, le panier moyen et la fidélisation client.

  • Suivre la rentabilité du canal, les coûts d'acquisition et la contribution commerciale des investissements marketing.

  • Développer une approche commerciale fondée sur la connaissance client, les données et la performance.

3. Développer la performance de la Maison Galénic Paris

  • Accompagner le développement commercial de notre Maison, véritable flagship expérientiel de la marque.

  • Piloter les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires des soins et des ventes retail.

  • Optimiser les réservations, le taux d'occupation des cabines, la conversion post-soin et la productivité commerciale.

  • Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en préservant l'excellence de l'expérience client.

4. Construire et développer notre réseau de distribution international

  • Définir et déployer les plans de développement commercial sur les marchés prioritaires

  • Identifier, sélectionner et négocier avec les distributeurs et partenaires locaux.

  • Construire les business plans par marché : objectifs commerciaux, conditions de distribution, investissements, marges et rentabilité.

  • Piloter les relations avec les partenaires, leurs engagements commerciaux et leurs performances.

  • Accompagner les lancements et le développement progressif de nouveaux marchés.

5. Développer les partenariats stratégiques

  • Structurer un réseau sélectif de partenaires auprès des hôtels de luxe, palaces, spas, cliniques esthétiques, clubs privés et acteurs du luxe.

  • Identifier et développer les opportunités commerciales à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Construire des modèles de partenariat rentables et pérennes.

  • Piloter la contribution de ces partenariats au développement commercial et à la visibilité de Galénic.

6. Construire et animer l'organisation commerciale

  • Structurer progressivement les équipes commerciales, en fonction du développement de l'activité.

  • Manager et accompagner les responsables opérationnels et commerciaux.

  • Développer une culture de performance, de responsabilité et d'excellence commerciale.

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Global & Regional Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain et les partenaires internationaux.

Profil recherché

  • 10 à 15 ans dans la beauté, dont une expérience significative en distribution internationale et une exposition réelle au e-commerce et au retail.

  • Expérience confirmée de direction commerciale ou de business development senior dans l'univers du skincare premium, de la beauté sélective ou du luxe.

  • Expérience significative du développement international, notamment à travers des réseaux de distributeurs.

  • Très bonne compréhension des enjeux du e-commerce DTC et de la distribution physique premium.

  • Expérience dans la construction et le pilotage de business plans, budgets et P&L.

  • Capacité démontrée à développer de nouveaux marchés, négocier des accords commerciaux et structurer des équipes.

  • Forte sensibilité à l'univers du luxe, à l'expérience client et à la valeur de marque.

  • Profil entrepreneurial, pragmatique, autonome et orienté résultats.

  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement international, interculturel et en transformation.

  • Anglais courant indispensable.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un rôle stratégique au cœur de la transformation et du développement international d'une Maison française de skincare scientifique.

  • L'opportunité de construire une organisation commerciale multicanale, avec une véritable responsabilité sur la croissance et la rentabilité.

  • Une collaboration directe avec la Direction Générale et la Direction Marketing
