title: Head of Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Head of Strategic Accounts, EMEA to lead the top tier of our commercial organisation — the largest, most complex accounts driving 9fin’s next phase of growth. Strategics is our top segment: a targeted book of our largest ARR accounts across the global banks, top-tier law firms, multi-strategy hedge funds, asset managers, and private equity firms who set the standard for how credit intelligence is bought and used.

You’ll build and lead a team of ~5–6 senior relationship managers in London, each owning a small portfolio of strategic accounts in a hybrid Account Management and Enterprise Sales role. You’ll partner closely with our Head of Strategic Accounts, EMEA to run a globally coordinated segment and work with senior Customer Success partners at the account level.

This is a builder role for a leader who has personally carried a large number, sold enterprise-scale deals into financial services, and knows how to raise the bar on rigour, presence, and multi-year deal execution.

This role requires 3 days in our London office.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Lead the EMEA Strategics team to consistent, forecastable delivery quarter over quarter across a book of $13M+ ARR accounts.

  • Coach and manage a team of ~5–6 Strategic Account Managers covering our most important banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, and law firms in EMEA.

  • Drive multi-year deal execution, lock in early renewals, and structure enterprise agreements that grow durably over time.

  • Coach the team through complex commercial motions — MSAs, procurement, legal review, and executive alignment at the MD, Partner, PM, Head of Desk, and C-suite level.

  • Run weekly segment reviews focused on deals moved, deals at risk, pipeline health, and account-level path-to-close plans.

  • Set the operating cadence for the segment. Enforce our 3-day office minimum, and drive territory planning, account mapping, and a shared deal methodology across the team.

  • Partner with the EMEA Head of Strategic Accounts to build geographic reciprocity, with EMEA AMs backing up EMEA coverage on global accounts, and vice versa.

  • Work in a “two-in-the-box” model with senior CSMs (product and usage) and Sales Engineering (pre-sales), and partner across Enablement, Rev Ops, Marketing, and Product to remove barriers to growth.

  • Be the senior voice of our strategic clients into Product and Engineering — translating segment-level themes across credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed, and private credit into a clear point of view on the roadmap.

  • Represent 9fin externally with the C-suite — at client offsites, executive briefings, industry conferences, and roundtables — and become a recognised name in EMEA debt markets.

  • Build the operating system for the Strategics segment — deal reviews, path-to-close proposals, territory planning, and account planning frameworks that scale.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 12+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, including 4+ years leading strategic or enterprise sales teams selling into financial services (banks, asset managers, hedge funds, PE firms), law firms, or a mix.

  • Have personally carried and consistently exceeded a large individual quota on multi-million-dollar strategic accounts, and can point to specific accounts you’ve grown from $X to $Y and explain exactly how.

  • Bring a consultative approach to selling and want to become a strategic partner to our clients

  • Have deep familiarity with capital markets, credit, or the debt markets ecosystem across credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed, and private credit — you can hold your own with a restructuring lawyer, a leveraged finance banker, or a credit PM.

  • Have led teams through multi-year deal execution and understand what it takes to secure meaningful year-over-year uplifts, early renewals, and complex enterprise agreements.

  • Can coach reps through complex procurement, MSA negotiation, legal review, and executive alignment at the MD, Partner, PM, Head of Desk, and C-suite level.

  • Bring C-suite presence and cross-organisational credibility. You show up sharp, prepared, and trusted by both your team and your customers.

  • Are a proactive coach, not a reactive manager. You share process, mentor your reps, and help them plan deals in advance rather than reacting to slipped forecasts.

  • Have run a disciplined operating cadence — weekly deal reviews, forecast rigour, territory and account planning, and a shared deal methodology across the team.

  • Are commercially sharp and operationally rigorous, and can be a credible senior voice of your team’s clients into Product and Engineering.

  • Build trust across a matrixed commercial organisation and can partner effectively with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Enablement, Rev Ops, Marketing, and Product.

  • Set a high bar and lead through presence and standards rather than fear. You drive accountability without burning your team out.

  • Thrive in ambitious, fast-moving environments where expectations are high, opportunities are abundant, and no two days look the same.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Health Solution Architect - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire de Theodo et son succès

Depuis 2009, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Notre approche : le meilleur de la technologie, au service de la création de valeur, porté par l'approche Lean.

Notre approche unique est fondée sur 3 principes :

  • nous avons développé des expertises reconnues dans les technologies clés de la conception et du développement produit;
  • quelle que soit l’étape du projet, notre priorité à chaque décision est la création de valeur pour nos clients;
  • nous recrutons les meilleurs talents digitaux et cultivons leur ingéniosité grâce à l’approche lean.

En 15 ans, nous sommes devenus un groupe de plus de 700 Theodoers, organisé en entités spécialisées par technologie (Apps, Cloud, Data & AI) et par industrie (Fintech, Govtech, Healthtech, Consumer Products Goods). En 2025, le groupe génère 100M€ de CA.



Tes missions

La santé se digitalise. Les données de vie réelle explosent. Elles facilitent le soin et accélèrent la recherche, notamment via les entrepôts de données de santé.

Ces données sont extrêmement sensibles et réglementées. Nos clients ont donc besoin de notre expertise pour bâtir des applications sur des architectures Cloud conformes à la réglementation HDS. L'arrivée des LLM ajoute un défi : exposer ces données à des agents pour aider les soignants et les patients, sans jamais transiger sur la sécurité.

Dans notre équipe, tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au service du soin et de la recherche. Des projets utiles, pour des produits qui comptent.

Ton rôle : concevoir, convaincre et déployer

Ta mission est avant tout opérationnelle. Tu conçois, tu présentes et tu mets en place des architectures Cloud qui répondent aux besoins fonctionnels, de sécurité et de conformité de nos clients.

Concrètement :

  • Avant-vente : traduire un besoin en architecture adaptée, et convaincre le client que c’est la plus ingénieuse pour le projet.
  • Déploiement : infrastructure as code, de bout en bout.
  • Audit : conformité HDS et bonnes pratiques des standards Cloud.
  • Développement d’assets : agents, boilerplates, projets open source.

    • À plus long terme, nous voulons t’impliquer dans la structuration des offres et des équipes Theodo.

    Autonome sur ton expertise, fort en équipe

    Sur l'architecture Cloud, tu dois pouvoir être autonome. C'est ton domaine, tu le pilotes.

    Mais tu ne travailles jamais seul. En avant-vente, tu fais équipe avec l'Account Manager et le Solution Architect. En projet, tu collabores avec l'Engineering Manager et les autres DevOps. La collaboration est au centre de chaque mission.

    L'équipe que tu rejoins

    Theodo est certifié infogéreur HDS. Nous avons développé notre propre framework de mise en conformité, et assurons la maintenance HDS d'une vingtaine d'applications en production.

  • Ton manager : Ludovic Descateaux, Group Manager de Theodo Healthtech.
  • En avant-vente : un binôme Account Manager (ex. Marine Accolas) et Solution Architect.
  • En projet : un Engineering Manager (ex. Thomas Walter).
  • L'équipe Run HDS, riche de plus de 50 projets, t'épaule sur les architectures.
  • Tu participes aux guildes Sécu, DevOps, Agentique, et aux rituels hebdomadaires de formation.

    • Tes perspectives d'évolution (moyen / long terme)

  • Business : Partnership, avec la responsabilité d'une plateforme business et/ou d'une practice du groupe.
  • Managériale : Group Manager.

    • Profil recherché

    Expériences

  • 6 à 14 ans d'expérience.
  • Une expertise en infrastructure Cloud.
  • Une expérience en service (ESN ou conseil).
  • Nice to have : Une expérience dans la santé et des notions de réglementation HDS.

    • Compétences clés

  • Concevoir des architectures qui accélèrent le développement tout en respectant la réglementation.
  • Traduire un besoin en architecture adaptée aux contraintes du client.
  • Utiliser les agents LLM de façon structurée pour améliorer la qualité du code.
  • Présenter et convaincre sur la pertinence d'une solution.

    Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

    💼 Un groupe de 700 personnes, avec de vraies possibilités d'évolution cross-entités. 🤝 Un coach interne dédié, avec des séances hebdomadaires sur ton quotidien et ta carrière. 🎯 Des projets associatifs via la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…). 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d'entreprise annuel.

title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

title: Interim Chief Privacy Officer | RVO
descriptionHtml:
Omschrijving

Wij zijn voor de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) op zoek naar een ervaren Interim Chief Privacy Officer (CPO). Binnen de afdeling CIP speel je een sleutelrol in het verder ontwikkelen en professionaliseren van de privacyfunctie binnen een grote en complexe overheidsorganisatie.

Vanwege het vertrek van de huidige plaatsvervangend CPO is tijdelijke versterking nodig om de continuïteit van de privacyorganisatie te waarborgen. Op termijn wordt de functie structureel ingevuld. In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder inrichten en uitbouwen van de CPO-functie, het versterken van de privacy governance en het adviseren van management bij complexe privacyvraagstukken.

Je begeleidt en stuurt privacyfunctionarissen functioneel aan, verbindt verschillende stakeholders binnen de organisatie en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van privacy, compliance en gegevensbescherming.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Verder ontwikkelen, inrichten en positioneren van de Chief Privacy Officer-functie.

  • Functioneel aansturen van privacyfunctionarissen en privacyaanspreekpunten binnen de organisatie.

  • Adviseren van hoger management over complexe privacyvraagstukken.

  • Opstellen, uitvoeren en bewaken van het privacyplan.

  • Doorontwikkelen van privacy governance, privacybeleid en bijbehorende processen.

  • Uitvoeren, begeleiden en beoordelen van Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA's).

  • Deelnemen aan strategische en tactische overleggen op het gebied van privacy en gegevensbescherming.

  • Begeleiden van privacy-audits, onderzoeken en opvolging van verbetermaatregelen.


Wat vragen wij?

Eisen

  • Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding op het gebied van gegevensbescherming, privacy of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Minimaal 2,5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) of plaatsvervangend CPO binnen de Rijksoverheid.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met de toepassing van privacywetgeving, waaronder de AVG, binnen grote organisaties met meer dan 1.000 medewerkers.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met functionele aansturing van privacyfunctionarissen of privacyadviseurs.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen of doorontwikkelen van privacy governance en privacybeleid.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het adviseren van hoger management over privacyvraagstukken.

Pré

  • Relevante privacycertificering, zoals CIPP/E of CIPM.

  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren of beoordelen van DPIA's.

  • Ervaring met het opzetten, vastleggen, inrichten en vervullen van een CPO-functie.

  • Ervaring met privacygerelateerde audits en onderzoeken.

  • Ervaring met Privacy by Design binnen organisatieprocessen of digitale producten.

  • Kennis van en/of ervaring met de EU AI Act en de relatie tussen AI-governance en privacy.

Competenties

  • Overtuigend en verbindend.

  • Bestuurlijk en organisatiesensitief.

  • Analytisch en doortastend.

  • Integer en onafhankelijk in de oordeelsvorming.

Informatie

Opdrachtduur: 7 maanden met optie verlengen

Locatie: Den Haag, met werkzaamheden in Utrecht en Zwolle en deels hybride

Inzet: 24 tot 36 uur per week (voorkeur voor 32 uur per week(

Contractvorm: ZZP

Start: Zo spoedig mogelijk

Geïnteresseerd?

Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor woensdag 04 november voor 09:00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht.

Contact

Voor meer informatie over deze opdracht kunt u contact opnemen met Leonie van Hove, Managing Consultant Interim Management, 06 45 39 02 31, Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Intern Power Electronics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
With over 140 years of Swiss engineering heritage, Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in high-power electrical and electronic equipment. Our solutions power railways, renewable energy, DC and AC networks, and industrial systems worldwide trusted for their precision, reliability, and innovation.
At the heart of modern rail infrastructure, our Traction Power Systems unit delivers cutting-edge DC and AC traction substations, protection systems, power conversion and digital monitoring solutions. Join us to shape the future of sustainable mobility with technology that keeps cities and countries moving.

As an intern within our Traction Power Systems R&D team, you will support the development and validation of power electronic converters and control solutions used in railway and industrial applications. You will work alongside experienced engineers on innovative projects involving power conversion, control algorithms, testing, and system analysis.

The internship has the duration of 6 months and is expected to start in January 2027, but if that is not the best for you, let us know your availability.

Key responsibilities

  • Support the design and analysis of power electronic converters.
  • Assist in the development and validation of control algorithms.
  • Participate in laboratory testing, measurements, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Analyze simulation and test results and prepare technical reports.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation projects within the team.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in power converters, control systems, and electrical energy conversion.
  • Basic knowledge of power electronics and control theory.
  • Familiarity with simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or similar is an advantage.
  • Curious, autonomous, and eager to learn in a hands-on engineering environment.
  • Good communication skills in English.

Benefits

A challenging internship in an international engineering environment.

Exposure to real-world power electronics and railway technology projects.

Mentorship from experienced R&D engineers.

Opportunity to develop practical skills in power conversion and control systems.

title: IT Support Administrator W/M
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France

(and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and

Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and

finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the

best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small

businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon

Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and

much more...

‍‍‍ Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of

the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong

remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of

Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding

ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000

accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact

Every great employee experience starts with great IT.

At Pennylane, our mission is to make technology simple, seamless and secure, so our

teams can focus on building the future of finance.

As an IT Support Administrator, you'll be one of the main points of contact for our

employees. You'll help them stay productive, improve the way we work and contribute to

building an IT environment that scales with our growth.

What you'll do

Deliver an outstanding IT experience

Whether it's resolving technical issues, answering questions or helping employees get the

most out of our tools, you'll make sure every Pennylaner has a smooth IT experience.

Employee onboarding & offboarding

You'll make sure every employee has everything they need before day one.

From day one to the last day, you'll make sure every employee has everything they

need to work successfully.

You'll prepare laptops, provision accounts, manage permissions and introduce new joiners to

our IT environment and security best practices.

You'll also handle offboarding and manage IT operations for freelancers and external

partners.

Keep our IT environment secure

Security is everyone's responsibility. You'll play an important role in making security part of

everyone's daily habits.

You'll help monitor compliance with our internal IT policies, manage software access, review

permissions and contribute to maintaining a secure environment for the whole company.

Manage our internal tools

You'll administer our SaaS ecosystem by creating accounts, managing permissions and

ensuring employees have the right access at the right time.

You'll also help improve how we manage and document our internal tools.

Share knowledge

You'll contribute to building a strong IT culture across the company.

That means writing clear documentation, improving our knowledge base, delivering

onboarding sessions and helping employees adopt best practices around IT and security.

Who are you?

We're looking for someone who combines excellent customer service with strong IT

fundamentals.

Someone who enjoys solving problems, communicating with people and continuously

improving the employee experience.

You won't know every tool we use on day one, and that's perfectly fine.

What matters most is your curiosity, your willingness to learn and your ability to take

ownership.

Why you'll love this role

● You'll work with every team across the company.

● You'll have real ownership from day one.

● You'll continuously improve our internal IT experience.

● You'll play a key role in scaling the internal IT environment of one of Europe's

fastest-growing fintechs.

We'd love to meet you if...

● You enjoy helping people and delivering a great employee experience.

● You have previous experience in IT Support, Workplace IT or IT Administration.

● You're proactive and enjoy taking ownership.

● You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical people.

● You're curious and enjoy learning new tools.

● You're comfortable administering modern workplace tools. Experience with Google

Workspace, Microsoft 365, Jamf, Intune, Okta or similar platforms is a plus.

● You care about security and access management (experience with ISO 27001 or

SOC 2 is a plus).

● You're fluent in English and French.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a

monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and

more than 300 activities related to wellness

You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work

remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum

time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days

(which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar,

fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on

top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue

healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon,

Bordeaux, Nantes...)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as

well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

● To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department

you’re applying to)

● To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

● To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

● Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they

meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a

meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your

exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings

published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional

email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the

recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not

respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that

we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender,

sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If

anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

What you’ll do

  • Identify and implement practical opportunities to improve security, performance, reliability, and employee experience across the IT platform.

Operational responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of identity, endpoint, MDM, SaaS, and automation platforms.

  • Develop and maintain Bash scripts and other scripts that reduce manual work and improve consistency across IT operations.

  • Monitor configurations, deployments, software updates, access, and security controls across managed environments.

  • Investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable solutions.

  • Document systems, workflows, processes, and technical decisions clearly.

  • Collaborate with IT Support, IT Project Management, and other teams on escalated cases and cross-team projects.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint management, identity and access management, or a closely related field.

  • Proficiency in Okta and a solid understanding of identity and access management concepts.

  • Hands-on experience with Jamf, Google Workspace, and Slack.

  • Experience building and maintaining automated workflows with tools such as Okta Workflows, Zapier, Workato, or similar platforms.

  • Practical knowledge of macOS and Windows environments.

  • Proficiency in Bash and scripting, with the ability to automate repetitive administration tasks, integrate systems, troubleshoot issues, and maintain clear and reusable scripts.

  • Proficiency in AI tools for IT operations, automation, or productivity.

  • Experience setting up MCP servers.

  • The ability to provide clear and regular progress updates on owned projects and initiatives.

  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

Nice-to-have

title: Key Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Hozah

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

And we're only getting started. We currently hold a small share of a large market, which means the opportunity ahead, for the business and for the people who join it now, is huge.

The Role

We're hiring a Key Account Manager to win new logos and then grow them. You'll find and open the door at landowners, managing agents, hotel groups and multi-site operators that have never worked with us, win their first site, and then earn the rest of their estate by delivering and building the relationship from the inside.

This is a target-carrying sales role for someone who loves the hunt. Rather than inheriting a book of accounts to farm, you'll build your own: the accounts you develop will be the ones you win, and the commission you earn on them is uncapped. Cold calling and outbound prospecting are a core part of the job, so it suits someone who enjoys both landing the first deal and then multiplying it.

You won't be running site go-lives, resolving driver appeals or chasing operational issues. Our Client Success Managers own the day-to-day running of each account, so your time goes on the commercial relationship, the next site and the next logo.

Key responsibilities

  • Own a named list of target organisations and be accountable for converting them into Hozah clients — from first cold call to signed contract.

  • Own the growth of every account you win: map the estate, build relationships beyond the original buyer, and secure the next sites and additional services.

  • Hit your sales targets. You will carry a new-logo target and an account-expansion target, with commission on both.

  • Run a disciplined outbound engine: daily cold calling, email and LinkedIn sequences, event follow-up and referral asks, with the activity, pipeline and forecast recorded accurately in the CRM.

  • Run the full sales cycle yourself: discovery, site visits, proposals, commercial negotiation and close, with support from the wider team where a deal needs it.

  • Hand each new site to the Client Success Manager cleanly, with the commitments made in the sale written down, and stay the commercial owner of the relationship after go-live.

  • Hold regular commercial reviews with the accounts you own — performance, value delivered, and what else we can do for them.

  • Feed what you learn from prospects and clients back to the CEO, product and operations, so the proposition keeps improving.

Who we're looking for

We'll explore each of these during the interview process, so come ready with specific examples.

  • A track record of winning new logos in B2B sales, with the numbers to show for it: targets carried, attainment over multiple periods, and deals you personally sourced from cold.

  • A track record of then growing those accounts — not a career spent only developing accounts somebody else won. We want to see both halves: the first win and what you turned it into.

  • Genuine comfort with cold calling and outbound prospecting as a daily discipline, and the resilience to keep going through a run of rejections.

  • The ability to run a consultative sale: ask the questions that uncover the real problem, write a proposal that leads with it, and handle price and timing objections without caving or bulldozing.

  • Commercial judgement on deal structure — knowing when to hold price, what to trade, and when a deal is not worth doing.

  • Pipeline and CRM discipline: a real, repeatable routine for managing, prioritising and forecasting a pipeline.

  • Comfort working alongside an operations and customer success team, handing over cleanly and resisting the temptation to become the client's help desk.

  • Willingness to travel to meet prospects and clients in person across the UK.

Useful but not essential: experience selling to landowners, managing agents, hotels, retail or leisure operators, or in parking, property services, facilities management or another multi-site B2B service.

What you get in return

We ask a lot of this role, and we give a lot back.

  • A generous, uncapped commission structure on both new logos and account growth, in a commercial team that already has people earning well above OTE.

  • Real room to grow. We hold only a small percentage of the market, so there's a huge amount of ground still to win and plenty of scope to progress as the commercial team grows.

  • The pace and energy of a fast-growth tech start-up, where your work is visible and your results directly shape the business.

  • A direct line to the CEO while the commercial leadership team is built out, and a seat close to the decisions on pricing, proposition and territory.

  • A proven, cash-generative product with strong references and award-winning technology. You are selling something that works.

  • Client Success Managers who run the operational side, so your time goes on selling and growing.

  • A purpose-driven company reshaping how parking and mobility work, a collaborative culture, and friendly office dogs.

title: Key Account Manager Immobilienwirtschaft (m/w/d) – Wohnungsunternehmen & Bestandshalter
descriptionHtml:
Die besser zuhause GmbH unterstützt Menschen dabei, möglichst lange sicher und selbstständig zuhause leben zu können.
Wir planen und koordinieren altersgerechte Badumbauten und Wohnraumanpassungen – von der ersten Beratung über die Fördermittel bis zur handwerklichen Umsetzung.
Dabei verbinden wir schnelle Prozesse, moderne Planung und echtes handwerkliches Verständnis.

Viele unserer Kunden wohnen zur Miete, oft bei Wohnungsunternehmen, Genossenschaften oder großen Bestandshaltern. Für diese Vermieter sind wir ein verlässlicher Partner: Ihre Mieter können länger selbstständig in ihrer Wohnung leben. Die Umbauten werden fachgerecht ausgeführt und dokumentiert, und die Vermieter haben dabei kaum Aufwand.
Als Key Account Manager verantwortest du diese Partnerschaften von Anfang bis Ende. Du gewinnst neue Partner, pflegst die Beziehung und sorgst dafür, dass Genehmigungen für die Umbauten ihrer Mieter schnell und zuverlässig erteilt werden.
Du bist das Gesicht von besser zuhause in der Immobilienwirtschaft und machst aus Kontakten Kooperationen, die für beide Seiten einfach funktionieren.

Aufgaben

  • Aufbau eines Netzwerks zu Wohnungsunternehmen, Genossenschaften, Hausverwaltungen und Bestandshaltern in unseren Regionen

  • Akquise neuer Partner-Vermieter, von der Erstansprache bis zur festen Kooperation

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Partnerschaften durch regelmäßige Termine und aktive Nachverfolgung

  • Einholen der Vermieterzustimmungen für deine Partner: Du reichst Anfragen ein, fasst nach und begleitest jeden Vorgang bis zur Zusage

  • Klärung von Rückfragen und Bedingungen wie Kaution, Rückbau oder Materialvorgaben, gemeinsam mit Planung und Bauleitung, inklusive Besichtigungsterminen vor Ort

  • Verhandlung von Rahmenvereinbarungen, z. B. vereinfachte Zustimmungsverfahren, abgestimmte Ausführungsstandards und klare Regelungen zu Rückbau und Kosten. Dein Ziel: schnellere Genehmigungen mit weniger Rückfragen

  • Laufende Information deiner Partner zum Stand ihrer Vorgänge, vom Baubeginn bis zur Dokumentation nach der Fertigstellung

  • Weitergabe der Anforderungen jedes Partners an Vertrieb und Planung sowie Briefing der zuständigen Kollegen

  • Präsenz bei Branchenveranstaltungen, Verbänden und Netzwerken der Wohnungswirtschaft

  • Dokumentation aller Kontakte, Vereinbarungen und Vorgänge im CRM

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb oder Key Account Management, idealerweise in der Immobilien- oder Wohnungswirtschaft

  • Verständnis dafür, wie Wohnungsunternehmen, Genossenschaften und Hausverwaltungen arbeiten und entscheiden

  • Ein bestehendes Netzwerk in der Wohnungswirtschaft ist ein großes Plus

  • Verhandlungsgeschick und sicheres Auftreten, auch gegenüber Vorstand und Geschäftsführung

  • Hartnäckigkeit und Verbindlichkeit: Du bleibst dran, bis aus einem Gespräch eine Kooperation und aus einer Anfrage eine Genehmigung wird

  • Freude daran, Beziehungen zu pflegen und dabei auch das operative Nachfassen zu übernehmen

  • Lösungsorientiertes Denken und der Wille, Prozesse für alle Beteiligten einfacher zu machen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, u. a. CRM

  • Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, auch bei vielen parallelen Vorgängen

  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb unserer Regionen und Führerschein Klasse B

Benefits

Was wir Dir bieten:

  • Sinnvolle Projekte mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert

  • Ein modernes, wachsendes Unternehmen mit schnellen Entscheidungswegen

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Wachstum

  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau des Bereichs Immobilienwirtschaft

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Die Möglichkeit, Prozesse und Standards der Branche aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Geschwindigkeit und pragmatische Lösungen zählen

Du teilst unsere Leidenschaft, Motivation und unseren Wunsch nach Erfolg? Dann sende uns noch heute Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen. Hast Du vorab Fragen an das Team?

title: Kundensupport (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Angefangen hat alles vor sieben Jahren als ambitionierte Idee. Heute sind wir Marktführer für Abschlusszeitungen in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr nutzen mehr als zwei Drittel aller deutschen Abschlussjahrgänge die nuggit App, um ihre Abschlusszeitung und ihre Abschlusstextilien zu gestalten und sich damit eine Erinnerung an eine gemeinsame Zeit zu schaffen, die bleibt.

Unsere Mission: Durch digitale Innovation und persönlichen Kundenkontakt sind wir für SchülerInnen der verlässliche Partner bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt. Dafür hinterfragen wir permanent den Status Quo und entwickeln neue, kreative Lösungen.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Unsere Kunden sind SchülerInnen, die gerade ihre Abizeitung oder ihre Abschlusstextilien planen. Für viele ist das ihr erstes großes Projekt. Im Kundensupport (m/w/d) bist du ihre erste Anlaufstelle: per Chat, Telefon und Videocall, von der ersten Frage bis zur Lieferung. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, du bist überall da, wo ein Mensch gebraucht wird. Das heißt viel direkter Kontakt, schnelles Feedback und echte Verantwortung.

Aufgaben

  • Support: Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer SchülerInnen per Chat, Telefon und E-Mail. Schnell, freundlich und so, dass sie danach wirklich weiterkommen.

  • Problemlösung: Wenn etwas hakt, etwa bei Freigaben, Bestellungen oder Lieferterminen, findest du gemeinsam mit unserem Operations-Team eine Lösung und hältst den Jahrgang auf dem Laufenden.

  • Begleitung: Du begleitest Jahrgänge von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung und sorgst dafür, dass kein Projekt untergeht.

  • Video-Sprechstunden: Du führst buchbare Video-Calls, in denen SchülerInnen intensive Unterstützung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen.

  • Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und hilfst dabei, Chatbot und Helpcenter besser zu machen.

  • Feedback: Du gibst weiter, was SchülerInnen bewegt, damit wir Produkt und Abläufe verbessern können.

So arbeiten wir

  • Wir sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt. Sie melden sich nach der Schule, in der Pause oder kurz vor der Deadline. Sie brauchen jemanden, der geduldig erklärt, verlässlich zurückmeldet und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird.

  • Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen.

  • Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich.

  • Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Kundenservice oder Support, idealerweise mit Endkunden. Quereinstieg ist ausdrücklich willkommen, etwa aus Hospitality, Hotellerie, Gastronomie, Einzelhandel oder Jugendarbeit.

  • Du kannst gut mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache und geduldig, wenn dieselbe Frage zum dritten Mal kommt.

  • Du schreibst schnell, klar und freundlich. Am Telefon bist du genauso entspannt wie im Chat.

  • Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Anfragen den Überblick. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks.

  • Du lieferst zuverlässig und meldest dich, bevor jemand nachfragen muss.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Tools wie Chat-, Ticket- oder CRM-Systemen.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind.

  • Du hast eine proaktive Haltung und arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.

Benefits

Unser Angebot

  • Du begleitest jedes Jahr Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt

  • Eine Rolle mit Perspektive: Wenn du willst, übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung

  • Ein kleines Team, in dem deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar ist

  • Kurze Wege und offene Ohren: Ideen landen bei uns direkt beim Entscheider, ohne Zwischenebenen

  • 30 Urlaubstage, Firmenlaptop, Sachgutscheine sowie D-Ticket oder JobRad

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn du die Anforderungen (noch) nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, du aber die Motivation mitbringst, dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen. Wir begrüßen BewerberInnen verschiedenster Hintergründe, ungeachtet ihrer Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, Ethnizität, nationaler Herkunft, sexuellen Orientierung, Migrationsgeschichte, Alter oder Einschränkungen.

title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Lead Engineer - Front End & Design System
descriptionHtml:
Tech Specialist (Front-end & Design System) TL1

  • Location: London, UK - Hybrid

  • Team: Global Engineering - Commerce & Customer Care

  • Visa: This role is based in the UK and requires existing right to work in the UK.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You will be fully embedded in the Customer Care org, specifically working on KAE (Kaluza Agent Experience) which is integral to building and enabling an energy specific agent product for servicing customers across multiple channels and the enterprise design system (Nebula) that will enable the next phase of scale for Kaluza. You will be the design system technical expert for the team and the hands-on bridge between design and engineering, turning design intent into accessible, production-quality React components and patterns, bolstering the existing team members with specific technical depth in building and scaling design systems across internal teams. You will work with designers as equal partners.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Working in a product development team with internal users to understand emerging and existing needs to steer the development of the enterprise design system, and supporting the teams who build with it

  • Working closely with designers as equal partners, and with product and engineering, to help shape the future of the global Agent Experience product and the design system

  • Designing, building and shipping React components and patterns that conform to WCAG 2.2 AA to help the team meet their delivery goals

  • Reviewing code from your colleagues, including contributions from outside the team, and setting the quality bar for design fidelity and accessibility

  • Making the design-to-code workflow work in practice, including design tokens, handoff and component documentation

  • Running the contribution process so that teams beyond our own can propose, build and ship into the design system, and leading changes that affect several apps from first proposal to final migration

  • Creating and delivering against the technical strategy for your team in partnership with the engineering manager

  • Promoting engineering, design and delivery best practices within the team, and coaching the engineers and designers who use the design system

  • Shaping how we use AI-assisted development in design system work

  • Championing progressive architecture and reviewing design solutions with other engineering leaders

  • Representing the design system to engineering and wider stakeholders, and helping set its direction

  • Working within a team of other senior leaders responsible for designing and evolving the architecture of the enterprise design system at Kaluza

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Deep experience building Frontend components with React and TypeScript

  • Deep experience designing, building and running design systems, including tokens, component APIs, documentation and versioning

  • Knowledge of implementing and maintaining WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, with practical empathy for users with accessibility needs

  • Good design and UX judgement, starting from the user, and comfortable challenging and being challenged by designers

  • Experience running changes across multiple apps

  • Strong communication skills, comfortable working with stakeholders across engineering, design, product and the wider business, holding opinions loosely and raising what matters even when it is inconvenient

  • A bias to action and a ‘Can do’ approach to problem solving in the face of uncertainty

  • Experience of mentoring, training and developing other engineers

  • An ability to deliver against a technical strategy iteratively, working through ambiguity to deliver change over longer periods

  • Experience of building and nurturing highly collaborative and engaged teams

  • Comfort with AI-enabled development, ideally leading others in using it well

  • An ability to collaborate with people managers, product managers and agile practitioners to contribute to a high-performing culture

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

Our Perks

  • Pension Scheme

  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme

  • Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP

  • Life Assurance

  • Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app

title: Lead Forward Deployed Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

Today, a key part of delivery has no clear owner: problem framing before configuration begins.

  • On the customer side, there are rarely UX specialists - only domain experts and sponsors who describe needs as pre-formed solutions.

  • On our side, configured workspaces are built by Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) in our Transform team: experts in the platform, accountable for shipping to a deadline, but not trained designers.

  • Our Platform teams have design expertise but are often too far removed from individual implementations to influence the moments that matter most.

The result is pretty predictable: we move quickly into “how” before we are confident about the “what” and “why.”

Your mandate is to slow down at the right moment and make sure we’re solving the right problem - then help the team implement the best platform-valid solution.

This is a founding role. You would be the first Forward Deployed Designer (FDD) at Artificial, hired into an enabling function within the Platform team, with the mandate to define how the function works and to build it out. Later, FDDs would join the Transform teams in hands-on client roles: you’d take part in hiring them (with our support), then line-manage them directly.

Responsibilities

You would work closely with the Transform team and customers throughout discovery and delivery. In practice, that means:

  • Establish the FDD function. Define the operating model, the patterns, and the ways of working from scratch.

  • Grow and manage the team. Take part in hiring subsequent FDDs and line-manage them as they join.

  • Join customer + FDE sessions early (problem framing and discovery), not only at reviews once decisions are already fixed.

  • Translate requests into problems. For example, turn “we need a confirmation button before this step” into:

    • the user behaviour driving the request

    • two or three platform-valid approaches

    • a recommendation, with trade-offs explained

  • Prototype and test ideas quickly using the most effective medium (written specs, wireframes, workflows, or light code). We care more about clarity and platform realism than polished artefacts.

  • Provide credible pushback when the customer’s proposed solution doesn’t address the underlying problem.

  • Codify patterns and precedents so knowledge moves from individual memory into shared team infrastructure.

  • Level up the FDE team’s design instincts over time. You shouldn’t be the only person who can think about UX across the two teams; part of the job is coaching, so the capability can spread.

  • Use workspace signals (e.g. session data and call analysis) to surface risks early - before they become escalations.

About you

You are a designer who thrives in ambiguity and constraints, someone who can bring structure, judgement, and clarity to complex, real-world delivery.

You likely have experience in enterprise/B2B software where:

  • the design system already exists

  • the hard part is framing the right problem and navigating stakeholders

  • solutions must work within meaningful technical and organisational constraints

You understand technical concepts fluently. Part of the role would involve writing code (with plenty of LLM and human assistance) using our in-house DSL (Domain Specific Language). We don’t want you to be an engineer, but we do need you to be comfortable reading and writing some code, reasoning about how a configurable system behaves, and understanding what the platform can and can’t express, well enough to hold a credible conversation with engineers and to explain these constraints to customers when necessary.

You have managed designers. You’re comfortable with line management of a small team (roughly three to five people) and have hired designers before. Early on, you’d do this hands-on yourself; as the function grows, you’d manage the FDDs who follow.

Insurance or Lloyd’s experience is a plus, but is not a requirement. We care more about how you think about complex platforms and stakeholders than about prior domain knowledge, which you can learn here.

We especially want to hear from you if you have

  • Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality.

  • Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Experience in a distributed work environment.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

    As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

title: Lead Fullstack Engineer - Secteur Public -  CDI Paris - Theodo GovTech
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo GovTech, nous accompagnons nos clients - ministères, collectivités territoriales et grands opérateurs publics - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société. Rejoindre notre aventure, c'est partager une ambition commune : utiliser le numérique pour augmenter l’efficacité de l'action publique et améliorer le quotidien des agents et des usagers.

Ton équipe :
Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.

Tes futures missions :
Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet. Tu mobilises ton équipe, fais les choix techniques adaptés au contexte et accompagnes les Software Engineers dans leur progression, avec l’objectif de faire grandir à la fois le produit et les personnes qui le construisent.

  • Garantir le delivery et la qualité du projet
Tu vises un niveau de qualité radicalement supérieur, en structurant le delivery autour de standards :
    • Concevoir des architectures évolutives et résilientes (diagrammes d’architecture clairs et partagés)
    • Rédiger des spécifications précises pour permettre le développement sans bugs de fonctionnalités
    • Mettre en place une stratégie de qualité basée sur : le Clean Code, les tests automatisés, les code reviews
    • Assurer un environnement de travail structuré avec les principes 5S (organisation, clarté, efficacité)
    • Accélérer la vitesse de développement grâce au déploiement des agents IA
  • Être le partenaire technique du client
    • Participer aux routines projet (backlog refinement, daily, cérémonies) et veiller à la satisfaction continue du client
    • Expliquer et défendre les choix techniques pour créer de la confiance et aligner toutes les parties prenantes
  • Créer les conditions de performance de l’équipe
    • Mettre en place un environnement de travail efficace et structuré pour l’équipe projet
    • Mettre en place des boucles de résolution des problèmes via le Daily Problem Solving
    • Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe exploite les LLM et gagne en productivité dans son quotidien
  • Faire progresser les Software Engineers de ton équipe
    • Analyser de manière appronfondie les défauts à la source dans le but d’améliorer les connaissance des équipes (Dantotsu)
    • Former et accompagner l’équipe (pair programming, code reviews, formation)

Les problématiques sont très différentes d'un projet à l'autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • Health Hero : On a aidé HealthHero à scaler une plateforme de télémédecine critique à l’échelle européenne, avec un focus fort sur la qualité et la fiabilité. Résultat : un produit robuste, qui tient la charge et supporte des millions d’utilisateurs sans compromis sur l’expérience.
  • LCL : Développement de la nouvelle néobanque du LCL (L by LCL), une plateforme digitale permettant aux professionnels d’ouvrir et gérer leur compte bancaire en ligne.
Tes perspectives d'évolution :
2 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi:
  • Architecte senior : développer une expertise technique
  • Solution Architect : participer à le vente de projets complexes en définissant les solutions techniques les plus ingénieuses pour nous permettre de gagner
  • Managériale : Engineering Manager
Une méthodologie basée sur l'apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Profil recherché :

  • 4 à 8 ans d’expérience en développement
  • Solide maîtrise des architectures web (front, back, BDD, infra, déploiement) et des pratiques DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Capacité à concevoir des architectures scalables, faire des choix techniques pertinents et garantir un haut niveau de qualité de code.
  • Expérience dans le coaching et l’accompagnement de développeurs, en restant connecté·e à la tech (veille, code, pair programming).
  • Orientation création de valeur et compréhension des enjeux métier du client.
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo GovTech ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?
