title: Legal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role

Legal Engineers turn the product into real outcomes for customers.

You’ll work with customers after purchase to design, configure, and implement legal workflows inside Wordsmith. This role sits close to the customer, helping them embed the platform into how their legal function actually operates.

It’s part implementation, part problem solving, and part advisory. You’ll combine legal understanding with product knowledge to help customers get meaningful value from the platform.

This is a technical, hands-on role. You don’t need to be a lawyer, and we’re not necessarily looking for one. We’re looking for analytical thinkers who are comfortable with technology and ideally have deployed legal tech before — people who can understand how a legal team works, then build the system that supports it. Where the work turns on legal judgement, we already have lawyers as part of the team who can bring the legal expertise.

What you’ll do

1. Customer Implementation

  • Lead implementation projects for new customers

  • Design workflows and automation tailored to each organisation

  • Configure the platform to support real legal use cases

  • Scope implementations for complex enterprise customers — use cases, sequencing, and where value will land first

2. Solution Design

  • Work directly with legal teams and Legal Ops leaders to understand how they operate

  • Translate legal processes into structured workflows and AI-enabled automation

  • Advise on best practices for implementing legal technology

  • Build and adapt playbooks with the customer, bringing in Legal Intelligence where clause language or negotiation positions need a lawyer’s judgement

3. Technical Build

  • Build integrations and connect Wordsmith to customers’ systems, knowing when to bring in Engineering

  • Build agents, skills, automations and workflows, from standard templates to complex multi-step processes

  • Take on complex reports and playbooks, leaving standard ones, such as a basic NDA blueprint, to the wider customer team

4. Escalation & Fixes

  • Reconfigure playbooks and workflows when a customer’s risk appetite or process changes

  • Act as the escalation point for technical issues and complex training questions from Support and Enablement

  • Run deeper health checks where a setup needs technical or process review

5. Customer Success & Expansion

  • Support onboarding and early adoption

  • Help customers expand into additional workflows and use cases

  • Create the template flows Enablement uses to demo and train on standard product workflows

  • Provide on-site embedded support where a customer needs hands-on technical help

6. Product Feedback

  • Surface patterns, insights, and recurring requests to Product and Engineering

  • Help shape how the product evolves based on real usage

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in legal tech, legal operations, or process transformation

  • Strong understanding of how in-house legal teams work

  • Ability to manage customer projects and guide stakeholders through change

  • Comfortable working across legal and technical domains

  • Technical enough to build integrations, agents and automations yourself, and to judge when a problem needs Engineering

  • A fixer’s instinct — comfortable diagnosing a live setup and reworking it when a customer’s needs change

  • Structured thinker — you can turn messy processes into clear systems

  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with customers

Typical backgrounds include

  • Prior Legal Engineering experience

  • Implementation or solutions consultants in SaaS (CLM / Legal Tech is a plus)

  • Legal Operations Professionals

How we work

We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh or London. You should expect to work from the office or visit customers as your default.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. There will not always be an established playbook, so you’ll need to bring curiosity, structure and persistence to unfamiliar situations.

You’ll sit in the Transformation team, reporting to the VP of Transformation, and work alongside Legal Intelligence, Enablement, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product.

Our customer teams have clear but closely connected responsibilities: Transformation leads implementation, Support Engineering resolves technical issues, Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth, Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation, and Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability.

Why Wordsmith

Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding within larger organisations. How legal work gets rebuilt around AI is still being written, and Legal Engineers are the people writing it with our customers.

You’ll work directly with ambitious in-house legal teams, see how dozens of legal functions really operate, and take that back into a product you help shape. It is a rare place to combine legal judgement with building things.

What you'll do

Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a box. It's part legal tech specialist, part product expert, part solutions architect, and part trusted advisor. If you want a role that stays static, this isn't it.

Your mission is to help some of the world's leading law firms get the absolute most out of Legora. You'll understand how lawyers work, how firms operate, and where AI can make the biggest difference — then turn that potential into workflows that deliver real value.

You'll be the person clients call when they want to rethink how legal work gets done — whether that's transforming how a practice group delivers work, embedding Legora across an international firm, or helping partners build the case for AI adoption.

Specifically, you will

  • Act as a genuine thought partner to law firms — understanding their practice areas, commercial priorities and ways of working, then identifying high-value opportunities to transform how legal services are delivered.

  • Own the journey alongside Customer Success from early pilots through onboarding to firm-wide adoption, turning initial use cases into sustained, measurable impact across teams, offices and practice groups.

  • Design and implement workflows around the realities of private practice — from due diligence, contract review and drafting to litigation, regulatory advisory, transactions and knowledge management.

  • Partner with law firm partners, innovation leaders, knowledge teams and practising lawyers to build the case for AI adoption, connecting Legora's capabilities to outcomes that matter to the firm and its clients.

  • Be the voice of the private practice lawyer inside Legora — bringing a deep understanding of legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial realities of law firms into product development, roadmap priorities and strategic direction.

  • Deliver clear, confident product demos, workshops and training that make the potential of Legora tangible for everyone from associates and partners to firm leadership.

  • Help firms navigate one of the most significant shifts in legal service delivery — moving beyond individual productivity gains towards fundamental changes in how legal work is performed, priced and delivered to clients.

  • Document what works, build scalable playbooks and help shape how Legora partners with leading law firms as we grow globally.

What you'll bring

You've worked in private practice and understand the reality of delivering legal advice in a law firm. You know that great legal work isn't just about getting the right answer — it's about delivering exceptional quality under pressure, managing demanding clients, exercising sound judgement and balancing commercial expectations with the highest professional standards.

But you've also never been entirely satisfied with how legal work has always been done. You're curious about technology, drawn to better ways of working, and excited by the opportunity to fundamentally change how law firms operate and deliver value to their clients.

title: Leitung Vertriebsinnendienst und Prozesssteuerung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worms · Vollzeit · unbefristet · Eintritt nach Vereinbarung
Berichtet direkt an: Head of Sales
Führt: Vertriebsinnendienst und Stabsstelle Vertriebscontrolling

Bei NICO entstehen gute Ergebnisse, wenn Menschen, Prozesse und Informationen zuverlässig zusammenspielen: Kalkulationen müssen stimmen, Angebote sorgfältig vorbereitet, Aufgaben klar verteilt und Entscheidungen durch belastbare Zahlen unterstützt werden.

Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die den Überblick behält, Zusammenhänge schnell erfasst und gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Menschen gute Lösungen entwickelt. Sie schaffen so viel Struktur wie nötig und halten Abläufe so einfach wie möglich.

Aufgaben

Ihre Rolle: Sie führen den Vertriebsinnendienst sowie die Stabsstelle Vertriebscontrolling fachlich und disziplinarisch. Dabei verantworten Sie die Organisation und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Vertriebsprozesse. Klassische Kundenbetreuung steht nicht im Mittelpunkt dieser Position.

Sie koordinieren den Gesamtprozess – von Kalkulation und Angebot über Auftrag, Beschaffung und Lieferung bis zu Rechnung, Auswertung und Nachbereitung. Sie sorgen dafür, dass Zuständigkeiten geklärt sind, Informationen fließen und Entscheidungen auf verlässlichen Daten beruhen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Sie führen Ihr Team klar, wertschätzend und nah am Arbeitsalltag.

  • Sie steuern und verbessern die internen Vertriebsprozesse über alle Prozessschritte hinweg.

  • Sie koordinieren insbesondere die Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Buchhaltung und Logistik und beziehen IT sowie weitere beteiligte Bereiche rechtzeitig ein.

  • Sie klären Zuständigkeiten, Übergaben, Freigaben und Vertretungen und verfolgen Vereinbarungen verbindlich nach.

  • Sie erkennen Informationslücken, unnötige Arbeitsschritte und wiederkehrende Fehlerquellen und entwickeln mit den Beteiligten praktikable Lösungen.

  • Sie setzen digitale Werkzeuge zur Arbeits- und Projektorganisation ein, um Aufgaben, Termine, Ziele und Verantwortlichkeiten transparent zu machen.

  • Zusammen mit dem Vertriebscontrolling sorgen Sie für aussagekräftige Kennzahlen, nachvollziehbare Auswertungen und eine verlässliche Datengrundlage.

  • Sie prüfen Zahlen auf Plausibilität, erkennen Abweichungen und Zusammenhänge und leiten daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Sie bereiten Informationen für den Head of Sales verständlich auf und geben einen realistischen Überblick über laufende Themen, Entwicklungen und mögliche Engpässe.

  • Auch wenn viel gleichzeitig zusammenkommt, setzen Sie klare Prioritäten und geben Ihrem Team Orientierung.

Qualifikation

Was Sie mitbringen:

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir keine reine Verwaltungskraft, sondern eine Führungspersönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Prozess-, Zahlen- und Datenverständnis.

  • Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertriebsinnendienst, in der Vertriebsorganisation, im Vertriebscontrolling oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion

  • Erfahrung in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Mitarbeitenden

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für kaufmännische Gesamtprozesse – von Kalkulation und Angebot bis zu Lieferung, Rechnung und Auswertung

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der bereichsübergreifenden Prozesskoordination

  • Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, Auswertungen kritisch zu prüfen und verständlich einzuordnen

  • Erfahrung in der Dokumentation, Vereinheitlichung und Verbesserung von Abläufen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP- beziehungsweise Warenwirtschaftssystemen und den gängigen Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel

  • Eine verbindliche Kommunikation, ein respektvoller Führungsstil und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind hilfreich

Wie wir zusammenarbeiten möchten

Wir wünschen uns eine Führungskraft, die zuhört, nachfragt und die Erfahrung ihres Teams einbezieht. Gleichzeitig erwarten wir, dass Sie Entscheidungen treffen, Prioritäten setzen und vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent umsetzen.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.

We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team.

Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

  • Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

  • Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

  • Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

     
 

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

  • Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission

  • Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

  • Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

  • Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

 

Example Projects

  • Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

  • Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

  • Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

 

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.

We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here.

Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

 

About Linkup

 

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

title: MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer to help us in our mission by supporting the electrical design, development, maintenance and documentation of test equipment and automated functional tests required to verify our spacecraft, engineering models and test beds, to ensure that our mission will succeed and our system will work in space!

Key Responsibilities

In your role as a MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, your role will include the following responsibilities:

  • Define and assess electrical test equipment and functional test needs for flight hardware as well as engineering models and test beds

  • Translate system and subsystem requirements into traceable functional test procedures, sequences and objective pass/fail criteria

  • Design, build, troubleshoot and maintain electrical test equipment and its software, with a focus on electrical engineering and test interfaces

  • Develop and integrate electrical test equipment, instrumentation, cabling and interfaces for power, communication and measurement activities

  • Develop and maintain automated functional test software, scripts and data acquisition for electrical test equipment

  • Prepare and maintain test documentation, including schematics, interface definitions, procedures, test results and verification evidence

  • Support and perform unit-, subsystem- and system-level electrical and functional tests on engineering and flight hardware

  • Analyze test results, troubleshoot anomalies, document non-conformances and support their resolution and retest

  • Manufacture and assemble test-equipment components

  • Participate in environmental tests and launch campaigns.


What we would love to see from you

In the role of MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, ideally you will bring the following skillset, mentality and experience:

  • Degree in aerospace engineering, electrical engineering or comparable qualification

  • Practical experience with electrical/electronic components and systems, ideally in spacecraft AIT or functional verification

  • Experience developing functional tests from requirements, including test procedures, acceptance criteria, traceability and test-data review

  • Theoretical understanding as well as practical experience with electrical test equipment and test interfaces:

    • Electrical design and integration of test equipment, including instrumentation, cabling, connectors, and power and signal interfaces

    • Physical assembly of test equipment (building racks, routing cables, etc.)

    • Familiarity with network configuration and network protocols (TCP/IP) used by test systems

  • Ability to develop software for test equipment and automated functional tests in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand; experience with Python or similar is an asset

  • Experience with data acquisition, test automation and troubleshooting on electrical test equipment

  • Exposure to Mission Control Software platforms like CCS5, COSMOS or similar; experience with COSMOS is a plus

  • Experience with communication and power test equipment is an asset

  • Ability to read, understand and apply technical manuals, data reports, electrical schematics and design specifications

  • Willingness to work hands-on with flight hardware

  • Joy in embracing technical problems and the process of solving them

  • Sense of responsibility and a clean and organized way of working

  • Fluent in written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel worldwide for test and launch campaigns.

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
BeyondMath is a pioneering startup, backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to reshape the frontiers of engineering through Foundational AI models for Physics. We are replacing traditional, slow, and expensive simulation methods with AI that rivals accuracy at orders of magnitude higher speed.

We are moving beyond the "generic AI" hype to solve the world's hardest physical engineering challenges in automotive, consumer electronics, aerospace, and energy. We are looking for a Marketing Manager to be our first dedicated marketing hire: a hands-on operator who will build and run the channels, materials and events that put our technology in front of the engineers who need it.

The Role

As Marketing Manager, you are the person who makes BeyondMath's marketing actually happen. This is an execution role, not a strategy role: you will report to our GTM Lead, who sets direction with the CEO and COO, and you own turning it into a steady, high-quality stream of output across our social channels, our go-to-market materials and our events calendar.

You will work closely with the leadership team, our GTM and technical account teams, and our engineers and researchers, turning deeply technical work with global OEMs, Formula 1 teams and aerospace innovators into content and moments the market notices. You will not inherit a marketing machine; you will build one, with real autonomy, a direct line to leadership, and the BeyondMath brand system already in place to work from.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Our Social Channels: Run BeyondMath's LinkedIn and other relevant channels day to day — content calendar, copy, visuals, scheduling, community engagement and reporting — with a consistent voice and an on-brand look.

  • Content Production: Turn product releases, customer results, research and team news into posts, short articles, case studies, one-pagers and short-form video, working directly with engineers and researchers to get the technical detail right.

  • GTM Materials & Preparation: Support the GTM team with decks, one-pagers, proposals, demo collateral and follow-up materials, and maintain a current library of on-brand templates they can pick up and use.

  • Events Calendar & Attendance: Own the events calendar across industry conferences, partner events and executive dinners or roundtables. Plan BeyondMath's presence end to end: selection and budget, sponsorships, speaker slots, booth and materials, logistics, attendee outreach, onsite execution and post-event follow-up and reporting.

  • Owned Events & Webinars: Produce BeyondMath-hosted moments — technical webinars, customer roundtables, launch events — from concept through follow-up.

  • Website, Email & Digital: Keep website content current (news, case studies, careers), look after basic SEO hygiene, and run newsletter and email communications to prospects and partners.

  • Brand Guardianship: Apply and maintain the BeyondMath brand guidelines across all internal and external materials, and brief and manage freelancers or agencies (design, video, PR) where needed.

  • Measurement: Track channel, content and event performance, report simply on what is working, and keep marketing data in the CRM clean and usable for the GTM team.

About You

  • You have a "founder's mentality": you are a builder who is comfortable being the first person in a function, and who will set up the system and then run it yourself.

  • You take pride in output. You would rather ship ten strong posts and two excellent events than write one strategy deck.

  • You are at home with deeply technical subject matter and genuinely curious about engineering, simulation and AI. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to enjoy working with them.

  • You are organised, detail-obsessed and reliable across many concurrent deadlines, and you bring a calm, can-do attitude to a fast-moving team.

Essential Requirements

  • Experience: 3–7 years' B2B marketing experience, ideally in a startup or scale-up and ideally in technology, software, engineering or deep tech.

  • Social Channel Ownership: A hands-on track record running company social channels, LinkedIn in particular — content calendars, copywriting, visuals, community management and analytics.

  • Events Delivery: Proven experience planning and delivering B2B events and conference attendance end to end, including sponsorships, logistics and onsite execution.

  • Writing: Strong writing and editing. You produce clean, accurate copy quickly and can work with engineers to make complex things clear without dumbing them down.

  • Tooling: Working proficiency in presentation and design tools (PowerPoint or Google Slides, Canva or Figma) and everyday marketing tooling (CRM and email, social scheduling, web analytics).

  • AI-Native: Fluent, daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) across your marketing workflow.

  • Travel: Willing and able to travel for events across the UK and Europe, with occasional travel further afield.

Highly Desirable

  • Technical Audiences: Experience marketing to engineering, manufacturing or industrial audiences (automotive, aerospace, energy, motorsport), or within CAE, simulation or engineering software.

  • First Marketer: Experience as the sole or first marketing hire in a company.

  • Video: Short-form video production and editing for social.

  • CRM & Web: Working knowledge of a B2B CRM and a website CMS.

  • PR: Experience with press, media relations and announcements.

Why Join Us?

  • Full Ownership: You will own how BeyondMath shows up in the market — our channels, our materials and our events — and build the marketing function from the ground up.

  • High Impact: Your work puts our technology in front of the engineers designing the next generation of sustainable transport and energy systems.

  • Elite Team: Work alongside veterans from world-leading AI labs and top-tier engineering teams in a culture of "impact with integrity."

descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

 

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

Design and build the machines, fixtures, and tooling used to manufacture HTS magnet coils.

Develop the manufacturing processes that turn new equipment into a repeatable production line.

Work hands-on with technicians to build, debug, and commission equipment on the shop floor.

Own equipment and process development together, from clean-slate concept through production readiness.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Design new manufacturing equipment and fixtures for magnet manufacturing; from concept generation and trade studies through the whole equipment life cycle.

Perform proof-of-concept calculations, benchtop testing, and tolerance stack-up analysis to validate design decisions before committing to build.

Own subsystem designs, BOMs (Bills of Materials), specifications, and drawings, and manage changes as designs mature.

Develop, coordinate and document assembly procedures, commissioning and operation for the equipment you design.

Support technicians during equipment build, assembly, and commissioning.

Supporting the production team troubleshooting issues and iterating on design or process as needed.

Drive non-conformances to root cause and turn findings into concrete process or design improvements.

Provide DFM (Design for Manufacturing)/DFA (Design for Assembly) input to magnet design engineers to keep coil designs manufacturable.

Select and manage external vendors and machine shops for components, subassemblies, and fabricated parts.

Recommend equipment, tooling, or facility improvements needed to scale manufacturing capacity as production ramps.

Participate in design reviews, and communicate design and process decisions clearly to cross-functional partners.

WHO YOU ARE

4–6 years of experience in mechanical design or manufacturing engineering, ideally building complex electromechanical systems, automated equipment, or precision assemblies.

Strong CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred) including GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) and drawing creation for fabrication and inspection.

Experience designing parts and equipment across multiple manufacturing processes: machining, sheet metal, welding, fabricated assemblies.

Hands-on experience building, assembling, and debugging equipment or prototype, not just designing on paper.

Solid technical writing skills for work instructions, assembly procedures, and design documentation.

Comfort with ambiguity and rapidly changing requirements in a fast-paced startup environment.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have:

Exposure to automation systems, control cabinets, PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers), or industrial sensors.

Experience with FEA (Finite Element Analysis) tools (SolidWorks Simulation, Ansys) for structural or thermal analysis.

Familiarity with cryogenics, vacuum systems, or superconducting/high-precision electromechanical hardware.

Experience with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)/MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) tools for BOM and change management.

Rapid prototyping skills: 3D printing, mill, lathe, or hand tools.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. title: Member of Technical Staff
descriptionHtml:
About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Product Engineer owns the surfaces people actually work in. A coordinator planning a month of inspections across a fleet of auditors. A reviewer signing off on a technical file. These are dense, stateful workflows where the interface carries real consequences, and where the person using it has done the job for twenty years and will know immediately if the software doesn't understand it.

You own product surface end to end: the interface, the backend that supports it, and the data model underneath. Every customer runs the work differently, so there's no template to fall back on. You decide what the right thing to build is, build it, and are the one who hears about it when it's wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about raw engineering strength than about matching a list of technologies. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, C++ or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, speed and standards are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've built something hard and put it in front of real users. Not a prototype, not a course project. Something that ran, broke, and got fixed.

  • You build genuinely good interfaces, and you can go as deep on the backend as the feature requires.

  • You can hold a complicated workflow in your head and find the version of it that's simple enough to ship.

  • Speed with taste. You ship fast, and you're opinionated about what not to build.

  • You go to the source. You'll read the customer's actual documents, join the actual call, and look at hundreds of real outputs.

Signals we like, none of them required:

founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, early engineer at a startup with a serious engineering culture, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup, design sense you can defend, open source you genuinely maintain.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

title: Microsoft 365 & Intune Administrator:in (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind das Rückgrat einiger Non-Profit-Organisationen in Berlin. Wir bauen verlässliche und sichere IT-Lösungen, damit sich Vereine, Stiftungen und NGOs auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren können: ihre Mission. Bei uns baust du IT, die trägt – statt Tickets abzuarbeiten.

Unsere Kund:innen sind Organisationen wie das Deutsche Kinderhilfswerk, die Technologiestiftung Berlin oder die Weltbank Group – Menschen, die mit ihrer Arbeit etwas verändern. Und du sorgst dafür, dass ihre IT verlässlich funktioniert.

Deine Rolle

Du bist bei uns die Person für Microsoft 365 und Intune. Du entscheidest, wie ein Tenant aufgesetzt ist, welche Richtlinien für Konten und Geräte gelten und wie die Daten vom alten Fileserver sauber in SharePoint landen. Bevor bei Kund:innen etwas umgebaut wird, planst du es – von der Bestandsaufnahme über das Zielbild bis zum Cut-over – und setzt es anschließend mit dem Team um. Unser IT-Support arbeitet nach deinen Standards und spiegelt dir, was im Alltag hakt.

Was du bei uns machst

Microsoft 365 & Entra ID

  • Tenants aufsetzen und aufräumen: Rollen, Lizenzen, Gruppen, Gastzugriffe und klare Namenskonventionen

  • Exchange Online betreuen: Postfächer, Verteiler, Mail-Flow, Spam- und Phishing-Schutz, SPF, DKIM und DMARC

  • SharePoint und Teams so strukturieren, dass Seiten, Bibliotheken und Berechtigungen auch in zwei Jahren noch verständlich sind

  • Identitäten absichern: MFA, Conditional Access, Notfallkonten und Rechtekonzepte in Entra ID

Intune & Endgeräte

  • Windows-Geräte über Intune verwalten: Konfigurations- und Compliance-Richtlinien, Updates und App-Rollouts

  • Geräte-Rollouts und Windows-11-Umstellungen planen und durchziehen, gern mit Autopilot

  • Microsoft Defender for Business einrichten und Meldungen bewerten

  • Apple-Geräte einbinden, wo Kund:innen gemischt arbeiten, über Intune und Apple Business Manager

Migrationen & Projekte

  • Bestandsaufnahmen bei Kund:innen durchführen und daraus ein Zielbild entwickeln: Wo soll die IT in ein bis zwei Jahren stehen?

  • Umzüge planen und umsetzen: vom Fileserver nach SharePoint, von Google Workspace zu Microsoft 365, von Tenant zu Tenant oder raus aus dem lokalen Active Directory

  • Den Plan selbst mit umsetzen: Testlauf, Cut-over am Wochenende, Rückfallebene und Nachbetreuung der Nutzer:innen

  • Konzepte so aufschreiben, dass Geschäftsführung und Vorstand entscheiden können: mit Varianten, Kosten und Risiken

  • Aufwände realistisch schätzen und Angebote gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung vorbereiten

Copilot, KI & Automatisierung

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot und andere KI-Tools bei Kund:innen einführen – mit aufgeräumten Berechtigungen, Vertraulichkeitsbezeichnungen und geklärtem Datenschutz

  • Wiederkehrendes automatisieren: PowerShell, Microsoft Graph oder Power Automate

Support & Schulung

  • Zweite Eskalationsstufe für alles rund um Microsoft 365 und Endgeräte – vor Ort in Berlin

  • Technische Entscheidungen verständlich begründen, auch gegenüber Geschäftsführungen ohne IT-Hintergrund

  • Kurze Security- und Anwendungsschulungen für Mitarbeitende unserer Kund:innen

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du arbeitest überwiegend vor Ort: im Büro in Schöneberg und ab und an bei unseren Kund:innen in Berlin, dazu bis zu 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche.

  • Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker:in Systemintegration oder mindestens zwei Jahre Praxis in der Administration

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 auf Administrationsebene: Tenant-Struktur, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Intune: Richtlinien, Compliance, App-Rollouts – du definierst Standards, statt sie nur anzuwenden

  • Du denkst erst in Konzepten, dann in Klicks: Du hast schon eine Microsoft-365-Migration oder ein größeres Geräte-Rollout selbst geplant und durchgezogen und kannst das verständlich aufschreiben

  • Verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit KI: Du nutzt KI-Tools gern und prüfst ihre Ergebnisse, bevor sie bei Kund:innen landen. Du führst kein Skript aus, das du nicht verstehst, und gibst Kundendaten nur in freigegebene Tools

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Du erklärst Technik klar, freundlich und mit Geduld

Nice to have

  • Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie MS-102, MD-102 oder SC-300

  • Erfahrung mit Autopilot, Defender for Business oder Microsoft Purview

  • Tenant-zu-Tenant-Migrationen oder das Ablösen von Entra ID Hybrid-Setups

  • Berührungspunkte mit Google Workspace oder Apple-Geräteverwaltung

  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft-Lizenzen für gemeinnützige Organisationen und Berührungspunkte mit Non-Profit, NGO oder Stiftung

Du fühlst dich eher in der ganzen Breite zu Hause, mit Netzwerk, Backup und Security? Dann schau dir auch unsere Stelle als IT-Administrator:in für Non-Profits an.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gehalt: 48.000 – 68.000 € brutto/Jahr (je nach Erfahrung)

  • Vollzeit, 40 Stunden pro Woche

  • Arbeit mit Sinn: du unterstützt Organisationen, die gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest, wie unsere Microsoft-365-Standards aussehen – kein Konzern-Freigabeprozess

  • Kleines, wachsendes Team mit kurzen Wegen

  • KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag: bereitgestellt und erwünscht, mit klaren Regeln

  • Einladendes Büro (guter Kaffee!) in Berlin-Schöneberg und 1–2 Homeoffice-Tage pro Woche für Konzepte, Doku und Skripte

  • Bezahlte Fortbildungen, etwa für Microsoft-Zertifizierungen

  • Regelmäßig gemeinsam raus – Teamreise in die Berge oder ans Meer

  • Deutschlandticket oder Gym-Mitgliedschaft, dazu 50 € Sachbezug im Monat

title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the role

As a Mid-level Software Engineer at Ledgy, you’ll build reliable, scalable product experiences that help companies manage their equity with confidence. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn complex equity workflows into clear, automated, user-friendly software.

This role is a strong fit if you’re ready to take ownership of well-scoped projects, grow your technical judgement, and contribute across the stack while learning from senior peers.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

Teams we are hiring for:

  • Core Equity — Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy’s equity engine. Every equity-related event — such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership — generates transactions. This team defines and maintains the transaction logic, data model, and core domain behaviour that ensure Ledgy’s platform remains accurate, scalable, and compliant. They also enable employees to sell their shares seamlessly once vested.
  • Workflows & Automation — Focuses on automating complex equity workflows and integrating with third-party services, including the trading exchange. The team builds systems that help company admins efficiently onboard and offboard employees, automate equity grants and terminations.
  • Reporting — Transforms Ledgy’s core equity data into financial, operational, and compliance reports. The team manages large, complex datasets and ensures reporting is accurate, performant, and reliable across jurisdictions and company structures. Their work powers the insights companies and auditors rely on for decision-making and transparency.
  • Tax — Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.

You will thrive in the role if you

  • You have 3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer
  • You are comfortable building and shipping production-quality features across the stack
  • You enjoy learning complex domains and turning them into simple, maintainable product experiences
  • You care about clean, tested, readable code and thoughtful collaboration
  • You are curious about equity, financial workflows, and their real-world impact on companies and employees
  • You’re excited to grow your technical judgement through code reviews, pairing, and architecture discussions
  • You take ownership of your work while asking for input early when trade-offs are unclear

Our Tech Stack*:

We have a modern, cohesive stack that lets us move fast while maintaining quality:

  • Language: TypeScript
  • Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC
  • Backend: tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, Temporal
  • Infrastructure: GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions

*We don’t expect proficiency in this specific stack

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Be paired with an onboarding buddy who will introduce you to the world of equity management
  • Get to know your engineering team, product managers, and designers
  • Learn how your team’s domain connects to the broader Ledgy platform
  • Set up your development environment and start contributing small, well-scoped changes
  • Build familiarity with our codebase, product workflows, and engineering practices

First 3 months:

  • Ship product features and improvements with increasing independence
  • Work with teammates to break down problems, understand trade-offs, and deliver reliable solutions
  • Participate actively in code reviews and team discussions
  • Develop a deeper understanding of how companies manage and automate equity
  • Contribute to improving quality, maintainability, and user experience in your team’s domain

First 6–12 months:

  • Own medium-sized features from implementation through release
  • Collaborate with Product and Design to shape pragmatic, user-centric solutions
  • Contribute to technical discussions around data models, workflows, and scalability
  • Continue growing toward senior-level ownership, judgement, and impact

The interview process:

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
    • Hackerrank take-home assessment (30-45mins) - this is a test to assess core coding cability
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session focused on practical problem-solving, clear trade-offs, and how you structure technical thinking
  • Behavioural (45 min): Answer behavioural style questions about your experience, using the STAR method - with a PM and EM.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy’s mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means:

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.
  • For candidates based in London or Zurich we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.

title: ML Research Intern in Agentic Runtime Systems
descriptionHtml:
Our mission

Constructor’s mission is to enable all educational organisations to provide high-quality digital education to 10x people with 10x efficiency. 

With strong expertise in machine intelligence and data science, Constructor’s all-in-one platform for education and research addresses today’s pressing educational challenges: access inequality, tech clutter, and low engagement of students.

Please send your resume in English only.

Interns are NOT eligible for equipment and other benefits as the position is temporary.

The Reality

The frontier models are converging into commodities; the engine is no longer the differentiator. The scarcity in 2026 is not the model.

We are not looking for people to fine-tune Llama on toy datasets or write "better prompts." We are building the runtime systems that turn probabilistic token generation into reliable workers that finish 50-step tasks without spiraling. We are solving the math of multi-step reliability through engineering, not wishful thinking.

What You Will Solve

You will work on the Agentic Harness, treating the LLM as a component within a larger, deterministic control system. Your research will focus on:

  • Architecting loops that survive error accumulation. You will build verification layers that force the agent to recognize its own hallucinations and self-correct.
  • You will implement systems where the agent compiles its own constraints and the harness enforces them via constrained decoding or external execution.
  • You will optimise KV-cache hit rates and design "restorable compression" strategies to prevent attention decay.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for systems thinkers who happen to know ML, not the other way around.

  • You know that a demo is not a product. You are interested in the "boring" engineering: state machines, retries, idempotency, serialisation — that actually makes agents work.
  • You are comfortable working with the raw output of the model and building robust software in Python or Rust around it.
  • You understand why dynamic tool loading destroys inference economics. You prefer deterministic guardrails over "prompting it to be nicer."
  • You are willing to read a 500-line trace of a failed agent loop to find the exact moment the context drifted. You care about the "last mile" of reliability.

What We Offer For Interns:

  • Internship Duration: from 2 months or more 
  • Type of internship:
    • 100% remote
    • or hybrid in the office in Bremen (GER), Sofia (BG), Belgrade (SRB), Istanbul (TR), Sakarya (TR), Singapore (SGD)

title: ML Systems Engineer — Inference Acceleration
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

Optimize the execution and serving of modern AI models on Arago's custom accelerator. Work across kernels, model execution, multi-device distribution, runtime, and inference serving, while helping shape the software stack around the capabilities of Arago's hardware.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in high-performance ML inference, GPU/accelerator programming, or ML systems engineering.

  • Deep understanding of computer architecture, accelerator/GPU execution models, memory hierarchies, parallelism, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Experience developing and optimizing custom kernels using CUDA, Triton, ROCm/HIP, or equivalent low-level programming environments.

  • Experience with operator fusion, tiling, scheduling, data movement optimization, graph execution, and profiling of compute- and memory-bound workloads.

  • Strong understanding of distributed model execution, including tensor, pipeline, sequence, and/or expert parallelism and communication/computation overlap.

  • Hands-on experience with modern inference-serving systems such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or equivalent, including KV-cache management, continuous batching, paged attention, and prefill/decode scheduling.

  • Strong C++ and Python skills, and comfort working on a custom accelerator stack where compiler, runtime, kernels, and abstractions are actively being developed. Exposure to or experience with MLIR and MLIR dialects is a strong plus.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze modern AI workloads and identify kernel-, runtime-, memory-, and system-level bottlenecks on Arago's accelerator.

  • Develop and optimize custom kernels, fused operators, and execution strategies to maximize device utilization.

  • Design efficient mappings of models and operators across multiple Arago devices, including communication and synchronization strategies.

  • Develop inference-serving techniques such as continuous batching, paged KV caches, prefix/context caching, chunked prefill, and prefill/decode interleaving or disaggregation.

  • Build profiling, benchmarking, and performance-analysis infrastructure spanning kernels, full models, and serving workloads.

  • Work closely with Arago's hardware, compiler, and runtime teams to co-design software abstractions and influence future hardware features based on real model workloads.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

title: Nordics Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Nordics Marketing Manager

Retire the ERP

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

Finance deserves better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.

The Role

We're looking for a Nordics Marketing Manager to make Light the default finance platform for scaling companies across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland. You can base yourself in Copenhagen or London.

Light started life in Copenhagen, and the Nordics already know us. Founders, CFOs and finance leaders in the region backed us from the start, and our local community gives us a head start most challengers would envy. Your job is to take that energy to new heights, so that when a Nordic finance team outgrows its current setup, Light is the obvious next move.

You'll own the Nordics marketing plan end to end. You'll have a B-line into our Nordics GTM pod, which spans sales, implementation and customer success, and you'll work closely with our central growth team to find new ways to drive demand through digital channels.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and running the Nordics marketing plan, with pipeline targets you share with the GTM pod.

  • Running a field and events programme across Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo and Helsinki and… any other city you think makes sense. From intimate CFO dinners to flagship moments people talk about for months.

  • Growing partnerships with the accounting firms, advisors, investors and communities that Nordic finance leaders trust and extends our voice across the region.

  • Localising our story, content and campaigns so they land with Nordic finance teams in their own language and context.

  • Creating content with our customers, product and design teams that turns what Light does into stories people want to share.

  • Working with our central growth team to test and scale digital demand generation in the region.

  • Building relationships with local press and the people who shape the Nordic tech and finance conversation.

What we think* you'll need

  • Enough years in the seat to know what works at a fast-growing company, ideally because you've built the ground game for a scaling B2B SaaS business before.

  • A track record across field, events, partnerships and content, and the judgment to know which lever to pull and when.

  • Experience localising a brand and its message for a region, with a feel for what lands with Nordic audiences.

  • Comfort working with sales, implementation and customer success as one team, with pipeline as the shared goal.

  • Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping finance teams and the companies they serve.

  • A great storyteller across video, text and meme.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant assholes here, please.

  • Fluency in English and at least one other Nordic language.

  • A passport. Expect regular trips across the Nordics and to our teams in London, Munich, New York and elsewhere.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don't tick every box, we'd still love for you to reach out and convince us you're the right person.

The Good Stuff

  • A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in Copenhagen or London.

  • A competitive salary and potential stock options.

  • 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays in the country where you're based.

  • Regular socials and two company off-sites a year.

  • The chance to shape a category from the inside, in the region where Light began.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

The Nordics gave Light its first customers, its first champions and its first team. We want to repay that by becoming the finance platform every scaling Nordic company runs on, and we want you to lead the charge. If you know the region, love building from the ground up and want to help retire the ERP for good, let's talk.

title: Onboarding Manager
descriptionHtml:
Über Cosuno

Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Volumen, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du bekommst jede Woche neue Kunden zugewiesen, die sich nicht selbst aktiviert haben, und führst sie durch das Onboarding: Erstkontakt innerhalb weniger Tage, Onboarding-Call per Screenshare, Profil und Suchprofil einrichten, erste Angebote begleiten. Rund 40 Onboardings im Monat, jedes etwa anderthalb Stunden Gesamtaufwand inklusive Vorbereitung und Nachfassen.

Du misst dich nicht am abgehaltenen Call, sondern am Kunden, der danach selbst weitermacht. Dafür verfolgst du die Aktivierungssignale jedes Kunden in Salesforce und greifst nach, wo einer hängen bleibt.

Du bist die Person im Unternehmen, die am häufigsten sieht, wo Neukunden scheitern. Dieses Wissen gibst du strukturiert an Product weiter, damit Tool Tips, Product Tours und Hilfetexte besser werden und mehr Kunden sich selbst aktivieren.

Du berichtest an den Head of Customer Success und arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team, das die Kunden abschließt, und mit den Customer Success Managern, die bei Kündigungen übernehmen.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Mindestens 90 % deiner Kunden sind 30 Tage nach dem Onboarding aktiv – Profil vollständig, Suchprofil eingerichtet, erstes Angebot abgegeben.

  • Jeder zugewiesene Kunde hat innerhalb von drei Werktagen von dir gehört.

  • Salesforce ist bei dir vollständig: Onboarding-Status, Aktivierungssignale, Hürden – bei jedem Kunden.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Wenn ein Kunde nach 30 Tagen nicht aktiv ist, fragst du zuerst, was du anders hättest machen können.

  • Speed. Du rufst heute an, nicht nächste Woche. Ein Kunde, der drei Wochen wartet, hat Cosuno vergessen.

  • Drive. Du hast schon einmal ein Skript, eine Checkliste oder einen Ablauf gebaut, weil der alte nicht funktioniert hat – ohne dass dich jemand gebeten hat.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du gern erklärst und dabei merkst, wann dein Gegenüber wirklich verstanden hat – und wann es nur nickt.

  • du 40 Gespräche im Monat als Rhythmus empfindest, nicht als Last.

  • du nach dem dritten Nichterreichen zum vierten Mal anrufst, zu einer anderen Uhrzeit – unsere Kunden stehen auf der Baustelle.

  • du Handwerksbetriebe magst und mit einem Dachdecker genauso sprichst wie mit einer Büroleitung.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Onboarding als Schulung verstehst und nach dem Call abhakst.

  • du Tickets abarbeiten willst statt Kunden hinterherzutelefonieren

  • du zehn Kunden intensiv betreuen möchtest statt vierzig in die Nutzung zu bringen.

  • dich eine Zahl über deinem Schreibtisch stresst statt motiviert.

Harte Anforderungen

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr in einer kundennahen Rolle mit Volumen: Onboarding, Customer Support mit Aktivierungsziel, Inside Sales, Kundenservice im B2B.

  • Sicher im Erklären von Software per Telefon und Screenshare.

  • Strukturiert und CRM-diszipliniert.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2), Englisch gut.

  • Berlin oder Bereitschaft zu Bürotagen.

Vergütung

55.000 € OTE pro Jahr (Zielgehalt bei 100 % Zielerreichung), bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt und einer variablen Komponente, die sich nach deiner Zielerreichung richtet.

Was wir bieten

  • Klarheit: Eine Zahl, ein Playbook, direkter Einfluss auf dein Ergebnis – und auf das Produkt.

  • Entwicklung: Die Rolle ist der Einstieg in Customer Success bei Cosuno; der nächste Schritt ist Retention Sales oder Produkt-Enablement.

title: Growth & Performance Marketing Multiplayer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Berlin · hybrid, in Ausnahmen remote · 20 Stunden pro Woche bis Vollzeit

Bewerbungen und CVs bitte auf Deutsch - Danke!

Du denkst Marketing ganzheitlich. Und kannst Performance nachweisen.

Du weißt, wie aus Marketingideen qualifizierte Anfragen und neue Kunden werden. Du denkst in Zielgruppen, Botschaften, Kampagnen und Conversions – und verstehst, wie alles zusammenspielen muss.

Dein Fundament ist Performance Marketing. Du hast Google-Ads-Kampagnen eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und kannst konkrete Ergebnisse vorweisen.

Aber du schaust auch über den Anzeigenmanager hinaus: Du erkennst Potenziale in Landingpages, Creatives und Funnels, entwickelst eigene Ideen und bringst sie gemeinsam mit unserem Team auf die Straße.

Du musst nicht jeden Kanal beherrschen. LinkedIn Ads und Meta Ads sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Wir suchen keinen reinen Kampagnen-Operator und keinen Generalisten ohne Tiefgang. Sondern einen Marketing-Multiplayer, der Performance beherrscht, Growth ganzheitlich denkt und gerne im Team gewinnt.

Wer wir sind

DigitalBegleiter ist eine Marketing- und Designagentur aus Berlin mit Schwerpunkt B2B.

Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische Unternehmen im DACH-Raum, viele davon inhaber- oder familiengeführt. Daneben arbeiten wir mit ausgewählten B2C-Marken und Personal Brands und sind an eigenen Unternehmen beteiligt.

Wir verbinden Strategie, Performance Marketing und Design zu einer integrierten Full-Service-Unit. Dabei arbeiten wir direkt mit Geschäftsführern und Marketingverantwortlichen zusammen – ohne unnötige Abstimmungsschleifen.

Wir mögen gute Ideen. Noch lieber mögen wir Ideen, die funktionieren.

Deshalb messen wir unsere Arbeit nicht nur an Reichweite und Klicks, sondern vor allem an qualifizierten Anfragen und messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen.

Unser Team ist klein, eingespielt und anspruchsvoll. Jeder übernimmt Verantwortung, bringt eigene Ideen ein und hat Lust, gemeinsam richtig gute Arbeit zu machen.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Du machst aus Marketing messbare Ergebnisse.
Du planst, steuerst und optimierst Performance-Kampagnen mit einem klaren Ziel: qualifizierte Anfragen und wirtschaftlich sinnvolles Wachstum.

Google Ads hast du im Griff.
Du entwickelst Kampagnenstrategien, baust Konten sauber auf und optimierst sie eigenverantwortlich. Du verstehst, welche Hebel wirklich etwas bewegen – von der Kampagnenstruktur über Gebotsstrategien bis zur Conversion-Optimierung.

Du denkst über den Anzeigenmanager hinaus.
Du erkennst, wenn eine Landingpage, eine Botschaft, ein Creative oder ein Angebot der entscheidende Hebel ist. Gemeinsam mit unseren Designern und Projektownern entwickelst du Lösungen, statt nur Symptome in Kampagnen zu optimieren.

Du entwickelst Ideen, bevor jemand danach fragt.
Du analysierst Zielgruppen und Märkte, erkennst Potenziale und bringst neue Kampagnenansätze, Konzepte und Tests ein. Du wartest nicht auf das nächste Briefing.

Du hast Daten und Tracking im Griff.
Du sorgst für verlässliches Conversion-Tracking, analysierst Kampagnenergebnisse und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Deine Reportings sind verständlich, nachvollziehbar und liefern echte Entscheidungsgrundlagen.

Du nutzt KI als selbstverständliches Werkzeug.
Für Analysen, Recherche, Texte, Ideen oder Automatisierungen. Du probierst neue Möglichkeiten aus und hilfst uns, unsere Arbeit besser und effizienter zu machen.

Du bist Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden.
Du bist in Calls, Workshops und Strategiegesprächen dabei, verstehst Geschäftsmodelle und kannst deine Ideen und Empfehlungen souverän vertreten.

Du gestaltest unsere Arbeitsweise mit.
Ob Prozesse, Tools oder neue Leistungen: Du bringst dich ein, hinterfragst Bestehendes und hilfst uns, als Agentur besser zu werden.

Was du mitbringst

Einen nachweisbaren Track Record im Performance Marketing.
Du hast Kampagnen eigenverantwortlich gesteuert, Budgets betreut und kannst anhand konkreter Projekte zeigen, welche Ergebnisse du erzielt hast. Du weißt nicht nur, was theoretisch funktionieren sollte, sondern hast es in der Praxis bewiesen.

Sehr gute Google-Ads-Kenntnisse.
Google Ads ist für uns Pflicht. Du beherrschst Kampagnenstrukturen, Gebotsstrategien, Conversion-Tracking und laufende Optimierung. Du kannst ein Konto selbstständig übernehmen, bewerten und weiterentwickeln.

Ein breites Verständnis von digitalem Marketing.
Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Zielgruppen, Positionierung, Werbebotschaften, Creatives, Landingpages und Conversion-Raten. Du musst nicht alles selbst umsetzen können, weißt aber, worauf es ankommt.

Strategisches und unternehmerisches Denken.
Du schaust nicht nur auf CPCs und Conversion-Raten, sondern verstehst, welche Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden tatsächlich relevant sind.

Eigeninitiative und konzeptionelle Stärke.
Du erkennst Chancen, entwickelst eigene Ideen und machst daraus konkrete Vorschläge. Du kannst sowohl strategisch denken als auch operativ umsetzen.

Technische Affinität.
Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Consent-Tools, CMS und Shopsysteme schrecken dich nicht ab. Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge und kannst Tracking-Anforderungen eigenständig vorantreiben.

Einen selbstverständlichen Umgang mit KI.
Du nutzt KI-Tools bereits in deinem Arbeitsalltag und hast Lust, neue Anwendungen und Automatisierungen auszuprobieren.

Kommunikationsstärke und Teamgeist.
Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen, bist zuverlässig, kommunizierst direkt und offen und kannst deine Empfehlungen gegenüber Kunden überzeugend vertreten.

Sehr gutes Deutsch.
Du formulierst überzeugende Anzeigentexte, verständliche Konzepte und klare Empfehlungen.

Das wäre ein Plus – aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit LinkedIn Ads

  • Erfahrung mit Meta Ads

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, insbesondere mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten und Dienstleistungen

  • Erfahrung mit Landingpage-Optimierung und Conversion Rate Optimization

Du musst nicht in jeder Marketingdisziplin Spezialist sein. Entscheidend ist, dass du Performance nachweislich beherrschst, Marketing ganzheitlich denkst und Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Was wir dir bieten

Flexibilität, die zu deinem Leben passt.
Du kannst mit 20 Stunden pro Woche einsteigen oder bis zu 40 Stunden arbeiten.

Ein Studio mit Charakter.
Unser helles, kreatives Studio in Berlin bietet viel Raum für konzentriertes Arbeiten, Austausch und gemeinsame Ideen. Wir arbeiten hybrid. In Ausnahmefällen ist auch vollständig remote möglich. Mehrwöchige Remote-Phasen sind grundsätzlich kein Problem.

Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement.
Uns interessieren Ergebnisse, nicht abgesessene Stunden. Du bekommst Freiraum, eigene Entscheidungen zu treffen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Mitgestaltung statt starrer Prozesse.
Du kannst unsere Tools, Abläufe und Angebote aktiv mitentwickeln. Gute Ideen landen bei uns im Projekt, nicht im Backlog.

Direkten Draht zu Entscheidern.
Du arbeitest eng mit Inhabern, Geschäftsführern und Marketingverantwortlichen zusammen. Keine unnötigen Hierarchien, kein Ticket-Pingpong.

Ein kleines Team mit hohem Anspruch.
Du arbeitest mit erfahrenen Designern und Projektownern zusammen, die ihr Handwerk verstehen, Verantwortung übernehmen und Wert auf gute Zusammenarbeit legen.

Abwechslungsreiche Projekte.
Von B2B-Techunternehmen über mittelständische Dienstleister bis zu ausgewählten B2C-Marken, Personal Brands und eigenen Beteiligungen: Du lernst unterschiedliche Geschäftsmodelle kennen und entwickelst passende Lösungen.

Die richtigen Werkzeuge.
Du bekommst die Hardware, Software und KI-Tools, die du für richtig gute Arbeit brauchst.

Kurze Wege und schnelle Entscheidungen.
Wir diskutieren Ideen, treffen Entscheidungen und setzen um. Ohne unnötige Meetings und lange Freigabeschleifen.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Schick uns einfach ein paar Zeilen über dich, deinen Lebenslauf und gerne ein oder zwei Kampagnen oder Projekte, auf die du besonders stolz bist.

Besonders spannend finden wir: Was war die Herausforderung, was hast du gemacht und was ist dabei herausgekommen?

Sag uns außerdem kurz, wann du frühestens starten könntest.

Ein Anschreiben-Roman ist nicht nötig.

Uns interessiert, was du kannst, wie du denkst und worauf du Lust hast.

Dein Ansprechpartner:
Robin · Geschäftsführer und Teamkollege

descriptionHtml:

  • Integrate the solution with other software and platforms (e.g. chat tools) to streamline operations

  • Analyse data to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to enhance operational efficiency

  • Develop and update training materials, documentations and user guides

  • Collaborate with customer support, IT, and other departments to understand business needs and implement solutions

Qualifications:

  • Experience in a fast paced operations environment

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously

  • Strong understanding of operation platform workflows and processes

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Partnerships Lead, UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Partnerships Lead to build and scale Tandem Health's strategic partnerships across the UK. You will play a key role in accelerating our growth by identifying and securing high-impact partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem, including NHS organisations, private healthcare providers, hospital groups and healthtech platforms.

You'll own the full partnership lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and building senior relationships through to negotiating agreements, launching partnerships and driving commercial value. Working closely with our commercial, product and leadership teams, you'll help unlock new routes to market, expand our distribution and establish Tandem as a leading AI partner to UK healthcare.

What You Will Do

  • Originate and manage partnership opportunities end-to-end, from initial outreach and business development through to commercial negotiations, contracting and launch.
