title: Senior HPC Engineer, GPU Compute
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior HPC Cluster Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking. 
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads). 
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication. 
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking. 
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments. 
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems. 
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing. 

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

title: Senior HR Advisor
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our People team are the architects of a great workplace where brilliant minds come together to do their best work. From discovering diverse talent and nurturing future leaders, to creating spaces that spark collaboration and crafting rewards that celebrate success—we’re passionate about building a culture where everyone can thrive.

We’re looking for a Senior HR Advisor to join our Manchester team. This is a hybrid role. You’ll help us deliver a fair, consistent and high-performing employee experience by leading complex employee relations, strengthening manager capability and using people insights to improve how we work across our Merchant organisation.

Get to know our People team—what drives us, how we work and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the UKI People team, primarily supporting our Merchant organisation. Employee relations sits at the heart of the role, alongside a broader focus on employee experience, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Employee Relations and Case Management

  • Manage a varied and complex end-to-end caseload across performance, probation, absence, grievances and disciplinaries.
  • Provide clear, practical advice that balances employee experience, commercial needs, employment law and organisational risk.
  • Build trusted relationships with managers, helping them address concerns early and confidently challenging where needed to achieve fair and consistent outcomes.
  • Respond to sensitive employee and manager concerns with sound judgement, discretion and professionalism, ensuring issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
  • Maintain accurate and timely case documentation, delivering a consistently high standard of support across competing priorities.

Employee Experience and Engagement

  • Partner with managers, leaders, and People colleagues to create an environment where employees feel heard, valued and supported.
  • Use employee feedback, case themes and engagement insights to identify emerging concerns and opportunities to improve the employee experience.
  • Support feedback channels and targeted engagement activity, ensuring themes are followed through and actions are clearly communicated.
  • Coach managers on the behaviours and everyday practices that influence engagement, performance and retention.

Root-Cause Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Use case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify hotspots and underlying factors, such as onboarding, management capability or gaps in existing processes.
  • Turn insights into practical interventions that reduce avoidable cases and improve employee and manager experiences.
  • Recommend continuous improvements to People policies, guidance and processes, helping us deliver support with greater consistency and efficiency.
  • Identify recurring employee or manager questions and improve the guidance, tools and self-service resources available to them.

Manager Capability and Coaching

  • Coach and upskill managers through sensitive people matters, helping them build the confidence and judgement to handle issues effectively.
  • Deliver practical sessions on employee relations policies, UK employment legislation and effective people management.
  • Guide managers towards the right People tools and resources, encouraging greater self-sufficiency while remaining available for complex or higher-risk situations.
  • Communicate complex processes and decisions clearly to a range of audiences, adapting your approach to the situation and the people involved.

People Partnering and Strategic Support

  • Partner with leaders across our Merchant organisation, building a strong understanding of their teams, priorities and people challenges.
  • Support core People processes, including performance calibrations, engagement activity and organisational change.
  • Use data and people insights to support leadership discussions and inform practical, evidence-based decisions.
  • Contribute to targeted UKI People projects and work collaboratively across the wider People team to deliver meaningful improvements.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience managing complex end-to-end employee relations cases within a fast-paced environment, backed by up-to-date knowledge of UK employment law.
  • Strong advisory and coaching capability, with a proven ability to constructively challenge managers and balance commercial risk with employee experience.
  • Sound judgement and the confidence to navigate sensitive or ambiguous situations with limited direction.
  • An analytical mindset, with experience using case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify root causes and deliver proactive HR solutions.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, including the ability to maintain accurate documentation, meet deadlines and deliver consistently across multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex or sensitive information clearly to a range of audiences.
  • A high level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential employee information.
  • A collaborative and adaptable approach, with experience building trusted partnerships across teams and influencing without direct authority.
  • Confidence using HR systems and digital tools to manage work, identify insights and improve the employee and manager experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting commercial, operational or technology-led business units.
  • Broader exposure to, or an interest in, HR Business Partnering and organisational design.
  • Experience supporting employee listening, engagement or retention initiatives.
  • Experience improving HR guidance, self-service tools or digital processes to increase adoption and make support easier to access.
  • Familiarity with people analytics or AI-enabled tools and an interest in how emerging technology can improve HR decision-making and operational efficiency.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here, you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Make a visible impact every day
    Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
  • 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment
    Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
  • 🧠 Build a career, not just a role
    Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
  • 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture
    Join collaborative, values-driven teams that support you to do your best work.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes three to four stages. You can find out more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior HR advisor / Senior HR Adviseur
descriptionHtml:
Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers

Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior HR Advisor:

  • draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid;

  • werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. Je hebt een stevige inhoudelijke HR-basis, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder: waar kunnen processen beter, welke impact heeft een verandering op de organisatie en wat hebben managers en medewerkers nodig?

Je bent kritisch wanneer dat nodig is, praktisch wanneer het kan en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • ervaring met strategische HR-projecten, beleidsontwikkeling of organisatieverandering;

  • het vermogen om strategisch te adviseren én betrokken te blijven bij de operationele HR-praktijk;

  • affiniteit met HR-technologie, HR-data, AFAS en procesoptimalisatie;

  • uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • beschikbaarheid van 32 tot 40 uur per week.

Wat bieden wij?
In cijfers:

  • Een bruto salaris tussen €4.000,00 en €5.000,00 (op basis van je ervaring);

  • Een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé vinden wij belangrijk: 30 vakantiedagen per jaar en de mogelijkheid om meer bij te kopen;

Voor je eigen duurzaamheid:

  • Deelname aan de pensioenregeling van Priva;

  • Opleidingsmogelijkheden via onze eigen Priva Academy.

Klaar om jouw HR-expertise in te zetten én écht invloed te hebben op hoe we HR binnen Priva verder ontwikkelen? Breng je strategische blik, praktische aanpak en verbetermentaliteit mee en bouw samen met ons aan een HR-organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.

title: Senior Infrastructure Manager
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader.

In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed.

The Team You Will Lead

You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms.

You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in:

  • On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.
  • Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused.
  • Cloud environments: GCP and AWS
  • Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

The Operational Reality

It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

  • Context Switching is the Norm
    • You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve.
  • Agility over Silos
    • Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.
  • Focus Management
    • Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time.

As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will:

People Leadership & Talent Development

  • Team Management
    • Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management.
  • Formal Training & Growth
    • Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports.
  • Recruitment & Retention
    • Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture.
  • Culture of Learning
    • Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference.

Strategic & Operational Management

  • Budget & Capacity Planning
    • Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware.
  • Risk & Contingency
    • Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity.
  • Procedure & Frameworks
    • Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards.
  • Prioritisation
    • Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations.

Technical Support & Oversight

  • Performance Optimisation
    • Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them.
  • Visual Documentation
    • Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor.
  • Hybrid Estate Management
    • Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments.
  • Unblocking Issues
    • Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover.

General Duties

On-Call DutiesWillingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-HocCarry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations.

Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

Leadership & Management Competencies

  • Proven Management Experience
    • Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc).
  • Project Management
    • Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment.
  • Communication
    • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members.
  • Goal Oriented
    • You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met.
  • ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma
    • Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts.

Technical Environment & Team Capabilities

Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions.

For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration.

Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation.

  • Innovation & Debt Management
    • A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt.
  • Advanced Containerization
    • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems.
  • Observability
    • Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana).
  • Data Streaming
    • Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid.
  • Web & Storage
    • Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster.
  • Tooling
    • Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation.
  • Version Control
    • strong understanding of Git and version control best practices.

Why This Role?

If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business

This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical Insurance through Vitality
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Eye Care Vouchers
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As our Launch Manager, you’ll own the end-to-end delivery of our partner onboarding, from kick-off through go-live and post-launch activities, turning complex, regulated brokerage integrations into predictable, high-quality launches.

Our partner universe is evolving: alongside our direct business with fintechs and neobanks, we’re building a combined offering with dwpbank, bringing a new wave of partners and increased cross-organization complexity. We’re therefore building a dedicated Launch Manager function to run these onboardings with clear ownership.

In this setup, you’ll provide the coordination we’re building, driving the launch plan, steering stakeholders, and ensuring a clean handover to Partner Management once the partner is live. You’ll sit at the center of cross-functional execution, aligning Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions (and, where relevant, dwpbank) to keep delivery on time, within scope, and operationally sound.

In this role you will:

  • Lead end-to-end partner launches by owning the onboarding plan, milestones, and delivery rhythm across Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions — so partners go live faster and with fewer surprises.

  • Drive alignment and decision-making between partnership leads, product counterparts, and executive sponsors — so scope, priorities, and trade-offs are clear and execution stays on track.

  • Design and continuously improve an onboarding playbook (templates, checklists, risk log, status reporting, launch criteria) to standardize onboarding and scale partner delivery without scaling chaos.

  • Own stakeholder communication and reporting to leadership, internal steering committees, and partner counterparts — so progress, risks, and dependencies are transparent and manageable.

  • Manage complex/time-sensitive post-launch activities (feature expansions, new functionalities, operational changes) so existing partners can grow their offering without destabilizing day-to-day operations.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in launch management or project/program management within brokerage, fintech, or banking environments.

  • You have a deep understanding of B2B onboarding, including how to structure plans, manage dependencies, and steer stakeholders through complex delivery.

  • You bring strong financial services domain expertise (brokerage knowledge is a plus) and can translate regulatory/operational constraints into actionable delivery plans.

  • You have led complex cross-functional teams across business, product, engineering, and second-line functions, driving outcomes without formal authority.

  • You are comfortable mixing methods (waterfall, agile, hybrid) and pragmatically using tools like onboarding plans, risk logs, and reporting to get the job done.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and complexity, take ownership end-to-end, and can zoom out for the plan while still digging into the messy details needed to execute.

  • Communicate exceptionally well in English and German (C1+) building trust quickly, leading tough conversations calmly, and keeping momentum across senior internal and external stakeholders.

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 day or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

title: Senior Lead, Trade Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

Role Purpose 

The Senior Manager, Global Compliance Risk Assessment designs and runs ASM's global compliance risk assessment program. The main focus is export control, with wider coverage of general compliance risks. The role gives leadership a clear, data-driven view of compliance exposure and makes sure risks are identified, prioritized and mitigated before they affect the business. In doing so, it protects market access, revenue and reputation. 

Key Responsibilities 

  1. Global Risk Assessment Framework
  • Design, implement and maintain a risk-based framework for export control and general compliance across all regions and business units. 
  • Define the risk methodology, including scoring, likelihood and impact criteria, risk appetite and escalation thresholds. 
  • Run the annual global compliance risk assessment and targeted assessments when the business or regulations change. Examples include new markets, products, customers and export control developments. 
  1. Export Control Risk (Primary Focus)
  • Assess risks under U.S. (EAR), EU (Regulation 2021/821), Japanese, Singapore, Korean and Chinese export control regimes. 
  • Evaluate exposure in high-risk areas, such as:  
  • Classification 
  • Licensing 
  • End-use and end-user due diligence screening 
  • Technology transfer and deemed exports 
  • Spare parts and service 
  • U.S. Persons Rules 
  • Assess the business impact of new regulations, such as BIS rules, entity list expansions and China countermeasures, and translate it into concrete mitigation actions. 
  • Test the effectiveness of the Internal Compliance Program (ICP) and of system controls, for example in ERP and Teamcenter. 
  1. General Compliance Risk
  • Extend risk assessment to general compliance related risks. 
  • Work with Internal Audit so there is one consistent view of risk and no duplication. 
  1. Monitoring, Testing and Assurance
  • Develop and carry out a risk-based compliance monitoring and testing plan, including site and process reviews in Europe, the U.S. and Asia. 
  • Identify control gaps and root causes, agree corrective actions with the business, and track them to closure. 
  • Prepare the organization for regulator inquiries, government audits and external reviews. 
  1. Reporting and Governance
  • Produce clear, executive-level risk reporting for the Corporate Director, the Management Board, the Audit Committee and the Supervisory Board. 
  • Maintain the compliance risk register and key risk indicators (KRIs). 
  • Turn complex regulatory risk into business terms such as revenue at risk, operational disruption and reputational impact. 

Qualifications and Experience 

Required 

  • Master's degree in Law, Business, Economics, International Trade, Finance or a related field. 
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience, including significant experience in internal audit, compliance risk assessment or risk management. 
  • Proven track record of designing or running risk assessment or audit programs in a multinational environment. 

Competencies 

  • Analytical and risk-based thinking, with the ability to set priorities 
  • Business acumen: positions compliance as a business enabler, not a barrier 
  • Clear, concise communication at executive and Board level 
  • Independence, integrity and sound judgment 

Travel 

International travel of about 20–30%, mainly to the U.S. and Asia.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

title: Senior long-term oil analyst
descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
About the Role

As a Senior Long-Term Oil Analyst, you will own Kpler’s strategic multi-decade outlook for crude oil, refined products, and alternative liquid fuels within the evolving global energy system. Bridging macro-economic forecasting and physical trade flows, you will anchor long-term supply, demand, and transition scenarios directly into Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level intelligence. In this high-visibility research role, your insights and published analysis will guide executive decision-makers, commercial traders, and investors navigating structural market transformations, capital allocation, and decarbonization pathways.


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead long-term market research and scenario modeling: Spearhead Kpler's multi-decade (5 to 25+ year) research coverage and fundamental supply, demand, and trade scenarios for crude oil, refined products, NGLs, and low-carbon fuels.
  • Analyze structural market drivers and transition pathways: Deliver in-depth research on upstream capital investment, OPEC+ and non-OPEC capacity shifts, refinery configuration trends, transport electrification, and evolving environmental policies.
  • Anchor macro projections in granular trade flows: Leverage Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level tracking to translate multi-decade macro perspectives into actionable implications for regional balances, trade routes, refining margins, and midstream infrastructure.
  • Author authoritative research publications: Produce regular, high-impact outlook publications, strategic research notes, and thematic market commentary under Kpler’s Insights banner, clearly framing key assumptions and structural uncertainties.
  • Synthesize cross-commodity dynamics: Collaborate with Kpler’s Gas, LNG, and Power research analysts to ensure cohesive, system-wide market assumptions, while benchmarking models against international agencies such as the IEA, EIA, and OPEC.
  • Serve as a trusted market authority: Represent Kpler’s research in executive client briefings, commercial advisory sessions, industry webinars, and specialist media engagements.

    • Experience & Background

    Essential:

  • 5+ years of prior experience in energy market analysis, energy modelling or strategy, with a focus on oil and liquids markets

title: (Senior) M&A Manager Healthcare (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
(Senior) M&A Manager Healthcare (w/m/d)

München – Vollzeit, Hybrid-Modell, mit VSOP

Du willst nicht einfach nur Deals abschließen, du willst die hausärztliche Versorgung in Deutschland nachhaltig verändern.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Zahlen, hier geht es um Menschen, die dank deiner Arbeit wieder rechtzeitig die richtige Behandlung erhalten.

10–20 Telefonate pro Tag, mehrere Parallel‑Deals und ein Jahresgehalt von bis zu 120 k € sind für dich Normalität, nicht Ausnahme.

Unser Kunde

Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Digital Health und moderne medizinische Versorgung mit Sitz in München.

Das Unternehmen verbindet klassische hausärztliche Versorgung mit digitalen Lösungen und baut deutschlandweit ein Netzwerk moderner Praxen auf. Ziel ist es, Versorgung für chronisch kranke Patienten messbar besser zu machen und gleichzeitig Ärzten moderne Strukturen zu bieten.

Die Rolle sitzt direkt an der Schnittstelle aus Healthcare, Wachstum, Strategie und M&A.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Du führst M&A-Prozesse eigenständig von Erstkontakt bis Signing

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Ärzten und Praxisinhabern statt nur mit Datenräumen

  • Du bekommst viel Verantwortung in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Management und Investorenumfeld zusammen

  • VSOP-Beteiligung sorgt dafür, dass Wachstum nicht nur auf PowerPoint existiert

  • Hohe Sichtbarkeit und echter Einfluss auf die Expansion

  • Die Mischung aus Healthcare, Verhandlung, Beziehungsebene und M&A ist selten. Viele reden über „Impact“, hier beeinflusst deine Arbeit tatsächlich Versorgungstrukturen.

Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst den gesamten Akquisitionsprozess von Arztpraxen und MVZs deutschlandweit

  • Du führst Verhandlungen direkt mit Praxisinhabern und Entscheidern

  • Du koordinierst externe Partner für Legal, Financial und Commercial Due Diligence

  • Du baust Beziehungen zu Ärzten, Maklern und relevanten Netzwerken auf

  • Du steuerst mehrere parallele Deals und behältst Timelines, Risiken und Erfolgswahrscheinlichkeiten im Blick

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre nachweisbare M&A‑Erfahrung mit direkter Akquisition von Hausarztpraxen oder MVZs, inklusive erfolgreich abgeschlossener Transaktionen

  • End‑to‑End‑Deal‑Ownership: Du hast eigenverantwortlich von der Sourcing‑Phase bis zum Closing gesteuert

  • Ausgeprägte operative Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Deals gleichzeitig zu managen

  • Stark ausgeprägte Beziehungs‑ und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten gegenüber Praxisinhabern und Ärzt:innen

  • Masterabschluss (M.A., M.Sc. o. Ä.)

  • Deutsch C1‑Niveau und exzellente Kommunikations‑ sowie Empathiefähigkeiten

  • Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise und idealerweise Erfahrung im Healthcare‑Umfeld

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Keine praktische Erfahrung im Erwerb von Arztpraxen oder MVZs – reine M&A‑Theorie reicht nicht

  • Nur beratende Tätigkeiten ohne eigenständige Transaction‑Ownership

  • Unzureichende Deutschkenntnisse (unter C1) – direkte Kommunikation ist Kernaufgabe

  • Schwache Stakeholder‑Kommunikation und fehlende Beziehungspflege zu Ärzt:innen

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

title: Senior Manager, Australia Communications
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is building technology for the defence challenges of today and tomorrow. In Australia, that means working with the ADF, industry and partners to develop and deliver capabilities that can make a difference in the defence of our nation.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Communications to help tell that story. You will turn complex programs and technology into clear, credible communications for Australian audiences. You will lead media engagement, develop narratives around our work, support senior leaders and help the team communicate through major milestones and fast-moving issues.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can set direction, write exceptionally well and deliver at pace. You will work across the Australian business and with colleagues internationally, balancing long-term reputation building with the demands of a busy news cycle.

The Australian business is growing rapidly, with over 300 employees, so this role will also support our internal comms work, engaging our employees and making sure our people are bought into the mission.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and execute communications plans that support Anduril’s priorities in Australia.
  • Build relationships with defence, technology, business and national media; identify opportunities to tell substantive stories about our work.
  • Write and edit announcements, speeches, opinion pieces, briefing materials, social content and executive messages.
  • Advise Australian leaders on messaging, interviews, speaking opportunities and sensitive issues.
  • Work with program, engineering and business teams to understand their work and explain its relevance to customers and the broader public.
  • Plan communications for product and program milestones, partnerships, events and other significant moments.
  • Manage reactive media enquiries and help prepare for issues or crises with sound judgement and clear processes.
  • Coordinate with global communications colleagues so Australian communications reflect local priorities and the company’s wider direction.
  • Own internal communications for Anduril Australia, keeping employees informed about business priorities, program milestones and decisions that affect their work.
  • Partner with Australian leaders to plan and deliver clear, timely updates, including all-hands meetings, leadership messages and major announcements.
  • Help teams understand how their work contributes to Anduril’s mission, connecting progress across programs, functions and locations.
  • Measure what is working and improve plans based on outcomes, feedback and changes in the external environment.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience in communications, media relations or public affairs, including ownership of complex projects from strategy through execution.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to make technical subjects understandable without losing accuracy.
  • Strong knowledge of the Australian media and policy environment, ideally including defence, national security or technology.
  • A record of advising senior leaders and working in executive communications
  • Confidence working directly with journalists and handling sensitive or high-stakes issues.
  • The curiosity to learn how a product works, the judgement to know what matters to an audience, and the discipline to check the details.
  • A practical, collaborative approach and the ability to move between strategic planning and hands-on delivery.
  • Aligned on the mission and the opportunity and challenge that faces our nation today
  • A sense of humour and a collaborative spirit!

Experience in technology, defence, government or a similarly complex sector would be valuable. What matters most is your ability to earn trust, find the real story and communicate it clearly.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. title: Senior Manager, Commercial Sales (South)
descriptionHtml:

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Proven sales management experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with a track record of exceeding goals as both an individual contributor and a team leader — cybersecurity or endpoint security experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in an indirect, two-tier go-to-market model that includes channel partners and distributors, with a solid understanding of how to maximize reach and performance through partner ecosystems.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. title: Senior Mass Properties Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Senior Mass Properties Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and lead mass properties engineering activities for the Microliner aircraft. You will be responsible for establishing, maintaining, and communicating the aircraft mass properties baseline throughout the development lifecycle. Working closely with the Overall Aircraft Design, Airframe, Systems, Propulsion, Technology, Flight Physics, and Configuration Management teams, you will guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in establishing reliable mass data and consolidate this information into a consistent, traceable, and configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline.

As a senior member of Central Engineering, you will provide mass properties expertise across the organization, support technical and programme decision-making, and ensure that mass properties objectives are consistently considered throughout design, verification, certification, and production.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead mass properties engineering for the Microliner across aircraft, system, subsystem, and lower levels, ensuring reliable, traceable, and configuration-controlled mass data throughout design maturation, verification, certification, and transition into production.

  • Maintain, further develop, analyse, and communicate the consolidated aircraft mass properties baseline.

  • Manage and continuously refine mass targets, allocations, margins, and weight-saving objectives in collaboration with aircraft, system, and discipline owners.

  • Guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in estimating, substantiating, and maintaining mass properties data for their respective scope, providing methods, quality assurance, and configuration-control guidance.

  • Perform aircraft weight and balance analyses, including operational loading conditions, centre-of-gravity envelopes, loading scenarios, and compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements.

  • Evaluate mass properties across aircraft configurations, managing applicability, effectivity, and consistency within the aircraft mass model.

  • Assess and communicate the mass-properties impact of design changes, technical trades, system integration decisions, and configuration changes.

  • Define mass properties verification and weighing requirements, and coordinate with suppliers and system owners to ensure that measured data is appropriately substantiated, reconciled, and incorporated into the configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline.

  • Further develop and continuously improve mass properties processes, methods, tools, reporting, governance, and interfaces with configuration management and the wider engineering toolchain.

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Minimum 8 years of professional experience in aircraft mass properties engineering, preferably within the development and certification of civil aircraft under EASA CS-23 or FAA Part 23. Relevant experience from CS-25/Part 25, military or eVTOL development is also considered.

  • Experience with the mass properties of battery-electric aircraft, electric propulsion systems, high-voltage systems, or other electric aviation technologies is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated experience managing aircraft mass properties throughout the product development lifecycle, including mass estimation, target setting, allocation, tracking, reporting, configuration control, and the incorporation of substantiated mass data into the aircraft baseline.

  • Strong expertise in aircraft weight and balance, centre-of-gravity envelope development, loading analysis, moments of inertia, mass margins, uncertainty management, and mass-properties substantiation.

  • Demonstrated experience working across the complete aircraft product hierarchy, from aircraft-level mass objectives and operational loading conditions through system, and lower-level hardware mass data, ensuring consistency and traceability between levels.

  • Good understanding of aircraft design, systems integration, configuration management, certification, and the interaction between mass properties, aircraft performance, structures, stability and control, and operational capability.

  • Proficiency with mass properties databases and analysis tools, as well as experience integrating mass data within product lifecycle management and configuration-controlled engineering environments; experience with Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE is a strong plus.

  • Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong ownership of aircraft-level outcomes, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate mass properties implications effectively across technical disciplines and programme stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset

  • Strong motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

     

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it?

AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.

Why a designer now

We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market.

That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Product Designer, you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster.

You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set.

Journeys and engagement

  • Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit.

  • Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky.

  • Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data.

Growth surfaces

  • Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels.

  • Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from.

Craft and UI ownership

  • You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence.

  • During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent.

Design system and enablement

  • Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan.

  • Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with.

How you work

  • You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision.

  • You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision.

  • You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign.

On a typical week

On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities.

In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience.

On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves.

In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details.

On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined.

We offer

  • A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution;

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work;

  • Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals;

  • Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here

  • Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

  • Pension plan;

  • 5 Mental health days per year;

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.


Who you are

You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if:

  • You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech.

  • You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around you.

  • You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas.

  • You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion.

  • You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence.

  • You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard.

  • You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same.

  • You see feedback as a way to improve the work, hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so.

  • You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week.

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

As a Senior Product Designer in Airalo’s User Experience division, you will shape consumer product experiences across native mobile and web for millions of people around the world. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on leading design from problem framing through delivery, partnering closely with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the Airalo Product Design Guild - our community for craft, critique, design systems, research-led decision-making, accessibility, experimentation, AI, and continuous learning.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Lead end-to-end product design for Airalo’s consumer mobile and web experiences, from discovery through delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Data, Growth, and other designers to translate customer needs, insights, and strategy into high-quality product improvements.
  • Create user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, UX copy, and production-ready specifications.
  • Facilitate workshops, critiques, ideation sessions, and stakeholder conversations that create alignment and momentum.
  • Contribute to Airalo’s Design System, improving consistency, accessibility, quality, and efficiency across products.
  • Mentor other designers through feedback, pairing, critique, and shared practice.
  • Help strengthen the Product Design Guild by raising the bar for craft, collaboration, research-led decision-making, and thoughtful use of AI.

    • Must-haves:
  • 6+ years or similar of dedicated experience in product design at a tech startup, scale-up, product-led company, or product-focused agency.
  • A strong portfolio showing high-quality UI, thoughtful interaction design, strong product thinking, and measurable impact.
  • Extensive experience designing, testing, and shipping native mobile and web applications for B2C products.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous design problems from discovery through delivery, balancing user needs, business goals, technical constraints, and product strategy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to explain design rationale clearly to cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced Figma and FigJam skills, with experience creating flows, prototypes, product specifications, and production-ready design assets.
  • Advanced experience working with design systems, native mobile guidelines, responsive design, accessibility, and product quality across mobile and web.
  • Advanced experience with motion, prototyping, or interaction details that bring product experiences to life.
  • Experience working in Lean and/or Agile product development environments, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Data, and Growth.
  • Able to facilitate workshops, critiques, ideation sessions, and alignment conversations.
  • Experience using AI and emerging tools to improve the design workflow beyond simple prototyping.

    • Good to have:
  • Experience in telecommunications, travel, marketplaces, subscriptions, or global consumer products.
  • Knowledge of eSIMs, GSMA-related technologies, or mobile connectivity services.
  • Experience partnering deeply with Research, Data, Growth, or Content Design teams.

    • You should apply if…
  • You lead through craft, clarity, and systems thinking. You can turn complex problems into simple, well-crafted experiences while considering journeys, patterns, accessibility, content, edge cases, and scale.
  • You can own ambiguous problems. You do not need every answer before you start. You ask good questions, define the path forward, make smart trade-offs, and keep momentum without waiting to be told what to do.
  • You care about outcomes, not just output. You use research, data, customer feedback, and product strategy to make decisions that improve the user experience and support business goals.
  • You communicate with confidence and humility. You can explain design decisions clearly to designers, engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders without becoming defensive.
  • You raise the bar for the design community. You give thoughtful feedback, invite critique early, mentor others, and contribute to a Product Design Guild where designers learn and improve together.
  • You are curious about AI and new ways of working. You actively explore how AI and emerging tools can improve design workflows, speed up learning, and help teams make better decisions.

    • This isn't for you if…
  • You only want to design screens. This role requires shaping problems, influencing direction, collaborating across disciplines, and staying involved from discovery through delivery.
  • You need certainty or close direction to make progress. Senior designers at Airalo are expected to move through ambiguity, create momentum, and make thoughtful decisions independently.

  • You optimize for perfection over impact. We care deeply about quality, but we also need to make pragmatic decisions, learn quickly, and ship improvements.
