title: Sr. Director, Evergreen Subscription Sales (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

The Sr. Director, Evergreen Subscription Sales leads the strategy, vision, and execution of Evergreen subscription sales across EMEA. This role translates global portfolio direction and company objectives into segment-specific commercial strategies, sales motions, operating models, and performance mechanisms that increase subscription adoption, recurring revenue, pipeline progression, customer value, and commercial effectiveness worldwide.

The Senior Director leads a global Evergreen Subscription Sales organisation and establishes the priorities, standards, resources, and operating cadence required to execute consistently across regions. The role partners with the Strategics and GSI segment leadership teams, Regional Sales, Account Executives, alliance and partner leaders, and executive stakeholders across Product, Finance, Customer Success, Marketing, Services, and Operations. The role has broad responsibility and significant operational latitude within the defined segments, while the Global VP retains overall ownership of the Evergreen portfolio strategy and global portfolio direction.

Key Responsibilities

Global Segment Strategy, Vision, and Commercial Leadership

  • Develop the global Evergreen subscription sales strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for EMEA within the context of global portfolio and company objectives.
  • Translate global portfolio direction into integrated segment objectives, priorities, policies, resource plans, sales motions, and operating mechanisms.
  • Establish and own global objectives for subscription adoption, recurring revenue growth, qualified pipeline progression, sales productivity, customer value, retention, and expansion across the two segments.
  • Define global coverage, prioritisation, account, and partner strategies that reflect the needs of strategic customers, GSI relationships, regional markets, and field organisations.
  • Participate with executive leadership in strategic planning, business reviews, forecasting, and decisions affecting the company’s commercial position in the Strategics and GSI segments.
  • Make final implementation decisions within delegated authority and ensure operational effectiveness across the global Evergreen Subscription Sales organisation and its cross-functional programs.
  • Provide informed input into global portfolio strategy, commercial policy, pricing and packaging discussions, and company-wide methods based on segment performance, customer insight, and market dynamics.

Segment Sales Partnership and Executive Commercial Execution

  • Lead the global Evergreen Subscription Sales overlay for the Strategics and GSI segments, establishing engagement standards and aligning with segment leaders, Regional Sales, and Account Executives on priorities, coverage, and execution.
  • Engage early in the most strategic and complex customer and partner opportunities to shape commercial strategy, subscription adoption, deal structure, and long-term account or ecosystem value.
  • Develop repeatable Evergreen sales plays for strategic accounts and GSI-led motions, and drive consistent adoption across relevant regions and field teams.
  • Coach and challenge segment and field leaders on Evergreen value propositions, customer outcomes, competitive differentiation, executive engagement, and commercial execution.
  • Establish executive-level inspection of global pipeline health, opportunity progression, forecast inputs, adoption, financial performance, and execution risks; drive corrective action where needed.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive customers, GSI partners, alliances, and internal leaders, representing the company in critical negotiations and strategic engagements.
  • Serve as the global voice of Strategics and GSI customer and partner insight, ensuring market feedback informs portfolio evolution, commercial strategy, and operating priorities.

Global Organisational Leadership and Talent Development

  • Lead the global Strategics and GSI Evergreen Subscription Sales organisation through subordinate managers, senior leaders, and experienced professionals, as established by the organisation design.
  • Set the organisation’s structure, priorities, objectives, operating cadence, and performance expectations in alignment with global portfolio and company-wide direction.
  • Build organisational capability through coaching, leadership development, succession planning, workforce planning, and performance management across geographies and segments.
  • Establish a global culture of accountability, commercial excellence, customer focus, inclusion, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead the development of new methods, scalable sales capabilities, and global practices that improve Evergreen effectiveness across the two segments and contribute to broader company solutions.
  • Create clarity and momentum through growth, transformation, organisational change, and evolving subscription and commercial models.

Cross-Functional, Segment, and Policy Leadership

  • Partner with Product Management to shape portfolio priorities, commercial readiness, and product or solution responses to Strategics and GSI customer and market requirements.
  • Collaborate with Finance and Operations on global business planning, forecasting, performance management, resource allocation, and budgets with functional or multi-department impact.
  • Work with Customer Success, Services, Marketing, and Sales Operations to optimise the end-to-end customer lifecycle and improve adoption, expansion, and partner outcomes.
  • Influence functional policies, processes, evaluation criteria, enablement, and operating standards that improve commercial effectiveness across the Strategics and GSI segments.
  • Reconcile competing perspectives across segments, regions, functions, customers, and partners and make decisions on sensitive, high-impact matters while preserving relationships and advancing business results.
  • Represent Strategics and GSI priorities, risks, and customer or partner insight in global governance and executive planning forums.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

title: Sr. Talent Partner 🇩🇪
descriptionHtml:
Über pplwise

pplwise unterstützt führende, schnell wachsende Unternehmen in ganz Europa dabei, ihre Wachstumsziele zu erreichen. Unsere Dienstleistungen umfassen Recruiting as a Service und Executive Search, mit einer Spezialisierung auf Technologieunternehmen in Wachstumsphasen.

Wir arbeiten mit börsennotierten Unternehmen wie Uber und JustEatTakeaway, Unicorns wie Clark, TIER und Taxfix sowie zahlreichen Startups und Scale-ups zusammen, die von führenden Venture-Capital-Firmen wie Sequoia Capital, HV Capital und Cherry Ventures finanziert werden.

Gegründet im Jahr 2021, ist pplwise in über 20 Ländern in Europa tätig und verfügt über ein Team von mehr als 40 talentierten Talent Partnern, die ehrgeizige Tech-Unternehmen bei der Bewältigung ihrer Wachstumsphasen unterstützen.

Senior Talent Partner (m/w/d)

Standort: Remote in Deutschland

Dein Einstieg bei pplwise

In deinen ersten zwei Wochen wirst du täglich mit deinem Manager und deinen Teammitgliedern sprechen, um schnell Selbstvertrauen im eigenständigen Arbeiten gemäß den pplwise-Prinzipien, -Rahmenwerken und -Methoden zu gewinnen, während du gleichzeitig alle kennlernst. Dein Onboarding wird typischerweise teilweise intern und teilweise bei einem Kunden stattfinden, bei dem du eingesetzt wirst.

Nach den ersten zwei Wochen bei unserem Kunden wirst du ein solides Verständnis für deren Vision, Strategie und Kultur entwickelt haben sowie ein tiefes Verständnis der Abteilungsziele und -rollen, an denen du arbeiten wirst. Außerdem wirst du Beziehungen zu den Hiring Managern und Teammitgliedern aufgebaut haben und eine Delivery-Prognose im Einklang mit der pplwise-Methode durchgeführt haben.

Nach Abschluss der zwei Wochen wirst du damit beginnen, deine Rollen zu übernehmen, Pipelines aufzubauen und proaktiv Insights an wichtige Stakeholder zu berichten, um Engpässe zu identifizieren und vorherzusehen.

Die Herausforderung

  • Unterstütze Startups, Scale-ups und börsennotierte Wachstumsunternehmen eigenständig und verantwortungsvoll bei der Erreichung ihrer Rekrutierungsziele.

  • Manage Stakeholder proaktiv und exzellent, um unsere Rolle als strategische Partner zu erfüllen, indem du Engpässe identifizierst und sie durch Kommunikation und kritisches Denken löst.

  • Entwickle und implementiere Rekrutierungsprognosen und wähle geeignete Kanäle und Strategien mit einem soliden Verständnis von Dringlichkeit und rückwärtsgerichteter Planung.

  • Nutze Rekrutierungssysteme zu deinem Vorteil, indem du Insights aus den gesammelten Daten vor und während der Rekrutierung gewinnst.

  • Manage Tech-Rollen von Anfang bis Ende und lege dabei großen Wert auf eine exzellente Kandidatenerfahrung.

  • Arbeite mit dem Team zusammen, indem du Unterstützung für Sourcing- oder Delivery-Engpässe gibst oder empfängst.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Skalierungsprozessen in verschiedenen Tech-Startups und/oder Scale-ups; zusätzliche Agenturerfahrung ist ein Plus.

  • Du verstehst die Struktur und Herausforderungen von Tech-Organisationen in verschiedenen Wachstumsphasen und kannst Hiring Manager bei der Definition von Rollen unterstützen.

  • Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten und Fakten.

  • Die Zufriedenheit der Stakeholder ist deine höchste Priorität.

  • Du bist ehrgeizig und kollaborativ – Eigenschaften, die unserer Kultur zugrunde liegen.

  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse für die interne Kommunikation und internationale Kunden.

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse.

Was dich erwartet

  • Eine dynamische, herausfordernde Rolle bei der Zusammenarbeit mit Startups, Scale-ups und börsennotierten Unternehmen, sowohl lokal als auch global.

  • Hervorragende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten als Talent Partner aufgrund unserer hohen Standards, Fokus auf Qualität und erheblichem individuellen Verantwortung.

  • Flexibilität und Autonomie, da wir ein vollständig remote arbeitendes Unternehmen sind.

  • Ein talentiertes, ehrgeiziges und kollaboratives Team.

  • Intensive Schulungen, um einen hohen Arbeitsstandard zu entwickeln und aufrechtzuerhalten.

pplwise fördert aktiv ein vielfältiges und inklusives Umfeld, das die Individualität jedes Kandidaten unterstützt. Wir ergreifen affirmative Maßnahmen, um Chancengleichheit im Bewerbungsprozess sicherzustellen, unabhängig von Nationalität, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Behinderung, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung oder Geschlechtsidentität.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich, dich zu bewerben 🚀

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Staff Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

As a Staff Data Scientist at Hims & Hers, you are a technical leader and a "force multiplier" for our data organization. You do not just solve the most difficult problems; you identify which problems are worth solving to move the needle for our customers. You will serve as a technical anchor, simplifying ambiguous problems into executable paths for the team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business strategy and production-ready machine learning. Whether you are building frameworks for growth, optimizing our supply chain, or refining marketing attribution, you will ensure our data products are technically sound, scalable, and built to deliver measurable business results.

You Will:

  • Architect the 0-to-1 Foundation: Lead the design and implementation of automated ML systems. You know how to balance "doing it right" with "doing it fast," making pragmatic architectural choices (build vs. buy, simple vs. complex) while rolling up your sleeves to write production code and establish our core ML infrastructure.

  • Translate Business Needs: Turn ambiguous business questions (from customer acquisition to churn dynamics) into concrete technical roadmaps that deliver clear, actionable results

  • Drive Execution and Reliability: Lead the end-to-end deployment of ML products, ensuring they are not just accurate but robust, maintainable, and fully integrated into our production infrastructure

  • Connect Technical & Business Goals: Partner across Engineering, Product, and Business to ensure our technical strategy is solving the right business problems and moving our core metrics

  • Define Technical Standards: Act as a force multiplier by establishing the standards for model development. You will lead design docs and peer reviews that ensure our work is reproducible and integrates with the work of our Data and Analytics Engineering partners

  • Own the Results: Take accountability for the full model lifecycle, from the initial data design through to the long-term performance and business value of production systems

  • Mentorship & Coaching: Actively mentor Senior and Mid-level Data Scientists, elevating the technical bar and fostering a culture of continuous learning across the data organization.

Experience & Skills:

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Science or ML Engineering, with a proven track record of building production systems that deliver measurable business impact

  • Technical Mastery: High proficiency in Python and SQL. Expert-level experience with the Python data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and at least one major ML framework (such as PyTorch or XGBoost/LightGBM)

  • Systemic Problem Solving: Ability to work on unique issues requiring conceptual thinking and broad impact. You know how to build for long-term scalability while delivering immediate value

  • Leadership & Influence: Proven ability to influence without authority. You can translate complex technical logic into compelling narratives for executive leadership

  • Engineering Rigor: Experience with CI/CD, ML Ops, and managing the full lifecycle of models in a cloud-based production environment (AWS or GCP)

  • Education: BS, MS, or PhD in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, CS, Applied Math, etc.) or equivalent field expertise

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 0-to-1 Execution: Experience taking the very first machine learning models in an organization from exploratory notebooks to reliable, automated production pipelines.

  • Advanced Business ML (Experience in 1-2 of the following):

    • Customer Behavior & Propensity Modeling: Building predictive models for churn, propensity-to-buy, lead scoring, or lifetime value (LTV) to directly drive targeted marketing and product interventions.

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR – We’re looking for an experienced, Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to help build the future of AI-powered software creation. You will be a founding member of our FDE function, working directly with our customers to translate ambitious ideas into real products. This is a hands-on software engineering role: you will design, write, and ship production code. It’s a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before.

 

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

 

About the role

Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both.

You’ll build alongside customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving technically difficult problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn’t simply to make individual deployments successful: it’s to identify what should become part of the Lovable platform and then build it.

As one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers, you’ll also help define the function - from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it collaborates with customers and our core product teams.

If you want to stay deeply hands-on while shaping a product, a team and a new engineering discipline, this is that role. As you’ll be working directly with customers, travel up to 50% could be required depending on needs.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping production software

  • Extensive software engineering skills across the application stack with a track record of writing maintainable, well-tested code and owning what you build in production

  • Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems

  • Ability to prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into production-quality solutions

  • Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users

  • Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and end-to-end ownership

Bonus if you’ve:

  • Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs before

  • Led zero-to-one product development

  • Worked in a founding or early startup environment

 

What you’ll do

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and problems

  • Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and working production systems

  • Design, code, test, deploy, and operate solutions across Lovable’s frontend and backend

  • Translate insights from real usage into foundational platform improvements

  • Own projects end-to-end—from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration

  • Debug complex issues across application, infrastructure, and AI-system boundaries

  • Shape how Forward Deployed Engineering operates at Lovable, including its engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks

  • Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations

 

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Golang & Rust

  • Frontend: React, Typescript

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers

  • Tooling: Github Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more

 

How we hire

  1. Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team.

  2. Complete a quick live coding exercise.

  3. Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.

  4. Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud.

 

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language

  • We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. [AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Location: France, Germany, Spain, or Italy — remote within these hiring locations.

Join us as a Staff Applied AI Engineer, Backend to build production systems in which AI is a core runtime capability. You'll help Qonto's Anti-Financial Crime teams investigate cases faster and with greater confidence by turning complex operational workflows into dependable, measurable tools.

➡️ As a Staff Applied AI Engineer you will

  • Build production AI systems: Design and ship agentic tools and AI-powered workflows that gather context from multiple internal systems, orchestrate models and tools, parse structured outputs, and handle uncertainty and failure safely

  • Own projects end to end: Lead discovery with AFC stakeholders, shape the solution, make architectural decisions, implement and launch it, then operate, maintain, and improve it in production

  • Design robust backend foundations: Build reliable, maintainable, and extensible services, APIs, databases, and integrations around evolving AI models and tooling

  • Make AI behaviour measurable: Define evaluation approaches, observability, fallbacks, and human-review mechanisms; monitor output quality, acceptance and edit rates, throughput, and operational impact

  • Deliver measurable operational value: Reduce investigation lead time and expand automation across AFC workflows through pragmatic, incremental delivery

  • Shape the team’s technical direction: Lead design discussions, anticipate risks, balance speed with quality, and help raise the team’s capability in production agentic systems

➡️ What you can expect

  • AI at the heart of the system: This is not a conventional backend role using AI only as a coding assistant, nor an ML research role. You’ll build real products where model behaviour, orchestration, evaluation, and failure handling are production concerns

  • High autonomy: There is no dedicated Product Manager. Engineers work directly with AFC stakeholders and own the path from an ambiguous operational need to a measurable production outcome

  • Lean, iterative delivery: The team uses a daily 15-minute blocker sync, bi-weekly 1:1s, and lightweight tracking, leaving engineers focused on building and solving problems

  • A close user feedback loop: You’ll collaborate directly with operational teams and measure success through investigation lead-time reduction, output quality, human acceptance and edit rates, adoption, throughput, and resources saved

  • A complex, meaningful domain: You’ll learn how to build safe, scalable AI automation in a regulated environment where reliability and auditability matter

➡️ Your future team

You’ll join Qonto’s AI Compliance Tooling team within the Financial Crime Compliance domain. The current team brings together Ioannis, the Tech Lead and a hands-on contributor; Staff Backend Engineer Enrique; Staff Machine Learning Engineer Luca; and Senior Backend Engineers Izan and Robson. The team is growing with two additional staff-level hybrid backend/AI hires.

One important clarification: the team does not build fraud-detection engines or KYC/KYB rule engines. It consumes upstream signals and builds the AI-powered automation and intelligence layer used by human investigators. One current system gathers information from 10–15 internal tools and produces a structured compliance analysis for a person to approve or edit, reducing treatment time from approximately 15–20 minutes to about 30 seconds.

➡️ About you

  • Production AI experience: You have shipped an AI agent or agentic workflow used by real users and can explain its orchestration, tool use, state, structured outputs, evaluation, retries, and failure modes

  • Strong backend engineering: You bring solid system-design fundamentals across architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, reliability, observability, maintainability, and scalability

  • Staff-level autonomy and judgement: You make sound decisions independently, communicate trade-offs clearly, and know when to optimise for speed and when quality is non-negotiable

  • Product and stakeholder thinking: You can turn ambiguous operational pain into a valuable solution, challenge assumptions, prioritise scope, and define success without relying on a PM

  • End-to-end ownership: You are willing to discover, build, ship, operate, maintain, and continuously improve the systems you create

  • Learning agility: You are curious about AFC and regulated workflows and can ramp up quickly in a complex domain; prior fintech or compliance experience is helpful, not required

  • Pragmatic technology choices: Python experience and familiarity with current model providers or agent frameworks are useful, but transferable production principles matter more than expertise in a specific language or vendor

title: Staff Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.

Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and merchants every day. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s (& Doordash’s) growth at scale.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Event Streaming Systems team. This is a hybrid role.

In this role, you’ll provide technical leadership for the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. You’ll help define the long-term direction of our messaging and streaming platforms, lead high-impact technical initiatives across teams, and raise the reliability, scalability and operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies. The team also partners closely with Database Reliability, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams to ensure our most critical data and messaging systems remain reliable, operable and cost-efficient at global scale.

These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for our event streaming and messaging platforms, balancing reliability, scalability, cost, operability and developer experience.
  • Lead team-level and cross-team initiatives for Kafka, EventBus and related streaming infrastructure, from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, delivery, rollout and adoption.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for Kafka, messaging, storage-adjacent and DBRE-related platform decisions across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • Design durable, extensible systems and platform capabilities that can be leveraged by other engineers and teams, reducing duplicated effort and operational risk.
  • Lead the resolution of complex distributed systems problems, including reliability incidents, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, data-safety risks and production-operability gaps.
  • Raise the operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure through observability, automation, incident response, runbooks, operational readiness and continuous improvement.
  • Proactively build alignment with partner teams, including EventBus, Storage, DBRE, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure, shaping joint goals and mitigating cross-org delivery risks.
  • Mentor and grow engineers through technical guidance, design, feedback, code review, incident review facilitation and knowledge-sharing across the engineering community.
  • Evaluate emerging streaming, storage and automation technologies, including AI-enabled operational tooling where appropriate, and champion pragmatic adoption where they can materially improve quality, velocity or efficiency.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in several of these areas and the judgment to lead others through ambiguity:

  • Significant experience building, operating and evolving distributed systems in production, ideally for platform or infrastructure teams supporting critical workloads.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kafka or comparable event streaming systems as a platform, infrastructure service or business-critical production dependency.
  • Strong technical leadership skills, with a track record of defining technical direction, shaping roadmaps and leading multi-engineer or cross-team initiatives.
  • Ability to make and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations, using data, operational signals, customer needs and long-term system health to guide tradeoffs.
  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable, observable and scalable production systems.
  • Experience improving production reliability through automation, observability, capacity management, incident response, operational readiness and sustainable on-call practices.
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including Linux, networking, storage, JVM-based systems, fault tolerance, backpressure, capacity planning and performance tuning.
  • A force-multiplier mindset: you create leverage through reusable technical foundations, clear documentation, strong engineering practices, mentoring and removing single points of failure.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence platform, infrastructure, product and reliability teams without relying on authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.
  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.
  • Experience with JVM tuning, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.
  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale, including incident leadership and post-incident improvement programs.
  • Experience with database reliability, storage systems, data platforms or DBRE practices in addition to event streaming.
  • Experience using automation or AI-assisted operational tooling to improve reliability, developer experience or incident response quality.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo (Doordash), you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.

Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale. Work on complex, always-on infrastructure that impacts millions every day.
  • 🌱 See your impact, fast. Shape the direction of foundational platforms used by teams across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership. Lead ambiguous, high-impact technical problems with strong support from peers and leaders.
  • 🌎 A culture built for builders. High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
  • 💰 Share in the success you help create. Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes 3–4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide to help you feel confident at each stage.

Our Global Structure

title: Stage - Commercial·e / Sales / Business Developer
descriptionHtml:
Le département Sales compte une trentaine de personnes réparties entre la qualification des prospects et le closing. Leur objectif commun : accompagner les prospects jusqu’à la signature du contrat en Assemblée Générale.

Notre cycle de vente est long et complexe en BtoC (3 à 4 mois en moyenne). La particularité ? La copropriété doit voter à la majorité lors de son assemblée générale pour souscrire à notre solution.

Tu rejoins l'équipe SDR, et ton objectif principal sera d'accompagner et de convaincre nos prospects à poursuivre le processus de vente en organisant des rendez-vous avec les Account Executives.

En tant que SDR, tu représentes le premier contact client, tu es le premier maillon de notre processus de vente ; ainsi, tu participes activement à l'atteinte de nos objectifs commerciaux.

En rejoignant le département Sales de Matera, tu auras l’opportunité d’échanger chaque jour avec des interlocuteurs très différents !

Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre !

Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente.

Tes missions :

En binôme avec nos commerciaux et sous la responsabilité de ton/ta manager, tu seras formé·e pour découvrir le métier de Sales Development Representative (SDR).

  • Prendre en main la qualification : Réaliser les premiers échanges téléphoniques avec les prospects ayant formulé une demande de devis pour instaurer un premier contact de confiance.

  • Comprendre les besoins : T’entraîner à analyser les problématiques rencontrées au sein des copropriétés et présenter les offres Matera.

  • Assister les Account Executives : Participer à la prise de rendez-vous de démonstration et épauler les AE dans le suivi des prospects, la préparation des assemblées générales et les tâches administratives.

  • Découvrir nos outils Sales : Participer à la tenue à jour de notre CRM (Hubspot) et appliquer les bonnes pratiques de suivi.Organiser des rendez-vous de démonstration avec les Account Executives,

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue : Proposer tes idées et participer aux projets internes visant à fluidifier nos processus commerciaux.

Déroulement du stage :

• Deux semaines d’immersion : Découverte de nos métiers, de nos équipes et de notre vision globale.
• Intégration à la Sales Academy : Tout du long de ton stage, tu bénéficieras d’un accompagnement sur mesure (formations techniques sur la copropriété, ateliers pratiques sur les méthodes de vente).
• Suivi régulier : Des échanges hebdomadaires avec ton/ta manager pour accompagner ta montée en compétences et lever tes blocages.
• Perspective d’évolution : En fonction de ta progression et de ton projet, tu pourras élargir ton champ d’apprentissage en découvrant les étapes suivantes du cycle de vente auprès de nos Account Executives.

À la fin de ton stage, tu maîtriseras les techniques de vente, les cycles de vente complexes et les meilleurs outils utilisés par les start-ups. Tu participes au lancement de nouvelles offres, ce qui te permet de comprendre comment fonctionne l'entrepreneuriat.

  • Une forte montée en compétence sur les métiers de Sales, la vente complexe, la connaissance de l'environnement start-up et immobilier,

  • Poursuite possible en CDI avec évolution en Account Executive par la suite,

  • Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis

  • Carte ticket restaurant Swile (France)

  • Abonnement à Gymlib (France),

Informations pratiques :

  • Localisation : Paris 10e

Idéalement, tu :

title: Stage Eventmanagement
descriptionHtml:
Stage Eventcoördinatie bij Priva

Ben jij georganiseerd, ondernemend en krijg je energie van events? Vind je het leuk om dingen te regelen, overzicht te creëren en ervoor te zorgen dat alles achter de schermen klopt? Dan hebben we bij Priva een stageplek voor jou.

Als Eventcoördinatie Stagiair(e) werk je direct samen met onze Event Manager aan het eventportfolio van Priva. Je bent dus niet alleen bezig met ondersteunende klusjes: je krijgt een actieve rol in de voorbereiding en uitvoering van verschillende events. Van de eerste planning tot de laatste materialen op de stand.

Wat ga je doen?
Samen met de Event Manager zorg je ervoor dat events soepel verlopen. Je houdt overzicht, pakt zelfstandig werkzaamheden op en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

  • Meewerken aan de voorbereiding en planning van events;

  • Contact onderhouden met leveranciers en andere eventpartners;

  • Ondersteunen bij registraties, uitnodigingen en deelnemerscommunicatie;

  • Organiseren en beheren van eventmaterialen en promotiemiddelen;

  • Planningen en draaiboeken voorbereiden en bijhouden;

  • Offertes en praktische afspraken met leveranciers opvolgen;

  • Helpen bij de logistieke voorbereiding van events;

  • Meedenken over hoe we onze events slimmer en efficiënter kunnen organiseren;

  • Tijdens eventdagen zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken en verantwoordelijkheden oppakken.

Je zit niet alleen achter je laptop, maar ervaart hoe een event daadwerkelijk tot leven komt. Je werkt samen met de Event Manager, leveranciers, collega's en andere betrokkenen en krijgt steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid.
Tijdens je stage werk je toe naar een van de grootste events binnen Priva: GreenTech Amsterdam in juni 2027. Een event waar veel bij komt kijken en waar je vanaf de voorbereiding tot en met de eventdagen bij betrokken bent. Van planning en leverancierscontact tot materialen, logistiek en de uitvoering op locatie: je ziet letterlijk het resultaat van jouw werk terug op de beursvloer.

Na GreenTech 2027 zit jouw stage erop. Een mooie manier om je stageperiode af te sluiten én een event van formaat van dichtbij mee te maken.

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een ​​optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen.

Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan ​​als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen.


Wat zoeken we in jou?
We zoeken geen student die afwacht tot er een taak wordt gegeven. We zoeken iemand die ziet wat er moet gebeuren en het leuk vindt om het te regelen. Iemand die creatieve ideeen heeft en durft voorstellen te doen.

Je:

  • volgt een mbo-, hbo- of vergelijkbare opleiding richting Eventmanagement, Leisure & Events, Marketing, Communicatie of Hospitality;

  • zoekt een meewerkstage en geen afstudeerstage;

  • bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar;

  • bent georganiseerd en houdt ervan om overzicht te creëren;

  • Beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • vindt het leuk om met verschillende mensen en leveranciers te schakelen;

  • bent praktisch ingesteld en denkt graag in oplossingen;

  • durft vragen te stellen, maar kunt ook zelfstandig aan de slag;

  • vindt het leuk als geen dag precies hetzelfde is;

  • hebt interesse in zakelijke events, beurzen en marketing.

Ervaring met events is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme, initiatief en organisatietalent vinden we belangrijker.

Wat krijg je ervoor terug?
Bij Priva krijg je geen stage waarin je vooral meekijkt. Je wordt onderdeel van het team en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.Je krijgt:

  • een afwisselende meewerkstage met echte verantwoordelijkheid;

  • directe begeleiding van een ervaren Event Manager;

  • de kans om meerdere events van dichtbij mee te maken;

  • ervaring met leveranciers, budgetten, planning en eventlogistiek;

  • een kijkje achter de schermen bij zakelijke events en internationale beurzen;

  • een stage waarin je kunt ontdekken waar jouw talenten liggen;

  • én natuurlijk een hele mooie eindstreep: GreenTech 2027.

Klaar om mee te organiseren?
Ben jij de student die liever regelt dan toekijkt? Die energie krijgt van een goede planning, blij wordt als alles op zijn plek valt en het leuk vindt om samen naar een groot event toe te werken?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Stuur ons je CV en vertel kort waarom jij enthousiast wordt van deze stage bij Priva. We kijken uit naar je reactie!

title: Stage - Ingénieur.e SQA Python, banc de test physique - H/F
descriptionHtml:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Nous avons l'obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs.

Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.

Intégré.e au sein de l'équipe SQA, vous prendrez en main un banc de test physique déjà en production : il valide chaque nuit l'installation, la mise à jour et la configuration d'une vingtaine de modèles de produits Withings (balances, montres, tensiomètres…), pilotés en UART et relais, intégrés à notre CI Jenkins. Ce stage a pour but de penser, concevoir et produire une version améliorée permettant d'automatiser les interactions physiques — prendre une mesure, monter sur une balance, porter une montre, appuyer sur un bouton, vérifier ce que l'écran du dispositif affiche — afin de convertir en tests automatiques (python) les cas de tests exécutés à la main.

En forte interaction avec la QA Firmware, vos principales responsabilités incluront :

- Automatiser les mesures simulables : injection de mesures en dblib côté firmware, synchronisation réelle, vérification dans l'app.

- Explorer l'émulation de device : étudier et prototyper la simulation complète d'un produit sur Raspberry Pi (comportement BLE/Wi-Fi, cycle d'installation, génération de mesures)

- Étendre la couverture du banc existant : nouveaux modèles de produits, nouveaux scénarios (installation, firmware, synchronisation)

- Concevoir, modéliser et réaliser les jig de tests : impression 3D de supports et d'actionneurs, pilotage de relais et d'instrumentation série, lecture de l'état des dispositifs (écran, LED).

- Développer et maintenir les scripts d'automatisation en Python (Appium, pytest) qui orchestrent app mobile (iOS et Android), backend et instrumentation physique.

- Intégrer chaque nouveau scénario à la CI Jenkins pour qu'il tourne chaque nuit, et mesurer la réduction du volume de tests manuels qu'il permet.

- Travailler avec les outils d'aujourd'hui : l'équipe développe avec un harness d'agents de code (Claude Code…) — pipeline de génération de tests, revues assistées ; vous l'utiliserez et contribuerez à l'améliorer.

- Analyser les résultats, remonter les bugs et documenter les composants hardware et software ; participer aux revues de code.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant.e en dernière année d'une formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université) et recherchez un stage de fin d'études ;
  • Une excellente maîtrise de Python est indispensable, notamment pour l'automatisation et l'interfaçage avec le hardware (ex : pyserial) ;
  • Des connaissances en conception mécanique et/ou en impression 3D (ex : FreeCAD, Fusion 360, Cura) seraient un atout majeur — le jig est autant mécanique que logiciel ;
  • Des bases en électronique (schémas simples, capteurs, relais, UART) seraient un plus ;
  • Une curiosité pour les agents de code (Claude Code, Codex…) est un plus ;
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les environnements MacOS et Linux ;
  • Vous êtes passionné.e par les produits high-tech innovants, l'IoT et les enjeux de la qualité logicielle et hardware ;

title: Stage of Afstuderen: Toepassing van Augmented Reality
descriptionHtml:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen Service & Support onderzoeken we hoe Augmented Reality (AR) kan bijdragen aan een efficiëntere en effectievere dienstverlening. Nieuwe technologieën bieden steeds meer mogelijkheden om klanten en monteurs op afstand te ondersteunen en stilstand van machines te beperken. Wij willen inzicht krijgen in welke toepassingen voor Voortman relevant zijn en hoe deze structureel ingezet kunnen worden binnen onze serviceorganisatie.

Tijdens deze stage onderzoek je de technische en organisatorische mogelijkheden van Augmented Reality binnen service en remote support. Je analyseert verschillende toepassingsmogelijkheden, waaronder het gebruik van een RealWear Smart Glass voor ondersteuning op afstand. Daarnaast onderzoek je welke procesveranderingen nodig zijn om AR succesvol te implementeren en welke voordelen dit kan opleveren voor de kwaliteit, snelheid en efficiëntie van onze serviceprocessen.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het onderzoeken van de mogelijkheden van Augmented Reality binnen customer service, remote support en field service;

  • Het analyseren van de inzet van de RealWear Smart Glass voor het ondersteunen van monteurs en klanten op afstand;

  • Het in kaart brengen van benodigde procesveranderingen voor de implementatie van Smart Glasses;

  • Het bepalen van mogelijke procesverbeteringen op het gebied van efficiëntie, reactietijd en servicekwaliteit.

Het eindresultaat van de opdracht is een onderbouwd implementatieplan waarmee Voortman de inzet van Augmented Reality binnen haar serviceorganisatie kan beoordelen en verder ontwikkelen.

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. title: Stagiair(e) Digitale Transformatie & Publieke Innovatie
descriptionHtml:
Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Digitalisering verandert de manier waarop overheden en publieke organisaties werken, besluiten nemen en dienstverlening organiseren. Tegelijkertijd groeit de behoefte aan praktische oplossingen, toepasbare kennis en slimme instrumenten die organisaties helpen om complexe digitale vraagstukken beheersbaar te maken.

Wil jij ervaring opdoen binnen een toonaangevend adviesbureau en bijdragen aan vraagstukken op het gebied van digitalisering, data, digitale autonomie en publieke innovatie? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou.

Dit ga je doen

Als stagiair(e) binnen het team Digitale Transformatie ondersteun je adviseurs bij uiteenlopende opdrachten voor ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, provincies, gemeenten en andere maatschappelijke organisaties.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ondersteunen bij onderzoeken, analyses en adviesopdrachten.

  • Voorbereiden en ondersteunen van workshops, werksessies en bijeenkomsten voor opdrachtgevers.

  • Meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van praktische handreikingen, methodieken en kennisproducten.

  • Uitwerken van onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete producten voor opdrachtgevers.

  • Actualiseren en verrijken van onze website, publicaties en online kennisproducten.

  • Structureren, actualiseren en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande kenniscollecties tot een deelbare kenniscatalogus.

  • Uitvoeren van markt- en deskresearch naar ontwikkelingen op het gebied van digitalisering, data en digitale autonomie.

  • Ondersteunen bij de doorontwikkeling van onze digitale-autonomie-quickscan en andere proposities.

Afhankelijk van jouw interesses en achtergrond draai je bovendien mee in lopende adviesprojecten.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één,

krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je wordt onderdeel van het team Digitale Transformatie binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur van Berenschot.

Ons team ondersteunt organisaties bij vraagstukken rond digitale strategie, informatiehuishouding, digitale autonomie, datastrategie, cybersecurity en continuiteit, governance, dienstverlening en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij combineren we inhoudelijke kennis van technologie met inzicht in recht, bestuur, beleid en organisatie.

Je werkt samen met adviseurs met uiteenlopende achtergronden, waaronder bestuurskunde, informatiemanagement, bedrijfskunde, data en technologie. Vanaf dag één krijg je verantwoordelijkheid en lever je een concrete bijdrage aan opdrachten en producten.


Dit neem je mee

Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding op het snijvlak van data, digitalisering, IT en organisatievraagstukken, bijvoorbeeld informatiemanagement, business IT & management, digital business, data science & business, technische bedrijfskunde, bestuurskunde (met een focus op digitalisering), bedrijfskunde (met een focus op technologie of innovatie) of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je affiniteit met digitalisering en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

  • Ben je analytisch sterk en nieuwsgierig.

  • Werk je zelfstandig en gestructureerd.

  • Kun je complexe informatie helder opschrijven.

  • Vind je het leuk om kennis te ontwikkelen én praktisch toepasbaar te maken.

Dit bieden we jou

  • Een meewerkstage van 4 tot 6 maanden.

  • Startdatum januari/februari 2027.

  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,- per maand (op fulltimebasis).

  • Een laptop.

  • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding door een ervaren adviseur.

  • Een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng.

  • De mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven.

  • De mogelijkheid om in te stromen in het traineeship van Berenschot.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Marielle Boer via WhatsApp (06 10 48 71 59) of per e-mail ----- voor informatie over de procedure.

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve eerste indruk nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Als dat goed aansluit, ontvang je een concreet aanbod.

title: Strategic Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The role

As a Strategic Account Manager, you’ll own our largest accounts — the global banks, top-tier law firms, multi-strategy hedge funds, asset managers, and private equity firms. This is a rare combination of Account Management and Enterprise Sales: you’ll be the trusted senior relationship owner for the account and the commercial lead responsible for expanding 9fin into every relevant team, desk, and geography inside it.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Owning the end-to-end relationship and commercial success of a small portfolio of 9fin’s largest most complex accounts, including global banks, top-tier law firms, hedge funds, asset managers and PE sponsors.

  • Acting as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor for MDs, Partners, PMs, Heads of Desk and C-suite stakeholders — building deep, multi-threaded relationships across each organisation.

  • Building and executing strategic account plans that map the org, identify white space, and lay out a clear path to materially growing ARR over multi-year horizons.

  • Driving expansion by qualifying and closing new opportunities inside your accounts, new teams, new desks, new asset classes, new geographies — running full enterprise sales cycles alongside your renewal motion.

  • Leading commercial negotiations on multi-year renewals, uplifts and enterprise agreements, partnering with Legal and Finance and on complex procurement and MSA processes.

  • Deeply understanding each client’s workflows in credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed and private credit, and translating those into concrete use cases 9fin can solve.

  • Partnering closely with Product and Engineering to bring the voice of your clients into the roadmap — you are their most credible advocate internally.

  • Representing 9fin externally at client offsites, executive briefings, industry conferences and roundtables, becoming a recognised name in debt markets.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 7+ years managing and growing strategic enterprise accounts, ideally selling data, SaaS, research or workflow platforms into global banks, buy-side firms, or law firms.

  • Have a proven track record of owning multi-million-dollar accounts and materially expanding them — you can point to specific accounts you’ve grown from $X to $Y and explain exactly how.

  • Combine the depth of a top-tier Account Manager with the commercial edge of a top-tier Enterprise Account Executive — you’re equally comfortable running a strategic QBR with an MD and closing a net-new expansion into a team that’s never used 9fin.

  • Have credibility with senior stakeholders in debt or credit markets, whether from selling to them, working in the industry, or both, and a genuine intellectual interest in the space.

  • Are commercially sharp and operationally rigorous: skilled at navigating complex procurement, legal review, executive alignment, and internal cross-functional work at scale.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

 

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

title: Strategic Partnership Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Andela:

At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America.

As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.

Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.

Are you an exceptional, hungry leader seasoned in scaling businesses through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

Job Summary

Strategic Partnership Manager · London, UK

Andela is hiring a London-based Strategic Partnership Manager to own and grow our co-sell partnership with GitHub, one of our most strategic technology partners, across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. GitHub is one of our highest-priority partnerships, and EMEA is where our co-sell momentum with them is strongest.

You will own the partner relationship and be accountable for the partner-sourced and

partner-influenced revenue it produces. That means building trust with GitHub's field sellers and partner team, running deal registration and co-sell, mapping accounts, and keeping our program standing current so the partner sends us more opportunities and continues to invest in us.

GitHub is the anchor, but the role is built to flex. You will work across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem, including co-sell, consumption credit and partner funding programs. As activity grows in region, you will extend the same motion to our AI lab partners. This is a revenue-generating role with a base-plus-variable compensation structure tied to partner-sourced and partner-influenced bookings.

Exceptional Leadership:

As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.

  • Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.

Key Responsibilities

Own the GitHub partnership in EMEA

  • Build and maintain relationships with GitHub's EMEA field sellers, partner managers, solution engineers and services leaders, so Andela is the partner they bring into accounts first.

  • Own the joint Partner Business Plan for the region, and run the QBR cadence and monthly deal reviews with GitHub.

  • Represent Andela in person at partner offices, sales kickoffs, field events and executive meetings across EMEA.

Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue

  • Source new opportunities from the partner's field organization and qualify them before bringing in Andela sales and Solutions Managers.

  • Run co-sell on live deals: connect partner sellers with Andela sellers, keep the partner informed through close, and remove blockers on both sides.

  • Map accounts with GitHub to agree on which customers we target together, then align Andela's EMEA sales team on how to pursue them.

  • Build and manage partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, with clean attribution in Salesforce.

Run deal registration, funding and program mechanics

  • Register every partner-involved opportunity so Andela receives credit for the consumption and seats we drive (for example, platform seats and cloud consumption).

  • Identify and secure deal-based partner funding, including co-investment and incentive programs, so sellers have more pricing flexibility on competitive deals.

  • Manage marketplace listings and partner program tiers: track designation and specialization requirements, certification counts, customer references and registered-deal thresholds, and file what is needed to maintain or move up a tier.

  • Maintain partner attribution tooling, such as partner portals and deal and consumption tagging.

Work across the Andela partner team

  • Bring Solutions Managers into qualified opportunities and partner enablement sessions, and relay what partner sellers need back into our offers.

  • Partner with the Partner Marketer on campaigns to partner sellers, joint customer campaigns and events, and own follow-up with partner sellers on the leads they produce.

  • Feed wins back into customer stories and references that strengthen our standing with each partner.

  • Report on partner pipeline, bookings, funding secured and program status to the Director of Partnerships and sales leadership.

Extend the motion to more partners

  • Apply the same co-sell playbook across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem in EMEA.

  • As activity grows, support our AI lab partners in region: partner seller relationships, deal registration, program tiers and marketplace presence.

How success is measured

  • Partner-sourced bookings (primary), with partner-influenced bookings credited at a lower weight.

  • Deals registered and accepted by the partner, and co-sell opportunities with a partner seller engaged.

  • Partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, and co-sell wins.

  • Partner funding secured, and partner consumption driven (platform seats, cloud consumption, AI licenses).

  • Program status: designations achieved, tier requirements met, business plans current and QBRs held on schedule.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in partner, alliance or channel management at a technology services firm, consultancy, systems integrator or ISV.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with the GitHub partner program or a comparable cloud or developer-platform partner program: co-sell, deal registration, partner portals and partner funding claims.

  • A track record of carrying a partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue target and growing pipeline through a partner's field sellers.

  • Experience running joint business plans, QBRs and account mapping with a large technology partner.

  • Enough technical fluency in software development, DevOps, platform migration or AI adoption to qualify an opportunity before bringing in a solutions specialist.

  • Comfortable working through others: you influence partner sellers and internal sales teams without direct authority.

  • Strong organization and follow-through on program mechanics, with clean CRM hygiene (Salesforce preferred).

  • Based in or able to work from London, and able to travel across EMEA for partner meetings and events.

Preferred

  • An existing network inside GitHub's EMEA partner and field organizations.

  • Experience managing partner tiers, designations, specializations and marketplace listings (for example, cloud marketplace listings and partner designations).

  • Exposure to AI lab partner programs, or interest in growing into them. We value candidates with a strong GitHub or cloud partner foundation who can carry that motion into newer programs.

  • Background selling or partnering on developer tooling, cloud modernization, engineering talent or technical training services.

  • Experience working across European and African markets.

  • Experience at a company building a partner function from an early stage.

Or you'd love going adventurous into new areas as long as you're solving real world problems? Let's talk and figure it out where there's the best match.  

What are the long term opportunities for this role? What happens after I'm done with a project?

You get full accountability from the start: from shaping the strategy and driving step-change improvements, to collaborating with multiple teams to achieve tangible business results.

At Picnic, the long-term opportunity isn't just a role—it’s a platform to shape your own career trajectory with real ownership, business impact, and fast growth. Hence the career paths are as diverse as your ambitions. Depending on your interests and strengths, these are most common career paths we’ve seen so far:

  • Given our scale-up environment, many projects tend to grow in scope and complexity under your responsibility and you naturally grow a team around you in order to take your project to a next level.
  • As you grow, you’ll deepen your understanding of the business, build a strong internal network, and prove your ability to lead impactful projects. Once you feel you’ve learned everything in your scope and your projects have been successfully implemented, you can switch to complete different areas of Picnic. We have numerous colleagues that have switched from Commercial to Fulfillment, or from Distribution to Customer and many other examples.

title: Supply Chain & Operations Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

getolo ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt fördert. title: Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders) in our Structures Team, you will lead the structural design and development of VÆRIDION’s fuselage, door, and windows work packages for our CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

Your mission is to guide a small team of engineers in delivering lightweight, manufacturable, certifiable, and production-ready structural solutions. You will be responsible for technical direction, work-package execution, team coordination, cross-functional alignment, and delivery quality within your scope.

This role combines hands-on aircraft structures expertise with strong leadership. You will not only execute engineering work yourself, but also enable others, remove blockers, anticipate risks, and represent the Structures function in internal and external discussions.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead complete fuselage, doors, and windows work packages independently.

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of structures engineers.

  • Set priorities, assign tasks, track progress, and ensure high-quality delivery.

  • Own technical coordination for fuselage structures, door surrounds, window cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, and installations.

  • Drive design maturity from concept through detailed design, prototype build, test support, and production release.

  • Anticipate and mitigate technical, schedule, manufacturing, supplier, and certification risks.

  • Represent Structures in cross-functional meetings, design reviews, supplier reviews, and certification discussions.

  • Align stakeholders across Stress, Systems, Production, Certification, Quality, Procurement, and external partners.

  • Challenge assumptions, bring practical design improvements, and help the team make sound technical decisions.

  • Review key engineering outputs, including CAD models, drawings, interface definitions, and design documentation.

  • Build team capability by improving methods, standards, templates, and ways of working.

 

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of aerospace structural design experience.

  • Proven experience leading technical work packages and coordinating engineering teams.

  • Strong leadership skills: clear communication, prioritization, decision-making, conflict resolution, and team development.

  • Experience in at least two full aircraft development programs, such as clean-sheet aircraft, major modifications, prototype-to-certification programs, or production ramp-ups.

  • Strong experience with metallic fuselage structures, aircraft doors, windows, cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, or major airframe assemblies.

  • Strong understanding of metallic and composite aircraft structures, load paths, manufacturability, inspectability, repairability, and certification constraints.

  • Deep proficiency in CATIA V5 or 3DX and configuration-controlled design data.

  • Solid understanding of airworthiness and certification principles related to aircraft structures, ideally including EASA CS-23.

  • Ability to anticipate risks, create clarity, align stakeholders, and deliver results through others.

  • Confidence to represent the function internally and externally.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?
